gzhi'i sde dang / rtogs pa brjod ①pa'i sde dang / de lta bur byung ba'i sde dang /skyes pa dze+erabs kyi sde dang / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang / rmad du byung ①ba'i sde dang / gtan la dbab par bstan pa'i rjosde'o/ /dgongs pa bzhi ni/mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa dang / dus gzhan la dgongs pa dang / don gzhan la dgongs pa dang / gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa'o/ /ldem ⑤por dgongs pa bzhi ni/ gzhug pa la sdem por dgongs pa dang / mtshan nyid la sdem por dgongs pa dang / gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pa dang /bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa'o/ /bden pa bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mo/ /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la bzhi ste/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong rjopa dang / bdag med pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi bden pa la yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ kun 'byung dang /rgyu dang / rkyen dang / rab tu 'byed pa'o/ /'gog pa'i bden pa la yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ 'gog pa dang / zhi ba dang / gya nom pa dang / nges par 'byung ba'o/ /lam la yang bzhi ste/ lam dang / rigs pa dang /bsgrub ④pa dang / nges par 'byin pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi tshogs lam la ⑧lnga ste/so so skye bo'i tshul khrims dang / dbang po'i sgo bsdams ⑨pa dang / zas kyi tshod shes pa dang / nam gye cha stod cha smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang / shes bzhin du gnas par mngon par dga' ba'o/ /sbyor ba'i lam ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha bzhi ste/ drod dang / rtse mo dang / bzod pa dang / 'jig rten chos kyi mchog go/ /mthong ba'i lam ni sems kyi skad cig ma bcu drug go/ /bsgom ⑩pa'i lam ni/ lam chung ngu dang / lam 'bring po 116—779

dang / lam chen po dang / sbyor ba'i lam dang / bar chad med pa'i lam dang / rnam par grol ba'i lam dang / khyad par gyi lam mo/ /lam chung ngu la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ chung ngu'i chung ngu dang / chung ngu'i 'bring po dang /chung ngu'i chen po'o/ /lam 'bring po la yang gsum ste/ che 'bring chung gsum moske/ /lam chen po la yang gsum ste/ che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam ni/ mi slob pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi shes pa bcu drug ni/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / sdug bsngal la chos shes pa dang /sdug bsngal la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'i bzod pa dang / sdug bsngal la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'o/ /kun 'byung la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang /kun 'byung la chos shes pa dang / kun 'byung la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'i bzod pa dang / kun 'byung la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'o/ /'gog pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / 'gog pa la chos shes pa dang / 'gog pa la chos rjes su rtogs par shes pa'i bzod pa dang / 'gog pa la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'o/ /lam la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / lam la chos shes pa dang / lam la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'i bzod pa dang / lam la rjes su rtogs par shes pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi rnam par bral ba'i lam ni brgyad①/'jug pa bzhi dang / 'bras bu la gnas pa bzhi'o/ /'jug pa bzhi ni/rgyun du zhugs pa la ②'jug pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba la 'jug pa dang /phyir mi 'ong ba la 'jug pa ①dang / dgra bcom pa la 'jug pa'o/ /'bras bu la dhiganas pa bzhi ni/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang /phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa'o/ /rgyun du zhugs pa ni gnyis te/116—780

rim gyis pa dang / cig car nges par 'byung ba'o①/ /rim gyis pa ni/ ji skad bstan pa yin no/ /cig car nges par 'byung ba ni/ gang bden pa rnams mngon par rtogs par byas nas/ mi spyogs pa ②la brten te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis ④khams gsum na spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams ④cig car sgong ste/ 'di ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu nyid la gnas so/ /rang sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ bse ru ltar gcig tu gnas pa dang / tshogs dang spyod pa'o/ /de ni nyan thos kyi ⑤sde snod la dmigs nas chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos grub pas sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa'i 'jig rten rmi khams su sdug bsngal mthar phyin dupa'o/ /'jig rten gyi lam ni brgyad de/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'o| /snyoms ⑦par 'jug pa bzhi ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang /'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi ⑧skye mched do/ /bsam gtan dang po la yan lag lnga ste/ rtog pa dang / dpyod pa dang / dga' ba dang / bde ba dang / sems rtse gcig pa nyid do/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la yan lag bzhi ste/ nang rab tu dang ba dang / dga' ba dang / bde ba dang /sems rtse gcig pa nyid do/ /gsum pa la yan lag lnga ste/ btang snyoms dang /dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang / bde ba dang / sems rtse gcig pa nyid do/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yan lag bzhi ste/ btang snyoms yongs su dag pa dang /dran pa yongs su dag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin 116—781

pa'i tshor ba dang / sems rtse gcig pa nyid do/ /yang gnyen po'i yan lag dang / phan yon gyi yan lag dang / de gnyi ka'i gnas kyi rang bzhin gyi yan lag go/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni/ gzugs can gzugs rnams la lta ba dang / nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la lta ba dang / sdug pa'i rnam pa mngon du byas nas gnas pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched ①dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang /ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched dang / 'du shes dang tshor ba dang 'gog pa mngon du byas nas gnas pa'orka/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad ni/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / sngon po dang / sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa dang /bzang po dang / ngan pa'o/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni/ mi rtog pa dang / dga' ba dang / bde ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /zad par kyi skye mched bcu ni/ zad par dkar po'i skye mched dang / zad par dmar po'i skye mched dang / zad par ser po'i skye mched dang / zad par sngon po'i skye mched dang / zad par sa'i skye mched dang / zad par chu'i skye mched dang /zad par me'i skye mched dang / zad par rlung gi skye mched dang /zad par nam mkha'i skye mched dang / zad par rnam par shes pa'i skye mched do//sems can gyi khams gsum ni/ 'dod khams dang ②/ gzugs khams dang ④/116—782

gzugs med pa'o/ /'dod pa'i khams na sems can gyi ris nyi shu gnas te/tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad①/ grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad do/ /nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba ni/ gcig gam gnyis sam dang ②po rang rang gi rgyu las grub pa'oske/ /dud 'gro na ①chu dang tha dudad nam mkha'i spyod yul lo/ /yi dwags rnams ni chos kyi rgyal po gshin ⑤rje'i pho brang na'o/ / mi'i gling rjobazhi ni/ ba lang spyod/ sgra mi snyan/ lus 'phags po/ 'dzam bu gling ngo ⑦/ /lha'i ris drug ni/ rgyal chen ris bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /gzugs khams bcu bdun ni/ tshangs pa dang / tshangs chen dang / tshangs pa mdun na 'don no/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa la/ 'od chung ④/ 'od gsalaske/ tshad med 'od do/ /bsam gtan gsum pa la ni/ dge chung dang /dge rgyas dang / tshad med dge'o/ /bzhi pa la/ sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che'o/ /gnas gtsang ma'i lha lnga ni/ mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / 'og min rnams so—/ /gzugs med pa'i lha'i ⑨ris bzhi ni/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min ⑩skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs chung ngu ā tsār+ya ⑪dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //116—783

〈〈snar 〉skoradul ba'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/779 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rjod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smad du 'byung / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉phab pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sdom/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉stongs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi la/⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsdam/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/78༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 de/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi ni/781 ①〈〈snar 〉〉zar nges pa 'byin pa'o/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉 med pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉sprongs pa/〈〈snar 〉〉thong pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉skorabyin/ 〈〈snar 〉skoraphyin/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉stom/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wagyi/782 ①〈〈snar 〉〉skyen chad/ ②⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi dang /783 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 dang / ②〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉stabang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stani/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉thang ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gin/ rjo〈〈snar 〉stabang glang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉to/ngo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉khodang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsar+ya/bsdur 'bras ze'i1 migasna tshogs/ (59)116wa 785

3609༄ga /pho zang stong thang lhan dkar gyi chos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bzhugs/①༄4/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum la sogs te/ bod kyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang dkar chag bris shig ces bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi mdun khyes nas/ 'brug gi lo la pho brang lhan ①dkar na bzhugs pa'i ston—/ sgra bsgyur thugyi ban+de dpal brtsegs ⑤dang / ban+de klu'i dbang po la sogs pas dam pa'i chos theg pa che chung gi mdo sde dang / gzungs che phra dang /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dang / bstod pa dang / smon lam dang / bkra shis dang / 'dul ba'i sde snod dang / mdo sde'i ṭī kā budang / dbu ma'i bstan bcos dang / bsam gtan gyi yi ge dang / rnam par shes pa'i bstan bcos dang / tar ka'i gzhung la sogs pa bod khams su chos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang bam po dang sh+lau ka'i grangs su ④mchis pa gtan la phab nas yi ger 116—786

bris pa/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/sgo ka 'bum/ bam po sum brgya/ 'phags pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ sh+lau ka nyi khri lnga stong / bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa khri brgyad stong pa sh+lau ka khri brgyad stong / bam po drug cu/ /'phags pa khri pa/sgo ka khri/ bam po sum cu rtsa gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa/ sgo ka brgyad stong / bam po nyi shu rtsa drug ①dang / sh+lau ka brgya/'phags pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa/ sgo ka nyis stong chig brgya drug cu ste/ bam po bdun dang / sgo ka drug cu/ 'phags pa bdun brgya pa/sgo ka bdun brgya ste/ bam po gnyis dang / sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa lnga brgya pa / sh+lau ka lnga brgya ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa rdo rje gcod pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /'phags pa sdud ④pa tshigs su bcad pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /'phags pa tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa lnga bcu pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/'phags pa kau shi ka /sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa gcig /'phags pa shes rab snying po sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'phags pa sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa lnga/'phags pa yi ge nyung ngu / sh+lau ka sum cu tham pa'osne// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa la/'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde sangs rgyas phal po che/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga yan chad la/ sh+lau ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu ste/ bam po brgya sum cu dang /sh+lau ka sum cu yod pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'ur gtogs pa 116—787

la—/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong nyis brgya ste/ bam po bcu bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/ sh+lau ka sum stong dgu brgya ste bam po bcu gsum/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu bstan pa/sh+lau ka nyis stong bzhi brgya ste/ bam po brgyad/ 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong brgyad brgya ste/ bam po bcu drug /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba ①bstan pa/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u/ sgo ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig /'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdo/ sh+lau ka dgu stong ste bam po sum cu tham pa// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgya pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yan chad las/ 'phags pa sdom pa gsum bstan pa/ sgo ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum / 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba/ sgo ka stong nyis brgya ste/ bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong lnga brgya ste/ bam po bcu gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa rmi lam bstan pa/ sh+lau ka stong ste bam po gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ 'phags pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod pa/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu ste bam po lnga dang / sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa go cha bkod pa/ sgo ka stong brgyad brgya ste/ bam po drug /'phags pa chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis ④dbyer med par bstan pa/ sgo ka drug brgya lnga bcu 116—788

ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa chos bcu pa/ khro ka lnga brgya ste bam po gcig dang sgo ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya drug cu/ 'phags pa 'od zer bsgrub pa/ sgo ka stong ①lnga brgya ste/bam po lnga/ 'phags pa byang chub sems pa'i sde snod/ sh+lau ka drug stong ste/bam po nyi shu/ 'phags pa mngal na gnas pa bstan pa/ sho ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa/sgo ka stong chig brgya bzhi bcu ste bam po gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu/'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste/ bam po bco lnga / 'phags pa gang pos zhus pa/ sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug /'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka stong ste bam po gsum dang /sgo ka brgya/ 'phags pa khyem bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa/ sgo ka bdun brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa glog ②sbyin gyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya sum cu ste bam po gcig dang / sh+lau ka brgya sum cu/ 'phags pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ 'phags pa byams pa seng ge'i sgra/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa 'dul ba rnam par ⑦gtan la dbab pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa lag bzangs kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya rtsa brgyad de bam po gnyis dang / sgo ka brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'phags pa des 116—789

pas zhus pa/ sh+lau ka sum ①brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa khyem bdag dpas ④byin gyis zhus pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa/ sgo ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa/ h+pho ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa mya ngan med kyis byin pas zhus pa/sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa/sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa yon tan rin chen me tog kun du rgyas pas zhus pa/ sgo ka brgya bzhi bcu/'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa/ sgo ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa seng ges zhus pa/ sgo ka drug cu/'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la snemakhas pa/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ༷bcu gsum ste/ bam po bzhi dang sgo ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/'phags pa bu mo dad ldan gyis zhus pa/ sgo ka brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya rtsa bcu ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka bcu/'phags pa byams pas zhus pa'i chos brgyad pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa 'od srungs kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsumaske/ 'phags pa rin po che'i phung po/ sh+lau ka drug brgya bdun cu ste/bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa/sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya 116—790

ste bam po gsum/ 'phags pa lha mo dpal phreng ①seng ge'i sgra/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs la/ bam po nyi shu rtsa drug man chad nas/bam po bcu gcig pa yan chad la/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po/ sh+lau ka bdun stong brgyad brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa drug /'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo/ sgo ka bdun stong lnga brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga/'phags pa rgya cher rol pa/ sh+lau ka lnga stong bzhi brgya ste/ bam po bco brgyad/'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa/ sgo ka lnga stong bzhi brgya ste/bam po bco brgyad/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po/ sgo ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/'phags pa snying rje pad+ma dkar po/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/'phags pa dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po/ sgo ka sum stong dgu brgya ste bam po bcu gsum/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po/ sh+lau ka sum stong dgu brgya ste bam po bcu gsum/ 'phags pa 'dus pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po/ sh+lau ka sum stong dgu brgya ste/ bam po bcu gsum/ 'phags pa sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa/ sgo ka sum stong dgu brgya ste/ bam po bcu gsum| 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa/ sgo ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig /'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa/sh+lau ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig/ //bam po bcu man chad la/ 'phags pa sprin chen po/ sh+lau ka sum ②stong 116—791

ste bam po bcu/ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo/ sh+lau ka nyis ①stong bzhi brgya ste/ bam po brgyad/ 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ bam po brgyad/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin/ bam po brgyad/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ bam po brgyad/'phags pa 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs/ sh+lau ka nyis stong bzhi brgya sum byu rtsa gsum ste bam po brgyad dang sgo ka sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'phags ④pa sangs rgyas kyi sde sdod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa/ sgo ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ 'phags po ①blo gros mi zad pas ④bstan pa/ bam po bdun/'phags pa chos yang dag par sdud ⑤pa/ bam po bdun/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ bam po bdun/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa—/ bam po bdun/ 'phags pa tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa/bam po bdun/ 'phags pa sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa/ bam po bdun/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po bstan pa/ bam po bdun/'phags pa da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/bam po bdun/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po'i rjopad+ma dkar po/ sgo ka stong brgyad brgya ste/ bam po drug /'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ bam po drug /'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas ⑦bstan pa/ bam po drug /'phags pa pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bstan pa/ bam po drug /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ bam po drug /'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyi nying nge 'dzin/ bam po drug /'phags pa lha mo dri ma 116—792

med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa/ bam po drug /'phags pa dad pa'i stobs skyed ①pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya bdun cu ste bam po lnga dang / sgo ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'khrul dze+epa bstan pa/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ 'phags pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa/ bam po lnga/ 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ bam po lnga/ 'phags pa rnga bo che'i mdo/ bam po lnga/'phags pa rin po che chen po'i mdo/ bam po lnga/ 'phags pa za ma tog bkod pa/ sh+lau ka stong sum brgya drug cu rtsa lnga ste bam po bzhi dang / sgo ka brgya drug cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ste bam po bzhi dang sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag /sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu ste/ bam po bzhi dang sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya nyi shu ste bam po bzhi dang sh+lau ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa/ sgo ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa dkon mchog za ma tog bam po bzhi/'phags pa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa/ bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa rgyan stug po bkod pa/ bam po bzhi④/ 'phags pa bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod/bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan/ sgo ka dgu brgya lnga bcu ste/ bam po gsum dang sgo ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i 116—793

yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya nyi shu ste bam po gsum dang sgo ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ①ting nge 'dzin/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya rtsa bcu ste bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bgro ba/ sgo ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u/ bam po gsum/'phags pa me tog gi tshogs/ bam po gsum/ 'phags pa khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ bam po gsum/ 'phags pa lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa/bam po gsum/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa/bam po gsum/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig /bam po gsum/ 'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo/ bam po gsum/ 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rnam par rtse ba'i le'u④/ 1 ka brgyad brgya nyi shu ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka nyis brgya nyi shu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/ sh+lau ka drug brgya drug cu ste/ bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka drug cu/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu bsgom pa/blo ka drug brgya bcu dgu ste/ bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka bcu dgu/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa/ h+pho ka drug brgya rtsa bcu ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka bcu/ 'phags pa byams pa 'jug pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/'phags pa kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa/ bam po gnyis/'phags pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa bu mo zla 116—794

mchog lung bstan pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa/bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyi rlabs ①sems can la gzigs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun du ston pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi sgon ②lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa/bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/sgoka lnga ①brgya bdun cu ④ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya bdun cu/'phags pa dpal dbyangs kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka lnga brgya ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste bam po gcig dang sgo ka brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya ⑤lnga bcu/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya dgu bcu rtsa bzhi sterjo/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa bzhi⑦/'phags pa chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa glang po'i rtsal ⑧gyi mdo/ sgo ka sum brgya drug cu ste/bam po gcig dang sgo ka drug cu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba/bam po gcig dang sgo ka drug cu/ 'phags pa rnam par 'thag pa thams cad sdud ⑨pa/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu/ 'phags pa rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu/ 'phags pa dpal sbas kyi 116—795

mdo| bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul gyi yul la rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya lnga bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya bzhi bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ sh+lau ka sum brgya rtsa bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ bam po gcig dang sgo ka bcu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /'phags pa tshangs pas byen gyis zhus pa/ bam po gcig /'phags pa chos kyi tshul ①nges pa dang ma nges par 'grol ②ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa/ bam po gcig /'phags pa 'dul ba rnam par gdon mi za ba/ bam po gcig /'phags pa mar me 'bul ba/bam po gcig /'phags pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa/ bam po gcig /'phags pa chos kyi tshul/ bam po gcig /'phags pa ye shes rgyas pa/bam po gcig /'phags pa thabs la mkhas pa/ bam po gcig /'phags pa sprin chen po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u bam po gcig /bam por ma longs pa la④/ 'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba/ sgo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ④bstan pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa drug /'phags pa bzhi pa bsgrub pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya drug cu/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub ⑤pa'i gzungs/ sgo ka nyis brgya drug cu/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa/ sgo ka nyis brgya sum cu/'phags pa sā lu ljang pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa drug /'phags pa byang 116—796

chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyi shu/ 'phags pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya bcu/ 'phags pa rin po che'i mtha'—/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya bcu/ 'phags pa khye'u rin chen zla bas ①zhus pa/sh+lau ka nyis brgya rtsa drug① /'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya/'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu / sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa tshangs pas zhus pa/ sh+lau ka nyis ①brgya/ 'phags pa ga ya mgo'i duri/ sh+lau ka brgya brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa/ sgo ka brgya drug cu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngo ba la mkhas pa/ sh+lau ka brgya drug cu/ 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu⑤/ 'phags pa chos kyi phung po/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcudu/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gnas pa/ sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu ⑦/ 'phags pa bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ sh+lau ka brgya sum cu/'phags pa rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i gzungs sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig /'phags pa sangs rgyas mi spangs pa④/ sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu/ 'phags pa dpal dbyeg gis ⑨zhus pa/ sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bco lnga/ 'phags pa bgres mos zhus pa sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bco lnga/ 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su mthun par 'jug pa sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bcu gcig /'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa sh+lau ka brgya rtsa lnga/ sh+lau ka brgya man chad la/ 'phags pa yi ge med pa'i za ma tog ⑪ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/116—797

'phags pa don brgya ①pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sgo ka brgya/ 'phags pa don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi chos kyi rnam grangs/ sgo ka brgya/ 'phags pa don dang chos rnam par 'byed pa/ sgo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa/ sgo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa/sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa gcig /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka dgu bcu—/ 'phags pa bram ze mo dpal ldan gyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka dgu bcu/'phags pa chos kyi phyag rgya/ sho ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho/sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa bdud rtsi brjod pa/ 1 ka brgyad cu/'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa bde ②byed kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po/ sgo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa/ sgo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa/ sgo ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa srid pa 'pho ba sh+lau ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa/ zla ka bdun cu/'phags pa sgra chen po/ sgo ka drug cu rtsa bzhi/ 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa/sgo ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig /'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa gcig /'phags pa tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa/ blo ka bzhi bcu/'phags pa kun du rgyu sen rings kyis zhus pa/ sgo ka sum cu rtsa bdun/'phags pa sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/ 'phags pa 116—798

byams pas zhus pa chung ngu / blo ka ①'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa/sh+lau ka phyed ②dang bco lnga/ 'phags pa rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba bstan ①pa/sgo ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa/ sgo ka bcu gsum/'phags pa rgyal ba'i dublo gros kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka bcu gcig /'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu / sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa/sgo ka bcu/ 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa/ khro ka bcu// //mdo chen por gtogs pa la/ mdo chen po kun du rgyu dang kun du rgyu ma yin pa dang mthun pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya lnga bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sgo ka lnga bcu/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba/ sh+lau ka sum brgya bzhi bcu ste/bam po gcig dang khro ka bzhi bcu/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /mdo chen po lnga gsum ⑤pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya nyi shu/mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po/ sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsdu ༷ba/ sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid/ sgo ka dgu bcu/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog /sgo ka brgyad cu/mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa/ sgo ka bzhi bcu// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rgya las bsgyur ba la/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po/ sgo ka khri nyis stong drug brgya ste bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis| 'phags pa mdzangs ⑦blun gyi mdo/ sgo ka sum stong dgu brgya ste/bam po bcu ⑧gsum/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba mdo sde'i ⑨rgyal po/ sgo ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa rin po che'i le'u sh+lau ka nyis stong bzhi brgya ste bam po brgyad/116—799

'phags pa thabs la mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi drin la lan gyis blan pa'i chos kyi yi ge /sgo ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi yi ge /sgo ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug /'phags pa sangs rgyas mdzod/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po/ bam po lnga/ 'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/ bam po lnga/ 'phags pa thar pa chen po'i ①phyogs su rgyas pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya rtsa bcu ④gnyis te/ bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bcu gnyis/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i ①chos bzhi bsgrub pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya ste/ bam po gnyis dang sgo ka brgya/'phags pa gtsug tor ④chen po las bdud kyi le'u bstan pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ tshangs pa'i dra ba/ bam po gnyis/⑤ chos kyi rgya mo/bam po gnyis/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo/ bam po gnyis/ pha ma'i drin lan bstan pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo—/ bam po gcig /sems can gyi skye shi'i rtsa ba bstan pa bam po gcigadu/'phags pa byams pa ⑦lung bstan pa/ sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bcu/ dge bcu dang du blang ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka brgya/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo nyid las mi g.yo bar snang ba bstan pa/ sh+lau ka dgu bcu/ yang dag pa'i legs pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ rgyal bu kun du dge ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo/ sh+lau ka bcu// //theg pa chung ngu'i mdo sde la/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ sgo ka khri nyis stong dgu brgya ste bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum yan chad 116—800

'gyur| 'phags pa las brgya tham pa sh+lau ka khri chig stong chig brgya ste/ bam po sum cu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/sgo ka drug stong drug brgya ste/ bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gcig las 'phros pa'i lung / sgo ka lnga stong bzhi brgya ste/ bam po bco brgyad/ 'jig rten gzhag ①pa / sh+lau ka nyis stong chig brgya ste/ bam po bdun/ rgyu gdags pa/ bam po bdun/ las gdags pa sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste/ bam po lnga/ bzang sbyin gyi ②mdo/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/ rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo/bam po gnyis/ las rnam par 'byed pa chung ngu / bam po gcig /ri glang ri lung bstan pa/ bam po gcig /las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba bstan pa'i gzhung / sgo ka nyis brgya bdun cu/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa| sh+lau ka nyis brgya rtsa bcu/ tshe'i mtha'i mdo/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya rtsa lnga/skyes bu dam pa'i mdo/ sgo ka nyis brgya/ khams mang po'i mdo/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya / dga' ba can gyi mdo/ sgo ka nyis brgya/ gang zag gi mdo/ sh+lau ka brgya/ phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ gsal rgyal gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/ sh+lau ka drug cu/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ khyim bdag 'du shes kyi mdo/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ lha'i mdo/ sgo ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka sum cu/gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo/ sgo ka sum cu/ gnas 'jog gi mdo/sh+lau ka nyi shu/ gzhon nu dpe'i mdo/ sgo ka nyi shu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 116—801

gzugs brnyan gzhag ①pa'i phan yon/ sh+lau ka nyi shu/ gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba bstan pa/ sgo ka bcu bdun/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu / sh+lau ka bcu bdun/sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo/ sgo ka bco lnga/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ sgo ka bco lnga/ chos bzhi bstan pa/ sgo ka bcu gsum/ chos bzhi'i mdo/ sh+lau ka bcu gsum/② gaṇ+ḍi'i ④mdo/ sh+lau ka bcu/ zla ba'i mdo/ sh+lau ka bcu// //bstan bcos la ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ gnas brtan spyan drangs pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyis lung bstan pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sgo ka brgya/ sbyin pa'i rabs/ sgo ka brgya| dkyil 'khor dbul ba'i phan yon bstan pa/ sh+lau ka bco lnga/ de'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka bcu// //gsang sngags kyi rgyud la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog ④pa chen po/ sh+lau ka bdun stong brgyad brgya ste/ bam po nyi shu rtsa drug yan chad 'gyur—/ 'phags pa rig pa mchog /sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/'phags pa phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis/ rgyud kun las btus pa/ bam po bcu gnyis/'phags pa legs par grub pa/ sh+lau ka nyis stong chig brgya ste/ bam po bdun/'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa/ sgo ka stong dgu brgya lnga bcu ste bam po drug dang blo ka brgya lnga bcu/ de'i bsdus 'grel ⑤slob dpon budha gup+tas mdzad pa/ sgo ka nyis stong sum brgya ste bam po bdun dang / sh+lau 116—802

ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa/ sgo ka bdun brgya ste/ bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya/de'i 'grel pa slob dpon burta gup+tas mdzad pa sgo ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/'phags pa dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gcig dang sgo ka lnga bcu/ de'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/'phags pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rim par phye ba/ sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bcu/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon burtse gup+tas mdzad pa/ sgo ka dgu brgya ste/ bam po gsum| gzungs chen po lnga la/ 'phags pa rma bya chen mo sgo ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa/sgo ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo/ sgo ka bzhi brgya bzhi ①bcu ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu/'phags pa bsil ②ba'i tshal chen mo/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya brgyad cu/ 'phags pa gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa/ sgo ka brgya rtsa snebazhi bcu // //④gzungs che phra sna tshogs la/ 'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i khang pa brtsegs pa/ sgo ka bdun brgya ste/ bam po gnyis dang / sgo ka brgya/'phags pa nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu gnas pa dam pa'i cho ga ⑤zhib mo rgyal po'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa rdo rje mchu'i rjogazungs/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying po'i gzungs| sgo ka sum brgya nyi shu ste bam po gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyi shu/'phags pa snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs bam po gcig /'phags pa sprin chen po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ bam po gcig /'phags pa 116—803

kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa byang chub snying po rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs/sgo ka nyis brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa stobs po che'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor los ①sgyur ba'i gzungs—/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa me kha la'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka nyis ①brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can/ sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgron ma mchog /sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po/ sh+lau ka brgya sum cu / 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba/ sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ sgo ka brgya nyi shu/'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ sgo ka brgya rtsa bcu/ 'phags pa sgo bzang po/ sh+lau ka brgya rtsa bcu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los ①sgyur ba'i gzungs/ sgo ka brgya rtsa brgyad④/'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ sgo ka brgya/ 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu rtsa dgu/ 'phags pa dri ma med pa'i gzungs/ sgo ka brgyad cu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs/sh+lau ka brgyad cu rtsa drug /'phags pa rgyal ba can/ sgo ka brgyad cu rtsa gcig /'phags pa khyad par can/ sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa rdo rje mi pham pa ⑤me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ sh+lau ka bdun cu/ 'phags pa gza' rnams kyi yum—/ rjosh+lau ka drug byu/ 'phags pa gzungs chen mo⑦/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa 116—804

bdun—/ 'phags pa me tog brtsegs pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po/ sgo ka lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ khro ka lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ 'phags pa kun du bzang po/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu rtsa phyed dang gsum/ 'phags pa snying rje mchog /sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa gser can/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi rig sngags/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ 'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags/sgo ka bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa be con chen po/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi/'phags pa lus kyi dbyebs mjos pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu rtsa gsum/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs ①kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel dze+egyi za ma tog /sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i cho ga zhib mo/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'od/sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa bdud rtsi thab ①sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa dgu/ 'phags pa tsan+dan gyi yan lag /sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa dgu/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po| sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa brgyad/ 'phags pa sa'i dbang po/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa phyed dang brgyad/ 'phags pa phyir bzlog pa rnam par rgyal ba can/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa dbyig dudang ldan pa/ sgo ka sum cu ⑤rtsa bdun/'phags pa gzhan byis mi thub pa rin po che'i phring rjob/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa lnga/116—805

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi yum/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa drug /'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ sgo ka sum cu rtsa lnga/'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ sgo ka sum cu rtsa lnga/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu ①rtsa bzhi/ 'phags pa dbang bskur ba/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa gsum ②/ 'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba/ sgo ka sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa ha ya shrī ba'i gzungs/ h+pho ka sum cu/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i snying po/ sgo ka nyi shu rtsa gsum/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi snying po/sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa gzhang 'brum zhi bar byed pa/ sgo ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa 'od zer can/ sgo ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'phags pa dug sel gyi rig sngags/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa phyed dang gnyis/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gcig /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i ming brgyad po/ gsang sngags kyis yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa ④/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gcig /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ sgo ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i snying po/ sgo ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa ye shes ta la la/ sh+lau ka nyi shu/'phags pa par+ṇa sha ba ri/ sh+lau ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa yi dwags kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /sh+lau ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ sh+lau ka bcu dgu/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa/ sh+lau ka bco 116—806

brgyad—/ 'phags pa mdangs phyir 'phrog ①pa/ sh+lau ka bcu bdun/'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i ②snying po/ sh+lau ka bcu drug /'phags pa mchod pa'i sprin/ sgo ka bcu drug /'phags pa las kyi sgrib ④thams cad rnam par ④sbyong ba/ sgo ka bco lnga/ 'phags pa yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa/ sgo ka bco lnga/ 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa/ sh+lau ka bco lnga/ 'phags pa nor bu bzang po'i snying po blo ka bco lnga/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen po/ /sh+lau ka bcu bzhi/ 'phags pa phyir bzlog pa stobs can/ sgo ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu ⑤zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa bu mang po bton rjopa/ sh+lau ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/sh+lau ka bcu gsum/ 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/sh+lau ka bcu gnyis/ 'phags pa dpal chen po'i ⑦mdo/ sgo ka bcu gcig /'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i mdo/ sgo ka bcu/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgol ba/ sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa nor bu bzang po'i snying po/ sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs/ sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka bcu/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba/sgo ka dgu/ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ sgo ka brgyad—/ 'phags pa dpal chen mo'i byaming bcu gnyis pa/ sgo ka brgyad/'phags pa stong 'gyur gyi gzungs/ sgo ka bdun/ 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs/ sh+lau ka byed dang bdun/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi ⑨blo 'phel 116—807

ba'i gzungs/ sgo ka lnga // //①mtshan rgya rtsa brgyad la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgyad dang bcas pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ phan yon dang bcas pa②/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /'phags pa lha mo sgol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa 'jam sdedapal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa④/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgo ka sum cu/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑤mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa lha mo nor gyi rgyun ma'i ༷mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu // //⑦bstod pa sna tshogs la/ slob dpon klu sgrub ⑧kyis mdzad pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ dpe med par bstod pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gnyis/bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ sgo ka bco brgyad/ don dam par bstod pa/ sh+lau ka bcu/ sku gsum la bstod pa/ sh+lau ka dgu/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod pa'i tshig gi sdeb sbyor slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon tan mu med par bstod pa/ slob dpon rat+na ḍa pas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka 116—808

bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa lha mo sgrol ma 'jigs pa thams cad las sgol bar ①bstod pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras ②mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags ①par 'os pas ④bsngags pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i gnas su bstod pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa la sgobs pa skyes pa/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag na rdo rje 'dzin rnams kyis ⑤bstod pa/ sh+lau ka drug cu/'phags pa srun ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag na rdo rje 'dzin rnams kyis bstod pa/ sgo ka nyi shu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la snying rje'i bstod pa/ sgo ka bco lnga/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin la bstod pa/rgyal po shi wi kra ma a dīr+yas rjomadzad pa/ sgo ka sum cu/ nad kyi bdag mo la bstod pa bram ze mchog sred kyis byas pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/ lha mo nam gru la bstod ⑦pa/ sgo ka bco lnga // //⑧smon lam sna tshogs la/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po sngags dang bcas pa/ sh+lau ka lnga brgya ste/ bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya/'phags pa nor ⑨bu rin po che dge ba brtan spyopa yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po/sh+lau ka brgya sum cu/ 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ sgo ka bzhi bcu/ 'phags pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba—/ sgo ka brgya sum cu⑩/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam⑫/ sgo ka sum 116—809

cu—/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa smon lam bdun byu pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu rtsa gsum/mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gsum/ rin po che phreng ba'i smon lam/ sgo ka bco brgyad/ byang chub dam pa'i smon lam/ sh+lau ka phyed ①dang bcu bzhi/ byang chub dam pa'i rjes su mos pa'i smon lam/ sgo ka bcu tham pa// //bkra shis kyi rnam grangs la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa chen po sgo ka sum cu/ shis par ②brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sgo ka lnga bcu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa drug /bkra shis su bya'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka bcu bdun/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ blo ka sum cu rtsa phyed dang lnga/ yang bde legs su bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sh+lau ka bcu gnyis/yang bde legs su gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sgo ka dgu// //'dul ba'i sde snod la/ 'dul ba lung gzhi/ sgo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya ste bam po brgya rtsa dgu/ 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya ste/ bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong drug brgya ste bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/'dul ba gzhung bla ma/ sh+lau ka khri drug stong nyis brgya ste bam po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/'dul ba zhus lan/ sgo ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig yan chad 'gyur / dge slong ma'i 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ sh+lau ka bdun stong bzhi brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa ④bzhi dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ dge slong pha'i so sor ④thar pa'i lam⑤/ sgo ka bdun brgya ste/ bam po dhiganyis dang / sgo ka brgya/116—810

dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i mdo/ blo ka brgyad brgya ste/ bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ 'dul ba mdo/ sh+lau ka nyis stong bdun brgya ste bam po dgu/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa/ sgo ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis| 'dul ba bsdus pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/'dul ba gzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig /'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig gi bshad pa/ sgo ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste ①bam po bco lnga/ 'dul ba phran tshegs 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/ 'dul ba gzhung bla ma'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sgo ka drug stong ste ④bam po nyi shu/ so sor ④thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa chen po/ sh+lau ka sum khri sum stong drug brgya ste bam po brgya rtsa bcu gnyis/ so sor ④thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'dul ba kun las btus pa/ sh+lau ka khri lnga stong ste/ bam po lnga bcu| so sor thar pa'i gzhung 'grel/ sgo ka brgyad stong chig brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun/ yang so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ so sor thar pa'i chag ⑤gi brjed byang / sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa/ blo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'dul ba'i bumado'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sgo ka nyi khri chig stong ste bam po bdun cu // //dze+ethams cad yod par smra ba dge tshul byi tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /sum brgya pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'od ldan/ sgo ka nyis stong bzhi brgya ste bam po brgyad/'dul ba dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ 'dul ba dri ba'i tshig gi 116—811

rgya cher bshad pa/ sh+lau ka stong drug brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi ste bam po lnga dang blo ka brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi ming dang rim pa/ slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka drug cu rtsa lnga/ gzhung tha dad pa bklag ①pa'i 'khor lo las sde pa ②tha dad pa bstan pa/ slob dpon dbyeg ba shes kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ dge slong gi tshul/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa—/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ ma byin par len pa'i skabs na/ mkhan po bzhis dpyad pa sh+lau ka nyi shu// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i tī ④kā la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum gyi 'grel pa chen po/ sgo ka nyi khri sum dustong bzhi brgya ste bam po bdun cu rtsa brgyad/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum dang nyi khri lnga stong dang /khri brgyad stong pa'i ⑤rgya cher bshad pa sgo ka brgyad stong chig brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i rgya cher bshad pa/mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ sh+lau ka drug brgya duste bam po gnyis/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ 1 ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/'phags pa sdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya ste/bam po drug /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/yang bdun brgya pa'i bshad pa/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ sgo ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug /yang bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa/ khro ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ yang bdun brgya pa'i bshad pa/ slob dpon dz+nyā na mi tras mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i ⑦'grel pa/ slob 116—812

dpon tshwa na mi tras mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ yang tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa gsang sngags kyi tshul du bshad pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa rdo rje gcod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya ste/ bam po lnga/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste/ bam po gnyis/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ sgo ka drug brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka lnga bcu/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i rnam par bshad pa tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ 'phags pa shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/sgo ka sum brgya ste/ bam po gcig /'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i ṭī kā chen po/ sh+lau ka khri brgyad stong ste ①bam po drug cu/ yang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa| sh+lau ka khri nyis ②stong ste bam po bzhi bcu/ yang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i byams pa'i le'u nyi tshe bshad pa/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya bdun cu ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka bdun cu/yang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i bsdus 'grel/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /yang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i bshad pa/ slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ sgo ka nyis brgya nyi shu/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po chos nyid zab mo'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas dze+ebastan pa'i 'grel pa/ h+pho ka drug stong ste bam po nyi shu/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong nyis 116—813

brgya drug cu ste bam po bcu bzhi dang sgo ka drug cu/ sa bcu pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i bshad pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis/ sa bcu pa'i gleng gzhi'i ①bshad pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /sa bcu pa'i don bsdus pa/ sgo ka lnga bcu/ 'phags pa puṇ+ḍa rī ②ka'i don bsdus pa/1 ka brgya/ 'phags pa ga ya mgo ri'i mdo'i rnam par bshad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya sum cu/ 'phags pa ga ya mgo ri'i mdo dang spel mar bshad pa/ sgo ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka brgya/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam par bshad pa/ slob dpon ngang tshul bzang pos mdzad pa/ sgo ka dgu brgya bzhi bcu ste bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/ sangs rgyas kyis ①las tshig gi don bsdus pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'od srungs kyi le'u'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug /'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi 'grel pa/ dre ka nyis stong chig brgya ste/ bam po bdun/ 'phags pa sā lu ljang pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu ste/ bam po gcig dang sgo ka brgya lnga bcu/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo tshigs bcad du bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa / sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub ④pa'i gzungs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka stong sum brgya rtsa bco lnga ste bam po bzhi dang / blo ka brgya rtsa bco lnga/ sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub ⑤pa'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka brgya dgu bcu/'phags pa rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa/116—814

sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug /yang sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi bshad pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa gcig /'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsum la/ sgo ka drug brgya sum cu ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka sum cu/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa| sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa sh+lau ka sum cu/ yang chos bzhi pa'i bshad pa/ sgo ka nyi shu rtsa bzhi| 'phags pa tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka nyis brgya/'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad brgya ste bam po gnyis dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya/yang bzang po ①spyod pa'i bshad sbyar/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/sgo ka lnga brgya ste bam po gcig dang sgo ka nyis brgya/ yang bzang po spyod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu ste bam po phyed dang gnyis/ bzang po spyod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon rgyan bzang pos mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu ste bam po phyed dang gnyis/yang bzang po spyod pa'i 'grel pa rnam pa bzhi ka las btus te brjed byang du babyis pa mkhan po ye shes sdes mdzad pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/dgongs pa bzhi dang / ldem por dgongs pa bzhi bshad pa'i brjed byang /mkhan po ye shes sdes mdzad pa/ sgo ka nyis brgya // //⑧mdo sde'i ṭī kā rgya las bsgyur ba la/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i ṭī kā chen po/ sh+lau ka khri nyis ①stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun cu rtsa bzhi| yang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i ṭī kā④/ sgo ka nyis ⑤stong 116—815

bdun rgya ste ①bam po dgu/ 'phags pa ④puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i 'grel pa rgya las bsgyur ba—/ sh+lau ka drug stong ste bam po nyi shu/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa chen po rgya las bsgyur ba/ sh+lau ka khri nyis ①stong ste bam po bzhi bcu/yang lang kar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka bdun brgya drug cu ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka brgya drug cu/ yang lang kar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa dube+en tar ta li las bsgyur ba/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ 'phags pa rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel ⑤pa/ rgya las bsgyur ba/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/chos kyi rgya mo'i bubashad pa/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi// //dbu ma'i bstan bcos la/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa shes rab ces bya ba/ sgo ka bzhi brgya bzhi bcu rtsa ⑦dgu ste bam po gcig dang / sgo ka brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma/ sh+lau ka drug stong ste bam po nyi shu/ shes rab sgon ma'i rgya cher bshad pa/ slob dpon spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong ste bam po brgyad cu/ yang dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon budha pā li tas mdzad pa—/ khro ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/ yang dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa ga las 'jig ⑧med/ sh+lau ka nyis ⑨stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ dbu ma rgyan gyi ⑩tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ dbu ma rgyan gyi dka' 'grel/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i dka' 'grel/116—816

sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ dbu ma de kho na nyid snang ba/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ dbu ma snang ba/ sh+lau ka nyis ①stong dgu brgya ste bam po dgu/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i rab tu byed ④pa/ sgo ka sum cu/ de kho na la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ h+pho ka nyis brgya/ de kho na nyid la rtsod pa bzlog pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /rtsod ①pa bzlog pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa| sgo ka bdun cu/ rtsod ④pa bzlog pa'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka bzhi brgya ste bam po gcig dang / sh+lau ka brgya/ rigs ⑤pa drug cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/sh+lau ka drug cu rtsa gnyis/ rigs rjopa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya drug cu ⑦ste bam po gnyis dang / sgo ka brgya drug cu/ stong pa nyid bdun cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sgo ka bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ stong pa nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa/ ⑧sgo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu/ stong pa nyid kyi sgo bcu gnyis pa rtsa ba dang 'grel par bcas pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / de'i rnam par bshad pa/ sgo ka lnga bcu rtsa bzhi⑨/ lag pa'i tshad kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/sgo ka lnga/ lag pa'i tshad kyi 'grel pa sgo ka lnga/ lag pa'i tshad kyi 'grel pa/sgo ka nyi shu/ yang lag pa'i chad kyi ⑩'grel pa/ sgo ka bdun cu/ byang chub sems kyi rnam par bshad pa/ sgo ka nyis brgya/ dbu ma'i snying po mdor bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa/ sgo ka brgyad cu/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par grub pa/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ 1 ka lnga brgya ste bam po gcig dang / 1 ka nyis brgya/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/sgo ka brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug /sku gsum la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka bdun 116—817

brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu// //bsam gtan byi yi ge la/ bsgom ①pa'i rim pa rnam pa gsum slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad②/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ bsgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon badz+ra tīrtis mdzad pa/ bam po gcig /yang bsgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ bam po gcig /byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i 'od kyis mdzad pa/ sgo ka brgya/ yang byang chub kyi sdesems bsgom pa/ slob dpon maspru shrī ④mi tras mdzad pa/ sgo ka drug cu rtsa brgyad/ bsgom pa'i sgo bstan pa/ slob dpon ka la ya sden warmas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka drug cu rtsa bdun/ bsgom pa'i rim pa/ slob dpon dharma rjom tis mdzad pa sh+lau ka sum cu/ bsam gtan gyi yi ge rgya las bsgyur ba/ slob dpon bo dhi dharma ⑦ta ras mdzad pa/ sgo ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum// //rnam par shes pa'i bstan bcos la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las/sa mang po ba sh+lau ka bdun stong brgyad brgya ste bam po nyi shu rtsa drug /gzhi bsdu ba—/ sh+lau ka lnga stong bdun brgya dgu bcu ste bam po bcu dgu dang sh+lau ka dgu bcu/rnam grangs bsdu ba/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ nyan thos kyi sa/ sh+lau ka lnga stong bzhi brgya ste bam po bco brgyadaske/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ sgo ka drug stong chig brgya lnga bcu ste bam po nyi shu dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba sgo ka lnga ⑧bcu ste bam po gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu/ rnam par ⑨gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba/ sh+lau ka khri chig stong lnga brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga ste bam po sum cu rtsa brgyad dang / sgo ka brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sa mang po'i rgya cher bshad pa/ sgo 116—818

ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i 'grel pa| slob dpon rgya mtsho sprin gyis mdzad pa/ sgo ka drug stong ste bam po nyi shu/rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa ①le'u nyi tshe bshad pa ①logs su phyung ba/ sgo ka sum brgya drug cu rtsa lnga ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu rtsa lnga/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u nyi tshe bshad pa logs su phyung ba/ sgo ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ de'i rgya cher bshad pa sgo ka stong lnga brgya ①ste bam po lnga/ 'dul ba bsdus pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/theg pa chen po bsdus pa/ sh+lau ka stong chig brgya bdun cu ste bam po gsum dang sh+lau ka nyis brgya bdun cu/ theg pa chen po bsdus pa'i bshad sbyar/ sh+lau ka sum stong sum cu ste bam po bcu dang sh+lau ka sum cu/ don gsang ba bsdus pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong nyis brgya ste bam po bcu bzhi/ chos mngon pa kun las btus pa/sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po drug /de'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig /mdo sde rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ mdo sde rgyan gyi bshad pa/ sgo ka sum stong nyis brgya bdun cu ste bam po bcu dang / sgo ka nyis brgya bdun cu/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad/ sgo ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu/ de'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya bzhi bcu ste bam po gnyis dang sh+lau ka bzhi bcu/de'i 'grel bshad/ sgo ka sum stong lnga brgya ste bam po bcu gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa'i ④sh+lau ka brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis/phung po lnga'i rnam par bshad pa/ sgo ka stong lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste bam po 116—819

lnga dang / sgo ka sum stong ①lnga bcu rtsa gcig /phung po lnga'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang /sh+lau ka brgya/ phung po lnga'i bshad pa/ slong dpon sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa/sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ phung po lnga'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka stong nyis ①brgya ste bam po bzhi/ sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/ sum cu pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang / sh+lau ka brgya/sum cu pa'i 'grel bshad/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste bam po lnga dang sgo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga/ nyi shu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu/ nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka brgya sum cu/ nyi shu pa'i 'grel bshad/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu ste bam po phyed dang gsum/ rnam par bshad pa'i rigs pa/ sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya ste bam po bcu/ rnam par bshad pa'i rigs pa'i ①'grel pa slob dpon yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/ las bsgrub pa la ④rab tu byed pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig/de'i 'grel pa/ sgo ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ rten cing 'grel ⑤par 'byung ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ bam po bzhi/ de'i 'grel pa/ sh+lau ka sum stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu gcig/ //theg pa chen po'i bstan bcos sna tshogs la/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong nyis brgya ste bam po bcu bzhi/skyes pa rjorabs kyi rgyud/ sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis/mdo sde sna tshogs kyi mdo bsdus ⑦pa/ sgo ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/116—820

mdo kun las btus pa/ blo ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ rin po che'i phreng ba/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ de'i 'grel pa sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya ste bam po bzhi/ pha rol tu phyin pa btus pa/ sh+lau ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis| tshigs su bcad pa'i don btus pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum| sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/sh+lau ka brgya/ shes rab brgya pa'i rab tu byed pa/ sgo ka brgya/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ khro ka bzhi bcu rtsa bdun/ de ①bshad pa/ khro ka nyis brgya/grogs po'i spring yig /sh+lau ka brgya/ de'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon blo gros chen pos mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ste bam po bzhi dang / sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ slob ma la spring ba'i spring yig slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ de'i dka' 'grel slob dpon bai ro tsa na rakhri tas mdzad pa/sh+lau ka brgya/ rgyal po ka ni ka la spring ba'i sdespring yig slob dpon ma ti tsi tras ①mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la spring ba'i spring yig /sh+lau ka bcu gnyis/ gces pa brgyad cu pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad cu/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ sgo ka nyi shu/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon shān+ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ bam po gnyis/ tshigs su bcad pa brgya pa slob dpon 'phags pa ④lhas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya/ lta ba'i bye brag slob dpon nyi ma'i 'od kyis mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ 'jig rten pha rol bsgrub ⑤pa/ mkhan po ye shes sdes mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/116—821

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi ①rgya cher 'grel pa/ sgo ka brgya rtsa bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ sgo ka sum cu—/ de'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka bcu/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa'i bshad pa slob dpon dga' byed snyan pas mdzad pa/ khro ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/gsang ba'i gnas su bstod pa'i 'grel pa/ bam po gsum// //theg pa chung ngu'i bstan bcos la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang / sgo ka brgya/ mdzod kyi 'grel pa sh+lau ka dgu stong ste bam po sum cu/ de'i 'grel bshad slo ba dpon ya sho mi tras mdzad pa/ sgo ka khri brgyad stong ste bam po drug cu/ yang mdzod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon saṃ gha bha dras mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong lnga brgya ste bam po bco lnga/ yang mdzod kyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon shārnyi swa mas mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi stong sum brgya ste bam po bcu bzhi/ mdzod kyi thabs bsdus pa/ sgo ka sum stong ste bam po bcu/ chos mngon pa la 'jug pa/ sh+lau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu ste bam po gnyis dang / sh+lau ka brgya ②lnga bcu/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa/sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ de'i snying po kun las btus pa/ sh+lau ka stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu ste bam po drug dang / sh+lau ka lnga bcu// //tar ka'i phyogs la/ las dang 'bras bu'i 'brel pa brtags pa/ sgo ka drug brgya ste bam po gnyis/ de'i 'grel pa sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/rigs pa'i thigs pa/ sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /de'i 'grel pa/slob dpon dharma ut+tas ④mdzad pa/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ de'i rgya 116—822

cher bshad pa/ sh+lau ka dgu brgya ste bam po gsum/ rigs pa'i thigs pa'i phyogs snga ma/ slob dpon ka ma la shrī las mdzad pa/ sgo ka brgya/ rigs pa'i thigs pa'i phyogs snga ma bsdus pa/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ gtan tshigs thigs pa sh+lau ka nyis brgya/ de'i 'grel pa/ h+pho ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis / 'azel pa brtags ①pa/ sgo ka drug brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste bam po gnyis dang sgo ka nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dmigs pa brtag pa/ sh+lau ka brgyad/de'i 'grel pa/ ②sgo ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga ste bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ gzhan sel ba grub pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa/ sh+lau ka lnga bcu/ bdag med pa grub pa/ sh+lau ka bdun cu rtsa gcig/ phyi rol gyi yul grub pa/ slob dpon shu pa gup+tas mdzad pa/sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /dbang phyug 'jug pa grub pa/ sh+lau ka drug cu rtsa dgu/ 'jig rten pha rol grub pa/ sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ de'i 'grel pa/sh+lau ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig /thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa/ blo ka nyis brgya lnga bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa brtags ①pa grub pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gcig /spyi tha dad med pa dgag pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gcig /spyi tha dad pa dgag pa/ sh+lau ka bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ dbu ma brtag pa/ sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa gnyisarka/ thos pa brtag pa/ sgo ka sum brgya ste bam po gcig/ //btsad po khri srong sde btsan gyis mdzad pa'i gtsug lag la/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma/ sh+lau ka nyis stong chig brgya ste bam po bdun/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad rtadu/ sh+lau ka stong lnga brgya ste bam po lnga/ byams pa'i bstod pa chen po/ /sgo ka bzhi brgya ste bam po gcig dang / sgo ka brgya/ byams 116—823

pa'i bstod pa chung ngu / sh+lau ka brgya lnga bcu/ grub pa'i mtha' 'gro ba/ blo ka bzhi bcu/ dbu ma'i gzer bu/ sgo ka sum cu/ theg pa chen po'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag gol sa brgyad btsal ba btsad pos bkas bcad pa/ sh+lau ka sum cu/① gsung rab zhu chen ma bgyis pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag bzhi pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa chen po gnyis gtan la ma 6 r+sha/bstan bcos ②bsgyur 'phro la/ dbu ma'i gzhung zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa rtsa ba dang / 'grel par bcas pa gnyis/ dbu ma'i snying po rtog ge 'bar ba rtsa ba dang / 'grel par bcas pa gnyis/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ bam po bcu gcig /rnam 'grel byi 'grel pa/ bam po bco brgyad/ rtsod ①pa'i rigs pa—/ bam po gcig /tshad ma de kho na bsdus pa rtsa ba dang 'grel par bcas pa gnyis/ gsung rab mdo sde dang bstan bcos thams cad la sh+lau ka dang /bam po'i grangs gtan la phab ste zhu chen zin to 'tshal thams cad 'brug gi lo la pho brang lhan ④dkar du mtshan byang dkar chag tu btab pa rdzogs so// //⑤116—824
bsdu3tsho /dros cheX )mig—116wa 828

༄ga /don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i 'grel pa/①༄4/ /don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i 'grel pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la phyag 'tshal mdo sde ⑤yi/ /don ni bdag gis gsal bar bshad/ /de la mdo sde 'chad 'dod pas/ /dang por dgos pa dang / 'brel pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / gleng bslang ba dang /bsdus pa'i don dang / tshig gi don ston te/ don rnam pa drug rnams bstan dgos so/ /de la slob ma rnams mnyan pa dang / bsam pa dang gzung ba la sogs pa shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ mdo'i don rnam par nges pa ma mthong bar ni blo sngon du gtong ba'i shes rab can dag bya rog gi so brtag pa bzhin du don med do zhes gang la yang 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na dang por dgos pa bshad ces gsungs te/ ci dgos she na/ chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir gsungs na①/ mnyan pa dang gzung 116—831

ba la sogs pa la/ nyan pa 37gus par byed pas na/ /de bas dang por dgos pa bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mgo mjug gi don dang / mtshan nyid kyi bye brag rnam par 'byed pa legs par bya ba'i phyir bshad de/ de ni dgos pa'o/ /gal te chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa ni thabs gzhan gyis kyang 'gyur ro zhe na / de lta rngun ma yin te/ thabs gzhan gyis ni chos 'di'i mgo mjug gi phrin las —rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas par mi nus te/ de bas na chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa ni 4bya ba'i thabs5/ bcom ldan 'aridas kyi (67mdo'i don ston to/ /de ltar mnyan pa dang bsam pa dang gzung ba la sogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par dz+washes par bya ba'i 'bras bu bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa bshad ces gsungs so/ /de ltar bstan cing bshad pa de yang ci 47dgos she na/ chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas na/ blang bar bya ba dang dor bar bya ba shes pas phan pa len pa dang / gnod pa spong ba'i sgo nas nyon mongs pa rnams spong bar 'gyur ro / /nyon mongs pa rnams spangs par gyur kyen/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur te/ 'di ni dgos pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de la 'byel pa ma brjod na se'u lnga dang khur ba drug lta bur gang dang cir yang ma 'byel lngo 7pa'o snyam pa'am/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po'i mgo la rims nad thams cad sel ba'i nor bu rin po che yod kyang / de blang bar bya ba'i thabs med pa lta bu yin no snyam nas/ rtog pa sngon shā1du gtong ba rnams 'jug tu mi btub pa gsal 3/ba'i phyir 'byel pa bshad dol/)/ /de yang tshig dang don du 'brel pa dang /116—832

don dang bsgrub par 'byel pa dang / bsgrub pa dang 'bras bur 'byel pa'o/ /de la tshig dang don du 'byel pa ni/ phung po lnga gang zhe na zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig gis gong du mdo sde'i lung don nyi shu rtsa drug gis chos thams cad bsdus nas bshad pa de khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /don dang bsgrub par 'brel pa ni/ mdo sde'i don bzang po mchog tu gyur pa mthong nas/ slob ma rnams dga' ba'i khyad par skye ste/ 'di ni bsgrub par bya ba'i gtso bo ①yin no zhe na②/ de la de bzhin du bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /bsgrub pa dang 'bras bur 'brel pa ni/ de ltar don ji ltar khong du chud pa bzhin du bsgrubs na/nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i mtshan nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob ①pa'i phyir ro/ /de la gleng gzhi ni mdo sde 'byung ba'i rgyu ste/ de la yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang thabs cig ④tu bzhugs zhes bya ba yan chad kyis bstan to/ /gleng bslang ba ni mdo sde bshad pa'i phyir/ skabs dang sbyar te smras pa'am/ skabs su babs ⑤par smra ba ste/ skabs su ma babs ④par smras na/ smyon pa'i tshig lta bur gyur pas/ rang gis ⑦rig par bya ba'i don du skabs dang sbyar te smra ba ni gleng bslang ba'o/ /de yang de na bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ dge sbyong ⑤de rnams bcom ldan 'das la slar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to zhes bya ba yan chad kyis bstan to/ /bsdus pa'i don kyang slob ma rnams kyi ⑨don dang tshig bde bar khong du chud par bya ba dang / gzung be+e bar bya ba'i phyir bshad de/ de yang dge slong dag la 'di skad ces ⑩don rnam par 116—833

gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba ①chos kyi rnam grangs gang zhe na zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/dge slong dag 'di ni don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi lung zhes bya sneyan chad kyis bstan to/ /tshig gi don ni bsdus pa'i don dang /tshig so so'i don rgyas par 'grel pa ste/ de yang de la dge slong dag phung po lnga gang zhe na zhes bya ba nas brtsams te mdo rdzogs kyi bar du'o/ /da ni gleng gzhi'i ①tshig dbye ba'i dbang du byas nas bshad par bya'o/ /gleng gzhi de yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ dus phun sum tshogs pa dang / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ba'i tshig 'di di don mang por ④'jug ste/dpe dang lung 'bogs dupa dang / dris pa la rjornam par nges pa dang / khas len pa dang tshig gi lan to/ /de la dper 'dren pa ni/ dper na ngal bso ⑦ba lta bu phyug pa dang / seng ge lta bu dpa' ba dang / rdo rje lta bu sra ba zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /lung 'bogs sdepar 'dren pa ni 'di skad lhogs shig ces bya ba lta bu'o—/ /dris pa la rnam par nges par 'dren pa ni/ ji skad thos zhes dris pa dang / 'di skad bdag gis thos te/ de bzhin du bshad do zhes bya ba lta bu'o//khas len pa ni 'di ltar gyis shig ces gsol ba btab pa dang / de bzhin du bya'o zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /tshig gi lan ni 'di skad bdag gis thos pa yin nam zhes smras pa la/ de de lta'o zhes bya ba lta bu'o⑨/ /'di'i skabs su rab tu 'byed pa'i dbang gis khas len par 'dren pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /ji ⑩lta zhe na 'phags pa 'od srungs la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas mdo yang dag 116—834

par bsdu ba la zhugs pa na 'phags pa dga' bo la dgra bcom pa gzhan dag gis khyod kyis ji skad du thos pa de bzhin du bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa dang 'di skad ces smras te①/ bdag gis ②bcom ldan 'das las 'di skad du thos te/ ji skad du thos pa de bzhin du bshad par bya'o zhes khas blang ba'i ④phyir ro/ /bdag gis zhes bya bas gzhan bcad nas mngon sum du thos pa ston te—/ mdo 'di bcom ldan 'das las mngon sum du thos kyi/ jos pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /thos zhes bya ba ni rna ba'i dbang po rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i rna ba'i rnam par shes pas don dang tshig ma nor bar gzung zhes bya ba'i don te/ des duni khong du chud pa med par ston to/ /de ⑤ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das las 'phags pa dga' bos mdo 'di mngon sum du thos pa de'i tshe/ 'phags pa dga' bos bden pa rtog rjopa med de bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bden pa mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /dus gcig na zhes bya ba ni dze+edus gcig gi sgra dus dang phrad pa ste/ don rnam pa gnyis su 'dren to/ /de la dus su 'dren pa ni bdag gis thos pa'i zhes bya ba'i tshig dang yang sbyar te/ de ni mdo sde 'di thos par dka' ba las lan cig ⑧gam dus gcig na thos so zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phrad par 'dren pa ni dus gcig na'i tshig /bcom ldan 'das dang 'og mar sbyar te/ sbal mgrin dang gnya' shing bzhin du mi lus ⑨dang khom pa rnyed dka' ba las rnyed pa dang sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka' ba las phrad de/ mnyan du yod pa la sogs par chos 'di thos so zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang na mdo sde 'di lan cig ⑩dus gcig na thos te/ dus gzhan na mdo sde 116—835

gzhan yang thos so zhes 'phags pa dga' bo nyid thos pa mang bar ston to/ /dus 'di na ni bcom ldan 'das gnas 'di na bzhugs te chos 'di bshad kyis①/dus gzhan gyi tshe na ni gzhan na bzhugs shing chos gzhan yang bshad do zhes bcom ldan 'das nyid sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa rgyun du mdzad par ston to/ /des ni dus phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /de la bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'i tshig 'di don rnam pa gsum du 'dren te/ bcom ldan du 'dren pa dang / dpal ldan du 'dren pa dang / skal ldan du 'dren pa'o/ /de la bcom ldan du 'dren pa ni bdud bzhi bcom pa'i phyir te/ bdud bzhi ni lha'i bu'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / phung po'i bdud do/ /de la lha'i bu'i bdud ni mngon par sangs rgyas nas—/ rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i tshe bcom ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i bu'i bdud mang po'i mtshon cha dang ri la sogs pa'i gnod pa'i tshul mang pos brgal ba las/ byams pa dang snying rje dang stong pa la sogs pa'i byen chen pos mtshon cha la sogs pa yang me tog tu bsgyur te/ btul nas thams cad mkhyen pa gang zag zla med pa'o zhes grags pa chen por mdzad pa na bcom mo/ /nyon mongs pa'i bdud ni de ltar thun snga ma la lha'i bu'i bdud bcom nas/de'i 'og tu thun phyi ma la mthong ba'i lam gyis spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / bsgom pa'i lam gyis spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa gnyis las chen po dang 'bring po dang / chung ⑧ngu ste/ rnam pa dgur gzhag pa la/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes skyes nas/ nyon mongs pa chung ngu'i yang chung ngu / ye shes chen po'i yang chen pos brtsal bas na ①bcom mo/ /de bas na bdud gnyis ni/116—836
