kha dog gi mtshan nyid cig car sal gyis snang bar 'gyur 7snanas gtad du 'dod par 'gyur ba'am1/ yang na thun mi ring ba tsam du snang bar gyur nas nyin mtshan gnyis gsum gyi bar du nyams par 'gyur zhing yang phyis cig car sal kyis dbyibs dang kha dog gi mtshan nyid snye gsal bar gyur chonas gtad du 'dod par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la rim gyis pa'am/ cig car ba'i dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid ni chos bzhi dang ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa yin te/ chos bzhi ni rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la snang ba dang /thun rkyang lte par nus pa dang / mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis dang bral ba dang /mthun pa'i chos gsum dang ldan pa yin no/ /dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i gsal ba'i bye brag ni rab 'bring tha mar shes par bya ste/ rab ni mig gis mthong ba las dugasal bar nga rgyal skye ba dang / 'bring ni mig gis mthong ba tsam du nga rgyal skye ba dang / tha ma ni yid la gsal ba'o/ /rab 'bring tha mar shes nas dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i dus su gang snang yang chog shes par byas nas brten 3pa'i cho ga byas na khams mi bde bar mi 'gyur ba dang / phyis mi nyams par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'bring tha mar shes kyang 'bring dang tha mas cho ga ma shes na ci gsal du rtsol ba drag tu bsgoms shing brtan pa'i cho ga ma byas pas khams mi bde bar 'gyur ba dang / phyis nyams par 'gyur ro/ dbang po rno rtul dang / thos pa mang nyung dang / khams rab 'bring tha ma la rim gyis pa dang / cig car ba dang / gsal ba'i bye brag rab 'bring tha ma las gang 'byung ma nges par shes par bya'o/ /cig car ba'i dbang du byas nas/ chos drug dang ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par 'gyur ba dang / sems kyi skye ba'i 116—1599

rim pa dang po'i dbang du byas nas chos bdun dang ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par 'gyur ba dang / lkusems kyi skye ba'i rim pa gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas chos brgyad dang ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par 'gyur te/de bas na chos brgyad shes shing ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i rgyu rnams ni sdogs la gtad du mi 'dod pa'i skyon phubyernams ni rnam par gcad pa yin no/ /de la mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor la dmigs pa gtad du 'dod nas ma tshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhu par bya ste/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byer gyi dbang du byas na yang chos brgyad shes shing ldan na dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par 'gyur te/ chos brgyad ni zhi gnas kyi rgyu drug dang ldan par bya ba dang / chos kyi rang bzhin ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du shes par bya ba dang / mi rtog pa bsgom par bya ba dang / dmigs pa ni pya shin tu gsal ba bsgom par bya ba dang / bying rgod gnyis kyi dbang du mi gtang khyebar bya ba dang /bsgom pa tshod zin par bya ba dang / rgyu chos de drug yid la bzhag nas bsgoms 'upas 'bras bu sems skye ba'i rim pa mu bzhir rig par bya ba dang / mu gsum pa'i dus su ma nges pa drug gi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /de la chos kyi rang bzhin ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du shes par bya ba ni kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bu yin la don dam par rang bzhin med par shes par bya'o/ /mi rtog pa bsgom par bya ba ni don dam par chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad dang bral ba yin pas cir yang mi 'dzin par bsgom par bya'o/ /dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bsgom par bya ba ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i dus na ni/sku'i kha dog dang dbyibs gsal bar bsgom pa yin la mtshan ma med pa bsgom kye116—1600

pa'i dus na ni/ cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid shin tu gsal bar bsgom pa'o / /mtshan ma bsgom pa'i dus na ni/ mtshan ma ni rang gi ngo bo yang rags pa yin la/ so so'i skye bo'i 1 thog ma med pa nas mngon sum du byas pas bsgom napa'i dus na yang yul can shugs kyis gsal bar 'gyur te/ shugs kyis gsal bar gyur pa des kha dog dang dbyebs kyi mtshan nyid shin tu gsal bar bsgoms snepa'i stobs kyis phyis kha dog dang dbyibs shin tu gsal bar snang bar 4'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma med pa'i bsgom pa'i dus na ni shes pa ma bsgrims par zhan pa 5cir yang mi 'dzin par don dam par chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral bas zab cing rtogs par dka' la/ so so'i skye bo'i ‘blo dang ldan pas kyang sngar mngon sum du ma byas pas bsgom 7pa'i dus na yul can shugs kyis gsal bar mi 'gyur te/ de lta bas na shes pa gzengs 8bstod cing gsal bar byas nas cir yang mi 'dzin pa shin tu gsal bar bsgoms 9pa'i stobs kyis phyis 10shin tu gsal bar nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/de bas na sems rtsol ba zhan pa 11cir yang mi 'dzin pa ni myur du dmigs pa thob par mi 'gyur te/ gal te sgom pa la skyed byung na cir yang mi 'dzin pa mthu chung zhing shes pa'i rgyud 1 gsal ba ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ de bas na shes pa'i rgyud shin tu gsal bar byas nas dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgom pa tshod zin pa ni gong du bstan pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rgyu chos de drug yid la bzhag nas bsgoms pas 'bras bu sems skye ba'i rim pa mu bzhir shes par bya ba ni mu dang po la ni rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam yang mi snang ba yin 776—160/

no / /mu gnyis pa la ni rtsol ba drag tu bsgoms na mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam gnas la gnas skabs kha cig tu ni rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam yang mi gnas pa yin no/ /mu gsum pa la ni rtsol ba drag tu bsgoms na rmyemi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam gnas la gnas skabs kha cig tu rtsol ba gzhan du rngubasgoms na mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam yang mi gnas pa yin no/ /mu bzhi pa ni mu gsum pa las khyad par du gyur te/rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la mi rtog pa'i ngo bor gnas la/ thun rkyang ②bar yang nus/ mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis dang bral zhing mthun pa'i chos gsum dang ldan pa yin no/ /yang na rgyu chos drug yid la bzhag nas bsgoms ④pas 'bras bu sems kyi skye ba'i rim pa mu bzhir shes par bya ba ni mu dang po ni rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam gnas la gnas skabs kha cig tu rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam yang mi gnas pa yin no/ /mu gnyis pa ni mu dang bo las khyad par du 'gyur ⑤ te/rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam gnas pa'i dus ni grangs mang la gnas skabs kha cig tu ni rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam yang mi gnas pa yin no/ /mu gsum pa la rtsol ba drag zhan gnyis ka la yang mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam gnas la gnas skabs kha cig tu rtsol ba zhan du bsgoms yang ⑪mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad tsam du mi gnas pa yin la/ yang kha cig gi dbang du byas na mi rtog pa'i ngo bor mi gnas pa'i 3ma nges pa drug snang ste/ drug ni kha dog bzhi dang nam mkha' dang / nam mkha' sa phyogs dang bcas pa yin no/ /mu bzhi pa ni mu 116—1602

gsum pa las khyad par du gyur te/ chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /mu gsum pa'i dus su ma nges pa rnam pa drug gi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ma yin pa ni gang gi hūṃtshe chos thams cad don dam par spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba yin pas cir yang mi 'dzin pa ni yang dag pa'i shes pa yin no/ /ma nges pa drug ltar snang ba'i phusna shes pa ni phyin ci log gi shes pa yin te/ de bas na de'i tshe mu gsum pa'i dus su ma nges pa rnam pa drug gi rjes su mi 'brang bar shes par bya'o / /yang na chos drug yid la bzhag nas bsgoms pas/ sems kyi skye ba'i rim pa bzhir mi 'byung bar cig car cir yang mi 'dzin par 'gyur te/thun dang po'am/ zhag drug bdun gyi bar du cir yang mi 'dzin par 'gyur nas grugatad du 'dod pa'am/ yang na thun mi ring ba tsam du cig car cir 4yang mi 'dzin par 'gyur ltanas nyin mtshan gnyis gsum gye bar du yang nyams par 'gyur zhing / yang phyis cig car yang mi 'dzin par gyur nas gtad du 'dod par 'gyur ba gyeyin no/ /de rim gyis pa'am cig car ba'i dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid ni chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin no/ /dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i gsal ba'i bye brag ni rab 'bring tha mar shes par bya ste/rab ni mi rtog pa'i mthu yang shin tu che la shes pa'i rgyud kyang shin tu gsal ba yin no/ /'bring ni mi rtog pa'i mthu yang 'bring la shes pa'i rgyud kyang gsal ba 7'bring tsam du gnas pa yin no/ /tha ma ni mi rtog pa'i mthu yang chung la shes pa'i rgyud kyang snga ma bas cung zad tsam tsumi gsal ba yin no/ /rab 'bring tha mar shes nas dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa'i dus su gang nyams su myong yang cho ga shes par byas nas brtan 9pa'i cho ga byas na khams mi bde bar mi 'gyur ba 116—1603

dang dmigs pa dus mtshungs su snang na brtan pa'i cho ga ye mi dgos par shes par bya'o/ /chos bzhi'i dbang gis khams tha ma la gsum ni khams tha ma de dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par byed pa'i dus su mi bde ba ye med na nyin mtshan gnyis su ci nus su bsgom par bya'o/ /khams tha ma de cung zad mi bde bar gyur na snga so'i bsgoms 1pa tsam nyin mtshan gnyis nas gsum du bsgom par bya'o / /khams tha ma de cher mi bde bar gyur pa dang dmigs pa dus mtshungs su snang na brtan 2 pa'i cho ga ye mi dgos par shes par bya'o/ /skyon spang zhing yon tan dang ldan pa ni khams mi bde bar 'gyur ba dang / dmigs pa mi gsal bar 'gyur ba dang / dmigs pa nyams par 'gyur ba'i spyon rnams spangs shing yon tan gsum dang ldan te khams mi 4bde bar mi 'gyur ba dang /dmigs pa mi gsal bar mi 5'gyur ba dang / dmigs pa nyams par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de bas na mi nyams shing brtan 6par 'gyur ro/ /de dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod par gyur nas brtan pa'i cho gas brtan par 7byas pa'i dbang gis phyis dmigs pa la gtad du 'dod pa de ni zhi gnas kyi phyogs dang mthun pa zhes bya ste/ zhi gnas rdzogs pa ma yin no/ /de la zhi gnas kyi phyogs dang mthun pa thob nas kyang chos gsum shes shing ldan na zhi gnas sdogs par 'gyur te/ chos gsum ni mu bzhir shes shing blang dor gyi bye brag shes pa dang zhi gnas kyi rgyu drug dang ldan zhing de'i mi mthun pa spang bar bya ba dang /bsgom 8pa tshod zin zhing thun ring po ma yin pa'o/ /de la myu bzhir shes shing blang dor gyi bye brag shes pa ni ting nge 'dzin ma rdzogs pa'i dbang gis sems kyi nyams mu bzhir 'byung bar shes par bya ste/ mu dang po la ni 9dmigs pa mi 716byed/605

'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i ①zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog/phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa④/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur—/ /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing ④'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad+mo duchus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad/ /zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ⑤rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god ⑥cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni ④phan par spyad/ /byang chub 116 1623

spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag gi ①spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing / /ma 'ongs ②bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs ①par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyong dub yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du yang bu'akhor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan ( )kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig 8steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi shedabus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun ⑩gyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung (mel rtag tu 'jug 1 76— 1624

par bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i ①rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad—/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgon ma rnams/ /de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o//kun du myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun nas sgo yi theg pa'i stobs dag dang / /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang / /kun tu khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs/ /kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs dag ④dang / /chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs ④dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing / /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par dgrol/ /chos rnams 116—1625

rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing / /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su ①rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa ②rgyal ba yi/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pa'i ①byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun bdag gis ma lus ④rdzogs par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par dhispyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo—/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang / /bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra brjo/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir//'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs ⑦bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar—/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung rnged par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang / /de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba'i ⑧mchog rnams kyang / /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ⑨ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing / /116—1626

lan cig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa na①/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spang bar ④'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin—/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des ①myur mthong / /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong / /kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'grur/ /mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gi dhimi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub—/ /'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btuladu/ /gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yirjo/ /de yi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ④ma byed cig /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams 116—1627

cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon du ①'gyur bar shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang ②/ /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo ①dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes(9—/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas ⑤mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab job nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis rjophyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi(7ra/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor par shog / gang yang dubazang po spyod pa 'di bsngos pas④// /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa ⑪gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor byeng ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing / /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste1(/ /ngan song gnas ⑫rnams ma lus stongs par shog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// // 'di byang chub sems dpa'i sde sdod kyi nang tshan phal po che'i sdong po brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa'i le'u las phyung ba'o/ /⑫116—1628

na614༄ga /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/①༄4/ / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi ṭī pra ṇi dh+wa na rā dza/ bod skad du—/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /②sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo//drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang / /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zlog byed ①cing / /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid bupa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis ldig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa des/ /bdag gi ⑤kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /bdag gi rjobyang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing khams ⑦su/ /sangs rgyas 116—1631

mchod pa gang byung ba/ / sangs rgyas mkhyen pas ①yi rang ba④/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams na/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs—/ /byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing / /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /srog chags kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i ①sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can mthar dubagyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur cing / /sred pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa/ /'ching ba kun gyis ⑤bcings bdag la/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs busu gsol/ /sems kyi dri mar bgyis pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad/ /sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang / /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa/ /de dag rjes su bdag slob cing / /byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /'gro drug sems can mthar (pebagyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas/ /bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang / /rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ /rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis/ /stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar/ /sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis/ /gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis/ /bdag ma mchis 116—1632

pa'i chos rtogs shog /bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos po kun la mi gnas par/ /sems can kun la bde slad du/ /ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong ①shog /dngos po dngos po ma mchis pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul dzams kyis/ /tshul dzams pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me/ /rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing / /bzod pa'ang (ltekhro ba ma mchis par/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing / /stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang / /rig gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis labasngags pa dang / /'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing / /byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis ༷nas/ /sa bcu po la rab tu gnas/ / kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa gang la gnas nas thabs mkhas pas zeg pa bde ba dang / 'jug pa bde ba dang / lam bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag 116——1633

par bsgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa ni 'di yin no/ /①'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po ④rdzogs so// // dkon brtsegs kyi byams pas zhus pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo las so// //①bsdur mchan/1631 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar〉rab 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girgya gar skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zlog bgyid/ du〈〈snar 〉〉gyid/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes pa ste/ /bdag gis/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉di/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/1632 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thams cad mkhyen pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thar—/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ bu〈〈pe 〉ra sa gzig 〈〈snar 〉stanas gzigs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thar/1633 ①〈〈snar 〉sngagatang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉shing / /bzod pa'am/ 〈〈snar 〉〉shig /bzod pa'am/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyas/1634 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni 'di yin no/ /①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigyi rgyal po/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidakon brtsegs kyi byams pas theg pa chen po'i mdo las so// //116byed1634
bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (65)116wa 1635

3615༄ga /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i smon lam bzhugs/①༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser 'od dam pa'i rnga chen sgra yis ni/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal gshin rje'i sdug bsngal dang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /'jig rten rmongs pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ji ltar thub dbang 'jigs med 'jigs zhi ltar / /sems can 'jigs med 'jigs dang bral bar shog /ji ltar 'khor bar kun mkhyen thub dbang po/ /'phags pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa ltar/ /skye dgu ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag gi/ /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan rgya mtshor gyur/ /rnga bo che yi lasgra skad 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad tshangs pa'i sgra ldan gyur/ /sangs rgyas dam pa byang chub mchog reg shog /chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor gyur cig /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab 116———1636

bzhugs par shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /nyon mongs 'joms gyur sdug bsngal sel bar gyur①/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi gyur cig /sems can gang dag ngan song sar gnas te/ /rus pa'i yul ④la me lce rab 'bar ba/ /de dag rnga chen bsgrags pa ①thos gyur cig / sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi gyur nas/ /④sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig thos shog /sems can kun gyi tshe rabs brgya dag dang / /tshe rabs stong phrag bye bar skye dran shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran gyur cing / /de dag gi ni rgya chen gsung thos shog /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rtag tu 'grogs rnyed gyur/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par sgong bar shog /bya ba dge ba rnams ni spyod gyur cig /mi dang lha dang srog chags thams cad kyi/ /de dag bsam dang smon lam gang yin pa/ /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /de dag rnams kyi re ⑤kun rdzogs gyur cig /sems can gang dag sems dmyal mi bzad skyes/ /lus la me lce kun tu rab tu 'bar/ /skyabs med mya ngan bcas shing yongs 'khyam pa/ /me rnams ma lus rab tu zhi bar shog /sems dmyal yi dwags mi yi 'jig rten na/ /sems can sdug bsngal mi bzad drag po gang / /rnga bo che yi dhisgra skad 'di yis ni/ /de dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi shog /rten med dpung gnyen sked pa dang / /skyabs med par ni gyur pa dag /de rnams la ni skyob ④pa dang / /dpung gnyen rten mchog bdag gyur cig(she /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis dam pa dag /thugs brtse ⑨thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /bzhugs pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis 1masngon chad sdig pa'i las/ /shin tu mi 116—1637

bzad gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu'i spyan sngar bdag mchis te/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /pha ma dag tu mi 'dzin dang / /sangs rgyas rnams su mi 'dzin dang / /dge ba dag tu mi 'dzin pas/ /sdig pa bdag gis gang bgyes dang / / phyug cing rgyags ①pas dregs pa dang / /rigs dang longs spyod rgyags pa dang / /gzhon pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa yis/ /bdag gis ①sdig pa gang bgyis ①dang / /nyes sam nyes par smras pa dang / /nyes pas bgyis pa'i las rnams dang / /nyes pa'i dmigs su ma bltas pas/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /byis pa'i blo yis rjo'ajug pa dang / /mi shes mun pa'i sems dang ni/ /sdeg pa'i grogs po'i dbang gyur dang / /nyon mongs rnam par 'khrug (9sems dang / /rtsed mo dga' ba'i dbang nyid dang / /mya ngan dang ni nad dbang dang / /nor gyis mi chog nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis rjosdig pa gang bgyis dang / /'phags min skye bo 'dren pa ⑦dang / /phrag dog ser sna'i sgyu dang ni/ /g.yo dang dbul ba'i nyes pa yis⑧/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyes dang / /phongs pa 'byung ⑨ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dod pa rnams dang 'jigs ⑪ rgyu dang / /phyug po ma yin gyur pa yis/ /bdag gis ⑪sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /g.yo ba'i sems kyi dbang nyid dang / /'dod dang khro ba'i dbang nyid dang / /bkres dang skom gyis nyen pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang ⑫bgyis dang / /bza' ba dag dang btung ba dang / /bud med rgyu dang gos kyi phyir/ /nyon mongs btung ⑫ba sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis ④sdig pa gang bgyis dang / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ⑫sdig /nyes par spyad pa rnam ⑩gsum bsags/ /'di 'dra'i ⑫tshul gyis gang bgyis pa/ /116—1638

de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams dang //de bzhin nyan thos rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags gang babyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags ①bgyis pa rnams④/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /dam chos smra ba rnams la yang / /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa dang / /chos la'ang gus par ma bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ / bdag gis ①rtag tu mi shes pas/ /dam pa'i chos ni spangs pa dang / /pha ma rnams la ma gus padhi/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /blun pa dang ni byis pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal dregs pas bsgribs bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /bdag ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /stobs bcu rnams la mchod par shog /bdag ni phyogs bcur sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal kun las 'don gyur cig /sems can bsam byis mi khyab kun/ /sa bcu dag la 'god par shog /sa bcu dag la gnas nas kyang / /thams cad de bzhin gshegs gyur cig /ji srid sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /de kun mthar bgyid rjonus srid du⑥/ /sems can re re'i phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye bar spyod par shog /gser 'od dam pa zhes bgyi ba/ /las rnams thams cad byang byed pa/ /zab mo dag ni ston pa 'di/ /sems can de dag ston gyur cig /gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad bgyis—/ /lan cig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyuraske/ /gang gis las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /myur du yang dag zad 'gyur ba//116—1639

gser 'od dam pa dge ba yis①/ /bshags pa 'di dag bshags nas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mchog bcu po/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par shog /sangs rgyas yon tan snang gyur cig /srid pa'i mtsho las sgol bar shog /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho chu bo dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho zab mo de/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas kyis④/ /thams cad mkhyen du ①rdzogs par shog /ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong rnams dang / /gzungs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /dbang stobs ④byang chub yan lag gisakhya/ /stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar shog /dgongs pa'i thugs kyis pyasangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag la rnam par gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /nongs pa rab tu gzung ⑦du gsol/ /bdag gis ④bskal pa brgya rnams su/ /sngon chad sdig pa gang bgyid ⑫pa/ /de phyir bdag ni mya ngan sems/ /phongs dang mya ngan 'jigs pas ⑩gzir/ /sdig pa'i las la 'jigs par bgyid/ /yid ni rtag tu dman par gyur/ /gang dang gang du 'gro bgyid pa/ /bdag ni gang du'ang dga' ⑩ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rjer ldan/ /'gro ba kun gye 'jigs sel bas/ /nongs pa ⑩ rab tu gzung ⑫du gsol/ /'jigs pa dag las bdag thar mdzod/ /bdag gi ④nyon mongs las rnams kyis⑫/ /dri ma de bzhin gshegs pas sol/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 4)bdag la ni/ / thugs rje chu yis bkru ⑫bar gsol/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis dang / /da ltar bdag gis ⑫sdig pa gang / /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /nongs par bgyis spyopa'i las rnams kunarka/ /be+en chad mi bgyid bsdam )par bgyi/ /bdag gis nongs par 116—1640

bgyis pa gang / /sdig de bcab par mi bgyi'o/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum po rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /lus kyis bgyis dang ngag gi las/ /yid kyis ①rnam par bsams ⑤pa dang / /las rnams bcu po bgyis pa dag /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /mi dge'i ①las bcu spangs nas su/ /dge ba bcu po bsten bgyis nas/ /sa bcu la ni bdag gnas shing du/ /stobs bcu mchog tu gyur par ⑤shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las gang dag /mi 'dod 'bras bu thob bgyid pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas nibya/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'dzam bu'i ④gling 'dir gang dag dang //'jig rten khams ni ④gzhan dag tu/ /gang rnams dge ba'i las bgyid pa⑨/ /dge ba kun la yid ⑩rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /bdag gis bsod nams gang bsgrubs pa/ /bdag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ /byang chub mchog la reg par shog /srid 'gro nyam ngar byes pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mi mnyam spyan sngar mchis nas ni//sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang / /'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga dang / /lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis⑪—/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so/ /byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang / /sdig pa'i grogs dang phrad pa nyam nga dang / /srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga dang / /zhe sdang gnyi mug mun pa'i ⑫nyam nga dang / /ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang / /bsod nams bsgrub ⑫pa nyam nga gang bgyis pa/ /rgyal ba mi mnyam ④mngon sum mchis nas ni/ /sdig 116—1641

pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas gser mdog ri snang ri rab 'dra—/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rgyal ba de dag kun la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gser mdog gser ni dri ma med pa'i ①gser gyi 'od/ /dri med rnam dag bai ḍūr+ya yi yan lag spyan/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma dpal gzi grags ④'bar 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer dag ①gis mun pa mun nag bsal0/ /yan lag rab tu dri med 'od ⑤bzang rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma yan lag dri med gser 'dras khyab/ /nyon mongs medalgegadungs yid can 'bar ba'i me 'dra bgi/thub pa'i zla ba'i 'od zer dra bas tshim par mdzad/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis ⑧dbang po yan lag mdzes/ /dpe byad bzang po dag gis yan lag rnam par mdzes/ /dpal gzi bsod nams 'bar 'khrungs ⑨'od zer dra ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum na mun khrod nyi ma bzhin du bzhugs/ /dri med rgya chen kha dog sna tshogs bai ḍūr+ya/ /skya rengs dmar dang dngul dang shel bzhin yan lag dmar/ /'od zer dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs legs brgyan pa⑩/ /thub chen khyod ni nyi ma bzhin du de yis mdzes/ /mya ngan 'khrugs pa'i ⑩'chi chu rgal ba'i dba' ⑫rlabs can/ /'khor ba'i klung ⑫chen phongs pa'i chu bor lhung ④ba la—/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mchog tu rtsub cing shugs drag pa/ /bde ⑫gshegs nyi ma'i 'od zer mang po rnams kyis skoms/ /yan lag gser gyi mdog tu rnam par snang / /ye shes 'byung gnas 'jig rten gsum mgon spyomachog /rab mdzes mtshan gyis yan lag rnam spras pa/ /sangs rgyas gser sku 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chu ni dpag med dang / /ji ltar sa la sa rdul 116—1642

mtha' yas dang / /ji ltar ri rab rdo ①mtha' mtshungs med dang / /ji ltar nam mkha'i tha ②ma mtha' yas pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas te/ /sems can kun gyis shes par mi nus so/ /bskal pa du mar gzhal cing bsams kyang ni/ /yon tan tha ma shes par mi nus so/ /chu ni skra yi rtse mo'i tshad tsam dang / /rdor bcas rir bcas rgya mtshor bcas pa ni/ /bskal par bgrangs na shes par nus kyang srid/ /sangs rgyas yon tan pha mtha' shes mi nus/ /yon tan kha dog snyan dang grags pa dang / /dge ba'i mtshan gyes brgyan pa'i sku lus dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa yis—/ /sems can thams cad de 'drar gyur par shog /bdag gis dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten mi ring ①sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston gyur cig /sems can sdug bsngal mang ④gzir thar byed shog /stobs bcas sder bcas bdud las rgyal gyur cig /chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor bar shog /bskal pa bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab bzhugs gyur cig /bdud rtsi chu yis dusems can tshim byed shog /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal bas ⑦sgogs pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin drug bla med rdzogs par shog /nyon mongs bcom zhing ⑧sdug bsngal sel gyur cing ⑨/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi byed shog /tshe rabs brgya dang tshe rabs bye ba stong / /bdag ni rtag tu tshe rabs dran par shog /thub pa'i dbang po rtag tu dran gyur cig /de dag rnams kyi gsung rgya che thos shog /bdag ni dge ba'i las rnams ⑩'di dag gis/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa rnyed par shog /sdig pa'i las rnams rnam par spong gyur cing ⑪/ /dge ba'i 'byung ⑫gnas dge 116—1643

rnams spyod par shog /zhing rnams kun na srog chags thams cad kyang / /'jig rten dag na sdug bsngal kun zhi gyur①/ /sems can dbang po ma tshang ②yan lag nyams④/ /de kun de'u re budabang po tshang bar shog /gang dag nad btab nyam chung lus nyams dang / /phyogs bcu dag na skyabs med gyur pa rnams—/ /de kun myur du nad las thar gyur cig /nad sked stobs dang dbang po rnyed par sgog /gang dag rgyal po chom rkun dgras bsdigs bsad ⑤thug dang / /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs brgya yis phongs gyur pa/ /sems can nyam thag gyur cing sdug bsngal de dag kun/ / 'jigs mchog mi dubazad brgya bo de las thar gyur cig /gang dag brdegs shing bcings pas bcings gzir ba/ /phongs pa sna tshogs dag na gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs stong phrag du mas dkrugs nas kyang / /'jigs pa mi bzad mya ngan sna tshogs rnyed//de dag thams cad bcings las grol gyur cig /brdegs ⑦pa dag ni brdegs ⑧las thar bar shog /bsad ⑨pa rnams kyang srog dang ldan gyur cig /phongs gyur thams cad 'jigs pa med par shog /sems can gang dag bkres sred skom byis gzir/ /de dag zas skom sna tshogs rnyed par shog /long bas (rtegazugs rnams sna tshogs mthong gyur cing / /'on pas yid 'ong sgra rnams thos par shog /gcer bu rnams kyis (kyesna tshogs gos rnyed gyur/ /sems can dbul pos gter rnams rnyed par shog /nor 'bru rin chen sna tshogs mang po yis—/ /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan par shog /gang yang sdug bsngal tshor bar gnod 7ma gyur/ /sems can thams cad blta na sdug pa dang //gzugs bzang mdzes shing shin tu shis par shog /rtag tu bde ba du ma sogs ⑫116—1644

gyur cig /yid kyi zas skom rab 'byor bsod nams dag /bsams ①ma thag tu de dag grub gyur cig /rdza rnga thucang te'u pi wang sgra snyan dang / /chu mig mtshe'u rdzing bu lteng nuka dag /gser gyi pad+ma a la 'dab ma 7can/ /zas skom gos nor mu tig nor bu dbyig /rgyan gser 57rin chen sna tshogs bai ḍūr+ya / /de dag bsams ma thag tu grub gyur cig /'jig rten gang na'ang sdug bsngal sgra ma byung / /sems can gcig kyang mi 'phrod mthong ma gyur/ /de dag thams cad kha dog rgya chen dang / /phan tshun du ni 'od byed gyur par thushog /mi yi 'jig rten phun sum tshogs gang yod/ /de dag bsam par de dag skye bar gyur dz+wa / /bsam pa thams cad bsams ma/ thag tu yang / /bsod nams 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par shog /spos dang phreng ba dag dang byug pa dang / /gos dang phye ma rnge tog sna tshogs dang / /ljon shing dag las bye dus gsum 'bab par shog /sems can de dag len cing dgar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa bsam yas thams cad dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang / /rdul bral dri med bstan pa'i chos la yang / /phyogs bcu rnams su mchod pa byed par shog /'gro ba dman pa 9thams cad spong gyur cig /mi khom brgyad po dag las 'das par shog /dal ba'i rgyal po dam pa thob gyur cig /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'grogs pa thob par shog /rtag tu mtho ba'i rigs su skye bar shog /nor dang 'bru yis mdzod rnams 'byor gyur cig /snyan dang grags dang gzugs dang kha dog gis/ /bskal pa du mar legs par brgyan par shog /bud med thams cad rtag tu phor gyur te/ /dpa' zhing rtul phod khumakhas shing gsal bar shog /de kun rtag tu byang chub 116—1645

phyir spyod gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod par shog /phyogs bcu dag na rmyerin chen shing dbang drung / /sangs rgyas bde /2snabazhugs rin chen be+e ḍūr+ya'irngo —/ /khri la bzhugs pa dag ni mthong gyur cig /chos bstan pa yang de dag thos par shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las rnams bsgrubs pa ni/ /srid byapa nyam ngar sngon chad gang bsgrubs pa/ /sdig las gang dag mi 'dod 'bras zhethob pa / dge ba bluthams cad ma lus zad gyur cigamu /sems can gang dag srid par bcings gnas kun/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa'i thag 2pas dam bcings pa/ /shes rab lag gis bcings pa bkrol rngubar shog /sdug bsngal rnams las thar gyur thob —gyur cig /sems can gang dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dang / /gang dag 'jig rten khams ni gzhan rnams na/ /bsod nams sna tshogs zab mo rnams byed pa/ /de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bsgrubs pa yi 14/ /bdag gi rjes su yi rang bsod nams des/ /bdag gi smon lam 'bras bu yod par shog /byang chub rdul bral bla med thob gyur cig /gang dag rtag ⑫tu dri ma bral ba dang / /dri med yid kyi /)phyag 'tshal bstod pa dang / /yongs su bsngo ba brjod pa 'di yis ni/ /bskal pa drug cur ngan song spong bar 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa 'di dag gis/ /skyes pa bud med bram ze rgyal rigs las/ /thal sbyar 'dug ste rgyal ba gang bstod pa/ /tshe rabs kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /yan lag dbang po kun gyes beyan lag brgyan skye/ /bsod nams yon tan sna tshogs rnams dang ldan/ /mi dbang rgyal po rtag tu de mchod de/ /de dang de dag tu ni de 'drar 'gyur/ /gang dag rna ba'i bu gar bshags pa 'di ⑩ni grag 'gyur ba⑩/ /de dag sangs rgyas 116—1646
