su bcad pa de dag gsan nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog la 'di skad ces bka' stsal lo/ /legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi rmi lam na gser gyi rnga las de bzhin gshegs pa'i yang dag pa'i yon tan bsngags pa dag sdig pa bshags pa/ du〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ 0〈〈snar 〉〉skothams cad kyang / ①〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉〉par gyur/ ni〈〈snar 〉〉skozhes bka' stsal nas/ de nas 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa mngon par bstod do// // ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉das gsung / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉—yin lnga min bcu la min/ smon lam rdzogs so// // (zhes pa'i g.yung drung rtags bar gyi yi ge rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉pa mi bzhugs pas dpe bsdur byung med/)bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (66)116wa 1649

na616༄ga /rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i tshen lam bzhugs/①༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ma 'ongs bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /gang dang gang du bdag ni skye ba na/ /rmi lam du ni 'di 'dra'i rnga mthong zhing / /der ni bshags pa 'di 'dra thos par shog /rgyal bstod pad+ma 'byung rgyal 'di 'dra ba/ /tshe rabs de dang der ni rnyed gyur cig /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas mtshungs med dang / /gang yang bskal pa stong du rnyed dka' ba/ /de dag rmi lam na yang thos par shog /nyin gyur tshe yang de dag ston gyur cis/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtsho las thar byed shog /pha rol phyin pa drug po rdzogs bgyis nas/ /phyin chad bla med byang chub thob par shog /bdag gi zhing ni 'gran zla med gyur cig /rnga phul rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu dang / /rgyal ba thams cad la yang bstod pa'i rgyus/ /shākya thub dbang mngon du mthong bar shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan thob 116—1650

gyur cig /gser gyi lag pa'i dbang dang gser gyi 'od/ /bdag gi khye'u ni gang yin 'di gnyis dang / /der ni bu pho de dag gnyi ga dang / /bla med byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /sems can gang dag gnas med rten med cing / /skyabs dang bral nas phongs par gyur pa dang / /de dag la yang ma 'ongs dus rnams na/ /skyob dang dpung gnyen skyabs dang rten gyur shog /sdug bsngal kun 'byung zad par byed gyur cig /bde ba kun gye 'byung gnas gyur par shog /sngon mtha' 'das pa de dag ji srid pa/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyod gyur cig /gser 'od dam pa yi ni bshags pa yis/ /bdag gi sdig pa'i rgya mtsho skems par shog /bdag gi las kyi rgya mtsho zad gyur cig /bdag gi nyon mongs rgya mtsho chad par shog /bdag gi bsod nams rgya mtsho rdzogs gyur cig /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yis/ /bdag gi tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnam dag shog /yon tan kun gyi rgya mtshor 'gyur bar shog /byang chub yon tan yon tan rin chen rdzogs/ /gser 'od dam pa'i bshags pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /bdag gi bsod nams rab tu snang bar shog /bdag gi byang chub snang ba rnam dag gyur/ /ye shes dri med snang ba dam pa yis/ /bdag gi lus kyi don ni snang bar shog /bsod nams snang ba lhang nger bya ba'i phyiraske/ /'jig rten gsum na khyad par 'phags gyur cig /bsod nams stobs dang rtag tu ldan par shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ni sgrol ba dang / /bde ba kun gyi rgya mtsho 'dra ba yis/ /ma 'ongs bskal par byang chub spyad par bgyi—/ /'jig rten gsum na sngon mthar ji snyed gshegs/ /de dag zhing ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /yon tan mtha' yas khyad 'phags ci 'dra ba/ /yon 116—1651

lda617༄ga /'phags pa lag bzangs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba'i smon lam bzhugs/①༄4/ /chos dang ldan pa'i bya ba rnams kyi phyir/ /'jig rten dag gi phyogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyal ba kun dang byang chub sems dpa' las/ /rang gi lus ni nges par dbul bar bgyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur bar du/ /ma 'ongs pa na smon lam mtha' yas gdab/ /skye dang skye bar dkon mchog gsum po la/ /gzhal med khang bcas bzhon dang mal cha dang / /bza' dang btung ba rab yang sbyin par shog /'gro ba'i bsam pa lam gyis rdzogs byed cing / /skyabs dang lus dang pha 'drar 'gyur bar shog /bzod la dga' zhing tshul khyems gtsang ba dang / /'gro la chos rnams rab tu ston gyur cig /byang chub theg pa mchog ni rnyed pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum phyir go cha bgo bar shog /pha rol phyin pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs su rdzogs byed shog /sdig pa kun dang bral zhing lus ngag 116—1653

dang / /yid kyi las mtha' dge ba mchog gyur cig /byang chub las ni mi ldog bdag 'gyur zhing / /byang chub dga' dang byang chub sems dpar gyur/ /srid dang srid par byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dge ba kun la slob/ /bdag gis chos rnams de dag kun la yang / /'jig rten de dag rab tu dgod par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs so// //bsdur mchan/1653 lamatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (68)116wa 1654

snapha ༄ga /sbyin pa'i rabs kyi smon lam bzhugs/①༄7/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zas skom bzang po ro zhim zhing mdog sdug la dri bsung ldan zhing ngad ①ldang ba/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i nags tshal dkon zhing dri ma med la rgyan gyis klubs pa/ yal ga'i thor to'i ljid kyis g.yur za la mgo lcogs ①me tog kha phye zhing me'adab mas legs par brgyan te/ bung ba lang long khyus lding ⑤zhing 'phungs pa rnams kyis gzhib cing non pa'i shugs kyis bag tsam 'dar ldem ldem la/ rin chen yal ga dang margad lcug phran bugyi bla re 'jol ba dag mngon par sgrub dze+epar byed pa⑧/ 'gro ba dag tu ma tshor bar 'gro ba'i g.yang sa chen po ya nga ba ⑨dag tu mar me snang gsal dag cing dri ma med pa lta bu byin pa gang la 6 )bsod nams dang / bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun pa dang /dge ba dang / dge ba'i rgyu dang mthun ⑪pa bde dgu'i gzhir gyur pa des ni sbyin 116byed1655

bdag chen po bdag nyid che ba che ge mo zhig gi lus dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyis bsgrubs pa la tshe dang / kha dog dang / stobs dang / gzi byin dang /longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / shes rab dang / spobs pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sbyin bdag gi bsod nams ma skyes pa rnams ni skye bar gyur cig /sbyin bdag gi bsod nams skyes zin pa rnams ni 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sbyin bdag gi pha ma mchog tu dka' ba byed byed pa/ gso gso—/ gnam gnam/ bskyed bskyed/ bsring bsring / 'dzam bu'i gling skra ①yer yer mig gis mthong bar byed pas kyang bsod nams kyi phud kyi skal shas thob par gyur ④cig /de bzhin du sbyin bdag gi chung ma rnams dang / bu rnams dang / bu mo rnams dang / sbyin bdag gi gnyen 'dun mdza' bshes ①rgyas pa'i tshan ris ④gang dag 'khod cing 'tsho la gnas pa de dag kyang tshe ring zhing longs spyod che la g.yog 'khor mang bar gyur cig /gang dag 'das shing tshe 'phos ⑤pa de dag kyang 'gro ba tso skye ba'i gnas dang gnas tha dad pa'i khyad par thob par gyur te/ lha'i gnas su skye bar gyur nas 'phags pa byams pa'i zhal snga nas mnyes par byed par gyur cig /de bzhin du rgyal po'i mchog rgyal po chen po mnga' dubadag dam pa dpal lha btsan pos ma phebs pa rnams ni phebs par gyur cig /phebs hustezin pa rnams ni cham du phebs par gyur cig /stobs kyi ( )'khor los sgyur ⑪ba'i rgyal srid kyang brnyes ⑫par gyur cig /de bzhin du khyed nye 'khor gyi grong khyer tshun gnas pa'i rigs bzhi ste/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u spyorigs dang / dmangs rigs la sogs pa yul gyi mi rnams la nad med cing gnod pa med par ma(stegyur cig /de bzhin du mi 116—1656

mjed ①kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba ②bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / bsnyen dga' bo dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bde ba'i ri bo dang / gangs can dang / lngas rtsen dang / lnga len la sogs pa dang / nor bu bzang dang rdzogs bzang gnyis dang / 'phrog ①ma bu lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' rjoba'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po dang / sbyin bdag gi khyem 'di na gnas pa'i lha rnams dang /sbyin bdag gis bubasten pa'i lha bukhyad par gyi ⑦de dag gzi byin dang / stobs dang / gzhal med khang rnams rgyas par gyur cig /de dag gzi byin dang ldan par gyur cig④ /stobs dang ldan par gyur/ gzhan byis mi tshugs par gyur / dbang ⑨che bar grags par gyur nas/ sbyin bdag bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi mdzod dang / bang ba dang / ba lang gi khyu dang / phyugs bdag ⑩sna tshogs kyi khyu dang / zhing gi rmo rko ⑪dang / las kyi sgo rnams dang /bla 'og gi bya ba thams cad la chos bzhin du bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang /sba bar byed par gyur cig /gnod pa thams cad ni bzlog ⑫par gyur cig /don du bsgrubs pa rnams ni snang bar gyur cig /de bzhin du sbyin bdag gi dad pa dang sbyar te dmyal bar skyes pa rnams kyi gnod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /dud 'gro rnams gcig la gcig za ba rnams zlog kṛ)par gyur cig /yi dwags rnams kyi bkres shing skom pa'i sdug bsngal thams 116—1657

cad zhi bar gyur cig /mi rnams tshol khros g.yen spyo ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /lha rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang rtsang ba dang / rnam par 'jor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig/mdor na khams gsum du skye ba'i ①sems can thams cad dang srog chags thams cad kyis kyang mya ngan las 'das pa ma skyes ma byung ba/ ma byas ma bcos pa dang / 'chi 'pho ba ②med pa dang sne/ mi gnas pa/ dmigs su med pa/bde ba zhi ba/ gya nom pa/ bde legs can/ gnas dang / gling dang /skyob pa dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / mi g.yo ba gang yin pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos kyi mchog de reg cing thob par gyur cig /gnod sbyin gang dag gzhon pa mi bzad dpung btsan ④lha rdzas gos gyon phreng ba thogs/ /gang dag 'jig rten gsum mchod mkhas pa rnams kyis brjod pa'i sangs rgyas skyabs song la/ /lngas rtsen lag na rdo rje nor sbyin dpal can nor bu bzang sras la sogs pa/ /de dag thams cad lhan cig rtag tu khyod kyi khyim du chos bzhin bsrung ④bar shog /lngas rtsen dang ni 'phrog ma bu sdug 'khor bcas nor bu bzang busras dpung dang bcas rnams dang / /gnod sbyin dbang po lag na rdo rje rang gi sde tshan bcas dang rang gi sder bcas dang / /gzhan yang gnod sbyin dbang po gang dag bde ④chen grags ldan bstan pa dag la dga' ba rnams/ /thams cad mthun par khyod kyi pha tshan ⑧dang ni gnyen sdug bcas la rtag tu skyong gyur cig /mtshan mo dang ni nyi ma 'char ka nyi ma'i gung rnams dang / /nyi ma nub kar rtag tu khyod la bkra shis ldan par shog /dpal chen lag na rdo rje nor bu bzang dang 'phags skyes sogs/ /byed dang gnyen 'dun rnams dang 116—1658

bcas la yongs su skyong gyur cig /gtong la dpa' ba rnams kyang khyem 'khor stobs dang 'byor pa grub cing mi nad med par shog /yon tan ①rnams kyang yon tan tshogs pas 'phel bar 'gyur zhing 'bru rnams rab tu rgyas par shog /mchod rten rnams kyang mchod par 'gyur zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa yun ring 'bar bar shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pas skyong ②gyur sems can mtha' dag rab zhi bde ba myong gyur cig① /sbyin pa'i rabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1655 ①mtshan byang 'di〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉rdzar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉dad/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉spyog du〈〈snar 〉ma nga /⑤〈〈snar 〉marading / me〈〈snar 〉raban/ ④〈〈snar 〉ra sgrub/ ④〈〈snar 〉skal/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉giya ngab/⑩〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉marathun/1656 sti〈〈snar 〉ra kra/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉shog ①〈〈snar 〉maradab mdza' gshes/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉'phongs| ④〈〈snar 〉ra dang / ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉skyes par/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉ge 'i mda'/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉snyeb/⑩〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉ra sgyur/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉thamanyes/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉shesang khyer gyi nye 'khor/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉rje su/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉gir ༅/ /sbyin pa'i rabs kyi smon lam bzhugs/ dmangs rigs la sogs pa yul gyi mi rnams la nad med cing gnod pa med par/ (zhes pa'i g.yung drung rtags bar gyi yi ge rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉la chad cing / 〈〈snar〉〉la ‘sbyin pa'i rabs kyi smon lam bzhugs/ ra tsho/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes chad pa las yi ge gzhan rnams dpe bsdur byas yod/)1657 ①〈〈snar 〉ra rjed/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉skyod pa/ ①〈〈snar 〉sko4ga bu〈〈snar 〉ra ga'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉5)/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snaྈ 〉〉gyis/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gicig ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra dbang /⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadags/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skogo/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlogs/1658 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes pa'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rgab/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsan| ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srung / dhi〈〈snar 〉thazangs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sde/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamatshan/1659 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/ ④〈〈co 〉〉spyod/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shog116byed1659
bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (69)116wa 1660

3619༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i smon lam bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar 'di dag kun byas te/ /dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bsal 5bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du/ /nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni/ /sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang / /de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste/ /bkres dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal bye snabasal/ /mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe/ /bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur/ /sems can phongs shing dbul ba la/ /bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te/ /yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su/ /mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang / /'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gi/ /khro 'am dad pa'i sems byung na/ /de nyid rtag tu de dag gi /don kun grub thupa'i rgyur gyur 116byed1661

cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /gzhan dag kye gnod pa byed pa 'am/ /de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung / /thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur/ /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang / /rgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni/ /gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur/ /gling don gnyer la gling dang ni/ /gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang / /bdag ni lus can bran 'dod la2/ /kun gyi bran du gyur par shog /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang / /dpag bsam gyi snguni shing dag dang / /lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i thumathas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can khams la rnam kun tu/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ /bdag ni nyer tre'atsho'i gzhir yang shog /bdag gis —byang chub spyod pa la/ /'jug pa rnam par brtsams 3 pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems/ /snyug bsngal nad pa ji snyed pa/ /de dag bdag 6gi bsod nams kyisatshe/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho thob par shog /de dag sangs rgyas bde thob kyi/ /bar du bde las rtsertanyams ma gyur/ /'gro bas bla na med pa yi/ /bde ba rgyun mi 'chad thob shog /'jig rten khams na dmyal ba dag /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /de dag tu muni lus can rnams/ /bde chen nyu/bde bas dga' bar shog /grang bas nyam thag dro thob shog /byang chub sems dpa' sprin chen las/ /byung ba'i chu bo mtha' yas kyis⑩ / /tsha 116—1662

bas nyam thag bsil bar shog /ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal yang / /de la dga' tshal sdug dgur ①shog /shal ma li yi sdong po yang / /dpag bsam shing du 'khrung bar ②shog /thing ril rur pa dag dang ngang pa dang / /bzhad sogs skad snyan 'byin pas mdzes gyur cing / /pad ma dri bsung che ①ldan mtsho dag gis/ /dmyal ba'i sa phyogs dag ni nyams dgar shog /sol phung de yang rin chen phung por gyur/ /sa bsregs shel gyi sa gzhi bstar bar shog /bsdus 'joms ri bo rnams kyang mchod pa yi/ /gzhal med khang gyur bde gshegs gang bar shog /mdag ma rdo bsregs mtshon gyi char pa dag /deng nas bzung ste me tog char par gyur/ /phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs pa de yang ni—/ /deng nas rtse phyir me tog 'phen par shog /chu bo rab med me dong 'dra nang bying ba dag /sha kun zhig gyur rus gong me tog kun da'i mdog /bdag gi dge ba'i stobs kyis lha yi lus thob nas/ /lha mo rnams dang lhan cig dal byis 'bab rjoganas shog /ci phyir 'di ⑤ni gshin rje'i mi dang khra dang bya rgod mi bzad rnams skrag byed/ /kun nas mun bsal bde dga' bskyed pa'i mthu bzang 'di ko su yi yin snyam rjoste/ /gyen du bltas na nam mkha'i dkyil na phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba ⑦bzhugs mthong nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis sdig dang bral nas de dang lhan cig 'gro bar shog /me tog char pa spos chu dang 'dres bab pa yis/ /dmyal ba'i me mdag chil chil gsod par ⑧mthong gyur nas / /glo bur bde bas tshim pa 'di ci bsam ⑨pa dang / /sems dmyal rnams kyis ⑩phyag na pad+ma mthong bar shog /grogs dag 'jigs pa bor la rings par tshur shog 'u bu'i thad du ni/ /gang gi ⑪mthu yis sdug bsngal thams 116—1663

cad bral zhing dga' ba'i shugs phyin la/ /'gro ba kun nas yongs ①skyob byang chub sems ⑤dang brtse ba skyes gyur pa/ /gzhon nu zur phud can 'bar 'jigs pa rnged par byed pa ci zhig phyin/ /khyod kyis lha brgya'i cod pan dag gi zhabs kyi ④pad+ma la mchod cing / /thugs rjes rlan ④spyan dbu la dhime tog du ma'i tshogs kyis char 'bab pa/ /khang brtsegs yid 'ong lha mo stong phrag bstod dbyangs sgrogs ldan 'di ltos zhes/ /'jam dbyangs de 'dra mthong nas da ni sems dmyal ca rjoco 'don par shog /de ltar bdag gi dge rtsas kun tu bzang la sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med sprin bde ba dang //bsil zhing dri zhim ngad ④ldang char pa 'bebs mthong nas/ /sems can dmyal ba de dag mngon par dga' gyur cig /dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig /za ba'i 'jigs dang bral bar shog /sgra mi snyan pa'i mi bzhin du/ /yi dwags rnams ni bde bar gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas shing / /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /long ba rnams kyis gzugs mthong shog /'on pas rtag tu sgra thos ⑧shog /lha mo sgyu 'phrul bzhin du ni/ /sbrum ma gnod med btsa' bar shog /gcer bu rnams kyis ⑨gos dag dang / /bkres pa rnams kyis ⑩zas dang ni/ /skom pa rnams kyis chu dag dang / /btung ba zhim po thob par shog /bkren pa rnams kyis nor thob shog /mya ngan nyam thag dga' thob shog /yi ⑪chad rnams kyang yid ⑫sos shing / /brtan ⑫pa phun sum tshogs par shog /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa/ /myur du nad las thar bar shog /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /116—1664

skrag pa rnams ni 'jigs med shog /bcings pa rnams ni grol bar gyur/ /mthu med rnams ni mthu ldan zhing / /phan tshun sems ni mnyen ①gyur cig /'gron pa dag ni thams cad la/ /phyogs rnams thams cad bde bar shog /gang gi don du 'gro byed pa/ /de 'bad mi dgos grub gyur cig /gru dang gru chen zhugs pa rnams/ /yid la bsam ④pa grub gyur te/ /chu yi ngogs su bde phyin nas/ /gnyen dang lhan cig dga' bar '-ishog /mya ngan lam gol 'khyams pa rnams/ /'gron pa dag dang phrad gyur nas/ /chom rkun stag sogs 'jigs med par/ /mi ngal bde blag 'gro bar shog /dgon sogs lam med nyam nga bar/ /byis pa rgan po mgon med pabu/ /gnyid log myos shing rab myos rnams/ /lha dag srung ba ⑤byed par shog /mi dal kun las thar pa dang / /dad dang shes rab brtser ldan zhing / /zas dang spyod pa phun butshogs nas—/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par—/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /sems can gzi brjid chung ⑦ngu gang / /de dag gzi brjid chen por shog /dka' thub can gang gzugs ngan pa—/ /gzugs bzang phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'jig rten bud med ji snyed pa/ /de dag skyes pa nyid gyur cig /ma rabs rnams ni mtho tshuthob cing /nga rgyal dag kyang bcom par shog /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu dge ba byed par shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing / /bdud 116 1665

kyi las kyang spong bar ①shog /sems can de dag thams cad ni/ /tshe yang dpag med ring bar shog /rtag tu bde bar 'tsho 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba'i sgra yang grag ma gyur/ /dpag bsam shing gi skyed mos tshal/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas sras/ /chos snyan sgrogs pas gang ba yis④/ /phyogs rnams thams cad dga' bar shog /thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ④ltar mnyam bai ḍūr+ya'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas par gyur/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod dgur yang / /byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag /rang gi legs pas sa stengs ④dag /brgyan par mdzad pas bzhugs gyur cig /lus can kun gyi bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang phrad gyur cing / /mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mchod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing / /lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed gyur cig⑤ /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod grub rjopar shog /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /sems can 'ga' yang sdug ma gyur/ /'jigs ⑦dang brnyas pa mi 'byung zhing / /'ga' yang yid mi bde ma gyur/ /gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis brgyan legs gnas shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /bslab pa nya'adod pa'i dge slong dag /dben pa dag kyang thob par shog /g.yeng ba 116—1666

thams cad spangs nas ni/ /sems ni las rung bsgom gyur cig /dge slong ma rnams rnyed ldan zhing / /'thab dang rtsod pa spong bar greshog /de bzhin rab tu byung ba kun/ /tshul khrims nyams pa med gyur cing / /tshul khrims 'chal pas yid byung nas/ /rtag tu sdig pa zad byed shog /bde 'gro dag kyang thob gyur nas/ der yang brtul zhugs mi nyams shog /mkhas pa rnams ni bkur ba dang / /bsod nams dag kyang rnyed par shog /rgyud ni yongs su dag pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun du grags par shog /ngan song sdug bsngal mi stsong zhing / /dka' ba spyad pa med par yang / /lha bas lhag pa'i lus kyis ni/ /de dag sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog② /sems can kun gyis lan mang du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /sangs rgyas bde ba bsam yas kyis②/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 2/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub ①shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /de bzhin rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos rnams kyang bde gyur cig /bdag kyang 'jam dbyangs bka' drin gyis/ /sa rab dga' ba thob bar du/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang / /rab tu byung nyab thob par shog /bdag ni kha zas gyi nas kyang / /nyams dang ldan zhing 'tsho bar shog /tshe rabs kun du dbe+en gnas par⑥/ /phun sum ldan pa thob par shog④ /gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa dang / /cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang / /mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni/ /gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i 2phyir/ /ji 116—1667

ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ①ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid bdag ni gnas gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang ④rung / /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig ①pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed medang bkur ste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las byung duba'i smon lam rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1661 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lam bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i smon lam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/⑤〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi gnod pa/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ba/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaragrub/1662 ha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / ①〈〈snar 〉rabazangs/ ñdzu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ bu〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabs/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma)/ ④〈〈snar 〉mego/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉ra sams/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉dag ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/⑪〈〈pe 〉〉du bde ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tu bde ba/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉can/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉7)/1663 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tur/ rngosnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrungs par/ ①〈〈snar 〉sngagasung chen/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'babs—/ (lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaradir/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉tham/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ ④〈〈snar 〉thar/ ④〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ pe/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sams/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/1664 ngh+ru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkanas yongs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpa' 'od/ zhu〈〈pe 〉stanas zhabs kyis/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gis zhabs kyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlan/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉skom/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthu/ dze+e〈〈snar 〉〉ba/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thos par kwa/1/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yond/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yi/176—1668

tunye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/1665 ①〈〈snar 〉sngaganyen/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉dag par/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sna/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉chu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉torabs rnams kyi thob/〈〈snar 〉torab rnams kyi tho/1666 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spangs par/ ②〈〈snar 〉nyan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'thil/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa dang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragrub/ ⑦〈〈po 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1667 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spangs par/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grub 'gyur/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grub/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabyung / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur cig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya'i/1668 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ②〈〈snar 〉〉du ci'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig du〈〈snar 〉〉snyed/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabyung /bsdur 'bras re'u mig:rdo ཿdzagatha / (dzā/༷)116wa 1669

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pra ṇi d+mā rna/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i sgon lam/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /bdag gis smon lam gdab par bkyi/ /ji srid nam mkha' srid pa dang / /byang chub mthar thug ji srid par/ /de srid dus su'ang rtag par bdag /sangs rgyas rnams la gus par shog /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus su bdag /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyan sngar ni/ /rgyud rnams thams cad mnyan par bgyi/ /'dod pa lnga rnams longs spyad pas/ /rnam bkra rdo rje'i mchod pa yis / /lus gnas bde ba chen po la/ /skye ba kun tu mchod par shog /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad/ /rig ma lha mo yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje theg par gnas sems kyis/ /rdo rje chags pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rdo rje'i 116—1670

glu ni legs blangs shing / /rdo rje'i gar gyis gar byas te/ /rdo rje tshogs dpal dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rol pa dag bgyi 'o/ /rdo rje theg pa rab rtogs pa'iske/ /mchog gi byang chub thob nas bdag /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus su nirka/ /ma lus bskal par gnas par shog /byang chub sems kyi chus bkrus shing / /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan byas nas/ /der gnas bla na med pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /rdo rje theg pa mngon par mjes/ /lus pa med pa yongs su chub/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba las/ /'khor lo rtag tu mthong bar shog /mi gang gis ni mthong tsam gyis/ /lta ba ngan las grol 'gyur ba/ /thub pa chen pos legs gsungs pa'i/ /rgyud rnams bdag gis bstan par bgyi/ /rdo rje las rab sbyor ba yis/ /sems can rnams la rtag pa ru/ /rdo rje ral gri rnon pos ni/ /smra po'i ye shes spro bar bgyi/ /rdo rje'i skye ba'i tshul sna tshogs/ /ched du rdo rje'i gar ston pas/ /sems can rnams kyi mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams 'byung ba gcad par bgyi/ /sna tshogs las dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /gdug pa gdul dka' cher 'khrugs pa'i/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa dang / /'gro ba thams cad gdul bar bgyi/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje slob dpon rnam par 'phrul/ /rab gtum khro bo'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus pa med par gdul bar bgyi/ /gus pas rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /ji ltar rigs par slob bgyi zhing / /sems la dub pa med par bdag /sems can kun gyi don bgyi'o/ /mang du sgon lta ci zhig 'tshal/ /bla ma la bdag gus gyur cig /rdo rje slob dpon rnams la bdag /gong nas gong du gus bgyir gyur/ /gang las gnyis dbye kun bral 116—1671

ba'i—/ /de nyid ye shes 'thob nyid na/ /de phyir rgyun chad med pa yi/ /yid kyis gus pa kho nar shog /rdo rje'i smon lam btab pa las/ /dge ba bdag gis nyer bsags gang / /des ni rdo rje lta bu yi/ /'gro kun rdo rjer snang gyur cig /dpal klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i smon lam rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i dbang phyug dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas dang / de nyid kyi bka' drin las legs par sbyar ba'i tshul cung zad rig pa/ dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya bas dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du bsgyur ba'o/ /'dis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du rten 'di nyid la rdo rje'i smon lam rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin par gyur cig/ //bsdur mchan/167༷ kyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉rang dpe bsdur byas yod/116 ——1672
bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (71) 116wa 1673

3621༄ga /byang chub 'byung ba'i smon lam/khyo ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo bye ā ñtshaka ra pra ṇi dh+wa na/ bod skad du/byang chub 'byung ba'i smon lam/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /log rtog mun bsal mkhyen rab 'dab rgyas shing / /bdud bzhi'i dgra bcom yang dag ji bzhin gshegs/ /thugs rje'i mtsho bskyil don mchog 'byor pa'i gter/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar mtshan gred rab zhi rtog las 'das/ /sgrib pa'i ṅkuskyon bral legs tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas/ / skye bo 'gro jemang byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas4/ /yang dag dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs dgra rgyal srid mtsho las rgal cing 6/ /sbug bsngal mtshon spangs yang dag thar lam mkhyen/ /'gro la phan mdzad yon tan mang po'i phul/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings mkha' dkyil mkhyen rab nyi shar nas/ /116—1674

rmongs pa'i mun bsal yang dag chos nyid rtogs/ /thabs ldan thugs rjes 'gro la phan brtson pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo rin chen sa gzhi dpag bsam nags tshal bcas/ /yid bzhin gzhal yas gdan khri rgyan mchog ldan/ /lha mi'i mchod sprin mang bo gtibs pa rnams/ /yon tan gter mnga' sras bcas rgyal la 'bul/ /dus kun bdag gis dkon mchog gsum spangs shing / /de yi bskor rmyephyogs byang chub sems btang dang / /mtshams ②med la sogs smad pa'i las byas rnams— / /bla ma'i spyan sngar de bshags slan chad bsdams / /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa' so so'i skye bo yi/ /bsod nams rgyu dang 'bras bcas ci mchis pa/ /de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs gang 'gro la sman slad bde gshegs rnams/ /mya ngan 'dar bzhed chos bshad bsgul gzhes la/ /'gro ba'i don slad la5mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul/ /skyon kun byang zhing yon tan kun rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dkon mchog la/ /bdag ni dus kun lus 'bul skyabs gsol gyis / /yongs bzhes log lta'i lam las bskyab tu 6gsol/ /bdag gis ghu /'gro ba'i nyon mongs bsal slad dang / /byang chub spyad pa'i bcom ldan gdung bsab hūṃphyir/ /bdag med rtog bral mi gnas rtag pa yi/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu 9 dus kun bskyed1 / /phyogs dus bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs / /khyod la bdag gi 11sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / /dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed pa'i/ /bslab gsum deng nas brtsams te gzung shārtabar bgyi/ /bsod nams stobs 'dis chos 1naganas thams cad la/ bla med 116—1675

mchod sprin 'byung zhing bgyi bgyis 1shog /sems can rnams kyang sgrib tshogs kun byang nas/ /yon tan tshogs rdzogs kun mkhyen mchog gyur cig /bdag kyang dus kun blo rnams snying rje ldan/ /ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs sgo mchog thob nas/ /'gro 3snakun bder 'gyur spyod mchog rnams byed cing / /chos rnams mtshan nyid ji bzhin rtogs gyur cig /bsdu ba bzhis bsdus pha rol phyin rdzogs shing / /mos spyod la sogs sa rnams kun sbyangs nas/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib tshogs rnams 4spangs te/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs sdogs sangs rgyas gyur/ /bdag ni mthong thos reg pa'am dran tsam gyis/ /'gro kun nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi byed shog /lus sems ngag rnams spyod yul cir 'jug pa/ /srog chags rnams la bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig /dus kun bdag gis lus ngag yid kun nas/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad ci bsags pa/ /dus gsum rgyal bas 5ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin/ /thams cad bla med byang chub myur 'grub bsngo/ /byang chub 'byung ba'i smon lam slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //116byed1676

༄ga /btsun pa zla ba'i tshen lam zhes bya ba/rtesna༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsan+d+ra go mi pra ṇi dh+wa na nā ma/ bod skad du/btsun pa zla ba'i smon lam zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i las ni nyam nga yis/ /gang dang gang du nyer skye ba/ /de dang der ni skyes pa dang / /dad dang dbang po tshang ba dang / /bzo dang sgyu 2rtsal kun mngon shes/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs snyemed dang / /'dod pa kun la rgyab phyogs shing / /dngos kun yongs su gtong ba dang / /dran dang ldan zhing bden smra dang / /sems can rnams kyis mthong na dga'/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / /dul ba'i spyod dang yang dag ldan/ /blo bzang skye ba gtsang ma dran/ /sdig pa'i las la 'jigs byed pas/ /spyod pa ④dge ba'i spyod yul can/ /mthar yang bla med rtogs pa yis5/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu bsten pas/ /'gro la 116—1678

gcig tu bde ba yi/ /g.yo med mgon po thob par gyur/ /bdag ni bran dang mor ma gyur/ /blun dang yul ngan skye ba dang / /sangs rgyas 'byung la sgog ma gyur/ /nam khyedu'ang lta ba log ma gyur/ /'dod med tshul ldan sangs rgyas rgyuraldu/ /pha rol 'dod pa'i rdzas longs spyod/ /sems can nyam thag byed 'gyur ba'i/ /'dod pa'i slong mo snyebadag mi spyod/ /sems can rnams la byams goms shing / /rgyu med rang bzhin sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems 'gro ba'i 'bras mi lta/ /rigs chen blo nor skye ba dang / /skye ba skye bar lus mdzes shing / /bde thugashegs mang po'i snyan ngag byed/ /skye zhing skye ba dang ldan par/ /gang du sangs rgyas lhar byed pa'i/ /rigs der bdag ni skye ba dang / /skye ba dang ni skye ba ru/ /chos lnga po ni mi spong zhing / /bsod nams ye shes stobs dang ni/ /brtson 'grus byang chub sems lnga po/ /ji ltar thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /zhabs thob pa yi thabs de bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis hūṃthabs kyis ni/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i zhabs thob shog /btsun pa zla ba'i smon lam zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas chen po nye ba'i 'thung gcod dpal bal po yam 'ubu'i grong khyer du/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dze+e ta kar+ṇa'i )zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //116—1679

bsdur mchan/1678 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torajig du〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/1679 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thos/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bder/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thum/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skadar+sā'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna ཿ1gas/ (73)116wa 1680

362na༄ga /'phags pa klu sgrub kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/71)༄༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya nā gā rdzu na pra ṇi dh+wa (kyen nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor bar 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du/ /chos la bzod pa ma thob bar du ni/ /ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye zhing / /mtho ris mi yi lus su skye bar shog /mtho ris mi yi lus su skyes nas kyang / /sdig spyod rgyal por ma skye blon po dang / /dmag dpon zhal che gcod par bdag ma skyeske/ /khe byed til brdung chang 'tshong (4 rkun po dang / /bran dang bran mo'i lus su bdag ma skye/ /dge slong gnas la dbang byed bdag po dang / /gnas brtan las byed pa dang ngan 'ukhrims pa/ /dge skos gtsang sbyor ba dang dam bzhag pa/ /gang zag las byed rnams su bdag ma skye/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo'i ge skye ba'i yul rnams dang / /glen lkugs 'on long phrag dog can rnams 116—1681

dang / /mu stegs log lta ①bram ze'i rigs rnams dang / /rigs ngan shan ①pa'i rigs su bdag ma skye/ /byang chub ma thob bar du rtag par bdag /dam chos spyod pa'i lus su skye bar shog /dam chos spyod pa'i lus su skyes nas kyang / /mi dge gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'gyur zhing / /tshe la nad kyis bar chad ①med pa dang / /skyes ma thag tu chos dang phrad par shog /skyes ma thag tu chos dang phrad nas kyang / /mnyan bsam dubasgom pas rig pa'i rgyud sbyangs nas⑤/ /ting 'dzin rtse gcig sems la dbang thob ste/ /rnam shes drug po yul la g.yengs ma gyur/ /lus kyi yan lag rgyas shing skyon med de/ /dbang po ma nyams rigs mtho bsgur ⑨ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas chos kun rdzogs ④par byed pa dang / /gzhon nur ⑧rab byung tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /dge bshes mchog rnams rtag tu bsten byed cing / /sa bcu rim gyis bgod rnams thogs med de/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /bla med byang chub myur du thob nas kyang / /rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad la/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don byed par shog /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //116—1682

bsdur mchan/1681 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi smon lam bzhugs so//zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉bha/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyod/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyang chang tshong / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gro/1682 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bshan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacod/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkur/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉rdzog ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (7zhe'i)116wa 1683

3624༄ga /rgyal po la gtam bya ba rin po che'i phreng ba las drung ba'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa bzhugs so//①༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la stiphyag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir sku gzugs mchod rten gyi/ /spyan snga'am yang na gzhan du'ang rung / /tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu 'di/ /nyin gcig bzhin yang dus gsum brjod/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /rnam kun btud de skyabs mchis nas/ /mchod 'os rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa'i las ni ldog bgyed cing / /bsod nams thams cad yongs su gzung ④/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams dag /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag ni spyi btud thal sbyar te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad dang / /'gro gnas bar du bzhugs slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyi ba'i 4bsod nams dang / /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyang / /bla med byang chub sems ldan shog /116——1684

sems can thams cad dri med dbang / /yongs rdzogs mi khom kun 'das shing //spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang / /tshor ①ba bzang dang ldan par shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang / /lag na rin ⑤chen nyid ldan zhing ④/ /yo byad thams cad mtha' yas pa/ /'khor ba srid du mi zad shog /bud med thams cad dus kun du/ /skyes mchog nyid du gyur par ④shog /lus can thams cad rig pa dang / /rkang par ldan pa nyid du shog /lus can kha dog ldan pa dang / /gzugs bzang gzi brjid che ba dang / /blta na sdug cing nad med dang / /stobs can tshe dang ldan par shog /thams cad thabs la mkhas gyur te—/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol bar bya⑪/ /sangs rgyas chos nor che ldan shog /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /nyon mongs btang snyoms gnas pa dang / /sbyin dang tshul dzams bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyis brgyan cing / /tshogs ke rnams thams cad yongs ④rdzogs te/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab sa bcu dag /rgyun mi 'chad par bgrod par shog /bdag kyang yon tan de dag dang / /gzhan kun gyis kyang brgyan ldan te/ /nyes pa kun las grol ba dang / /sems can kun mchog byams pa dang / /sems can kun yid re ba yi/ /dge ba thams cad rdzogs bgyid cing / /rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal bsal 8par bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang / /su dag 'jigs pas skyo ba ste9/ /bdag gi ming tsam thos pas kyang / /shin tu 'jigs pa med par shog /bdag ni mthong dang dran pa dang / / mi gtsang thos pa'i skye bo kun/ /rab dang 116 —1685

'khrug med rnal ma dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges pa dang / /tshe rabs kun du rjes 'brang ba'i/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam kun du/ /rtag tu phan bde bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo 4stegang / /sdig pa byed par ②'dod gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad gnod med par/ /rtag tu cig car zlog gyur cig /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis①/ /rang dgar dgag med spyod par shog /sems can rnams la srog bzhin ④phangs//bdag la de dag ches phangs shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /de skad brjod pa'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de ni gzugs can gyur/ /gang gā'i gebye ma snyed kyis spyoni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal po la gtam bya ba rin po che'i phreng ba pelas byung ④ba'i sgon lam gye tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa rdzogs so// //116—1686

3625ra༅/ /rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/①༄s+dza/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku la pra ṇi dh+wa na ④nā ma/ bod skad du/rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /dbang po gsal bar 'chi ba dang / /gnad gcod sdug bsngal med pa dang / /srid pa bar ma do ru yang / /rang byung ye shes rtogs par shog /rang byung ye shes rtogs nas kyang / /gar skye rang dbang yod par shog /gang der skyes pa'i sa der yang / /nyon mongs mtha' dag chung ba yi/ /chos ldan rigs su bya bar shog /chos ldan rigs su skyes nas kyang / /chos ldan grogs dang phrad par 4shog /chos ldan grogs dang phrad nas kyang / /gtso bo dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /sdom pa gsum la gnas par shog /sdom pa gsum la gnas nas kyang / /stong nyid dam pa bsgom 5pa dang / /thos pa'i chos rnams dran par shog /thos pa'i chos rnams dran nas kyang / /6rang don gtso bor mi 116 1688

byed cing / /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog /sdug bsngal bdag la smin nas kyang / /lus ngag sems la mi gnod cing / /mtshan ma'i ①spyod pas mi g.yel ba'i/ /gzhan don dmigs pa'i sems kyis su/ /gzhan don thams cad byed par shog /gzhan don thams cad mthar phyin nas/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog /rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1688 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ④〈〈snar 〉wu/ (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skosgom/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skotheg pa chen po'i don rtogs nas//1689 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (76)— ——— 116————1689

byed /bsngo ba shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/①byed/ /bdag ni sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rnyed dka'i sangs rgyas nyid thob nas//rab med srid pa'i rgya mtsho las//sems can ma lus grol ②bar shog /ces bya ba ni slob dpon btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i ①bsngo ba shin tu bsdus pa yin no//paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī las bsgyur ba'o// //6byed690
bsdur mchan/169༷ ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrol/①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna ཿ1gas/ (77)116wa 1691

༄ / /rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las drung ba'i smon lam bzhugs/①༄s+dza/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i lam 'jug yang dag par/ /sbyar las bsod nams tshad med gang / /de yis 'gro kun rgyal ba yi/ /lam la legs par 'jug par shog /bdag gis ②bsod nams 'di yis ni/ /nam mkha' kun khyab skye bo rnams/ /ngan 'gro kun las nges grol zhing / /mi khom thams cad rnam par spangs/ /skye ba ①lha dang mi yi ni / /skye ba yongs su thob par shog /srid pa gesdug bsngal gyis skrag pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /dam chos nyan sems don bsgom '-idang / /sems ni dben par gnas par shog /theg pa chen po la gnas te/ /tshangs pa'i spyod dang ldan par shog /lam kun rnam par bsgom pa yis sa la sogs pa kun thob nas/ /zhing kun yang dag sbyangs nas ni/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ji ltar 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su/ /bsam 116—— 1692

pa'i don kun thams cad ni/ /nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin ༄1mkha' nyid nas/ /sems can kun la 'byung bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar gnas pa'i//'jig rten khams ni de dag rnams/ /don kun 'jig rten khams bzhin du/ /de ltar thams cad dag par shog /bdag kyang byang chub snying po'i bar/ /zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos dang / /byams pas sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsam kun yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /rtag pa nyid du tshangs spyod dang / /sdom pa kun byis bsdams par shog /sems can don kun byed pa dang / /chos kun don ni ston par shog /'jig snyen khams ni sems can kun/ /gang la gnod pa byed kyang ni/ /bdag ni de dag thams cad la/ /phan 'dogs byed pa nyid du shog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsran nas bdag /rtaka par sems can don la brtson/ /(gesems ni dam chos bsam gtan la/ /ro gcig brtan pa nyid du shog /ji ltar brtson ldan brtson 'grus bzhin/ /bdag kyang go cha sbyar blub dang / /de bzhin mi sdog pa zhes pa'i/ /brtson 'grus dang ni ldan par shog /nying 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /tshogs kyi byang chub ⑤bsgrub pa yis( dā/ /bsam gtan kun la gcig tu gnas/ /bdag sems rdo rje lta bur shog /shes rab nam mkha'i mtha' 7khyab pa/ /rdo rje yi ni mtshan nyid dang / /rab mthun kun dga' (8tshogs dang ni/ /steng rje'i ro yis nges gang zhing / /thabs dang smon lam de bzhin du/ /stobs ni rab tu sbyor ⑨ba dang / /ye shes bdag nyid 'di dag ni/ /bdag la rnam par dag par shog /mngon shes kun gyi phar phyin te/ /khyad par lam ni thob par shog /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam sbyang zhing / /bdag ni sangs rgyas nyid kyur cig /116— 1693

'di nyid kyis ni rim pa yis/ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can kun/ /myur du rgyal ba nyid du shog /bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba 'di/ /bdag nyid kyis ①ni blo yis byas/ /kun nas kun tu ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mkhyen pas na/ /kun du bzang po zhes bgyi ba'i/ /smon lam rgya mtsho ji lta ba/ /de bzhin du ni bdag la yang / /dge ba rgya mtsho de myur du/ /'bras bu dang ni bcas par shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha' ②kun khyab pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rgyal rnams shar④/ /de dag ji ltar smon lam ni/ /sngon du byas pa'i ④rim pa rnams/ /de tsam nyid du bdag gis kyang / /bsam pa brtan dhipa de bzhin bgyi/ /bsod nams mthu yis 'di dag no/ /de bzhin du ni grub par shog /ji ltar dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /smon lam de bzhin bdag gis yang ⑥/ /dus ni yun mi ring ba yis/ /smon lam 'di ni rdzogs par shog /sangs rgyas kun rnams rang rang gi/ /zhing bzhugs mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /mkha' mnyam chos kyi char gyis ni/ /rtag tu sems can tshim byed shog /sems can rnams kyang sangs rgyas chos/ /dge 'dun bcas pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas mchod sprin mtha' yas pas/ /yang dag par ni mchod byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /'jig rten khams kun gang bar shog /mchog gi chos rnams sems 'gyur zhing / /srid pa sbyong bar ṣ+ṭa༄byed par shog /paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las byung ⑧ba'i smon lam rdzogs so// //116 —1694

bsdur mchan/1692 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉la rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa'i las 'byung ba'i smon lam bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈snar 〉nyago/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/1693 ①〈〈pe 〉sngaradzin/ ②〈〈snar 〉skaradzin nam/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/sems can don la brtson/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyor/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrubs pa yi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉mthas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mkhas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dga'i/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabyor/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyangs te/1694 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkha'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gang / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gra ba'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉togatan/ 〈〈co 〉〉brten/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag bdag yi rang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyung /bsdur 'bras re'u migasna sna1gatha / (78)116wa 1695

3628༄ga /smon lam bdun cu pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/tshusngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra ṇi dh+wa na sap+ta nyi nā ma gā thā/ bod skad du—/ smon lam bdun cu pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rin chen dpag med tshogs mnga' zhing / /nyes pa'i dug sdong mtha' dag drung ⑤phyung ba/ /phyogs bcu dag na dus gsum bzhugs pa yirte/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib sel mdzad pa'i/ /bag la nyal ba'i mda' dug 'byen pa'i thabs/ /'gro ba gsum po kun gyi blo gros kyi/ /mig 'byed pa yi chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs sras po dge 'dun mi bzlog papa/ /thugs rje chen pos yid ni drangs gyur te/ /blo can bye bar gyur pa ma lus la/ /rgyun mi 'chad 5par mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba rnams su bdag gis mi dge gang / /cung zad bgyis sam bgyid sprul 6rjes yi rang / /116 1696

rgyal ba rnams la de dag bshags nas ni/ /be+en chad mi bgyid pa yi sdom pa nod / /bde ①gshegs rang rgyal dang ni nyan thos dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis dge ba bsags pa dang / /'jig rten pa yis kyilegs par spyad pa bzhin//ma lus pa yang ①bdag ni yi rang ngo / /skye bo nyon mongs dug gis mgo rmongs pa—/ /de ④dag rnams la mi dge gang mchis pa/ /de ni bdag nyid kho na dga' bzhin du/ /ci nas dmyal ba rnams su gzhol bar bgye/ /'jig rten rab zhi bde ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /tshim nas yid ni dge ba gebagyed gyur cig /'gro ba dag rjogi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /de ni bdag gis dang du len par shog/'gro ba 'di dag yid la myur du ni/ /yang dag byang chub nyid ni skye gyur cig /yid la byang chub dag ni bskyed pa dag /byang chub tshogs rnams yang dag sgrub par shog /dge ba'i tshogs sgrub ṣ+ṭanas ni sa thob cing / /srid pa gsum gyi mgon po'i gdung bzung nas/ /dgra rnams bcom nas 'jig rten gsum dag na⑧ / /chos kyi rgyal srid chen po'i gnas thob shog /byang chub shing drung sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /nyin zhag ji snyed gzhes shing bzhugs pa dag /dpe ma mchis pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char/ /'gro la dbab pa'i be+ed du gsol bar bgyi/ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs byas 9nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog te ⑩gshegs pa gang / /gzhan la phan pa mdzad cing yun ring du—/ /bzhugs par blo bzang de la gsol bar bgyi/ /'jig rten gsum po thibs po der rgyu ba'i/ /sems can su dag ji snyed mchis pa dag /de dag rab tu zhi ba'i bde ba yi/ /bdud rtsi'i longs spyod mgron /1du gnyer bar bgyi//de ltar dge ba gang dag bsgrubs pa 'di/ /ma lus yang dag byang chub bsngo bar 776 /697

bgye / /des ni bdag ni byang chub sems dang ni/ /skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /ji srid phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang ma mnan pa/ /de srid du ni thub pa'i khyu mchog dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang bral 3ma gyur/ /de ②dag kho nas gzhan la dman 1pa yi/ /spyod pa'i lam dag nye bar bstan pa la/ /skyo ba ma mchis par ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /sras kyi kun la yang ④ni sbyar bar bgyi/ /bdag gi lus kyi yan lag nying lag dag /tshang zhing skye bo kun gyis bstod 'os pa'i/ /yon tan phung po tshe rabs dran pa dang / /cho rigs btsun zhing lus ni mdzes par shog /gzhan phan spong zhing rang don lhur len pa/ /tha chad dug dang 'dra ba spangs nas su/ /snying rjes gdungs pa'i yid kyis ⑤skye bo kun/ /gcig tu gzhol bar rjes su 'dzin par shog /bdag gis ④bdog pa rnams la gzhan gyis peblo/ /gzhan gyi nor snyam (nyecung zad mi 'dzin cing / /rang gi nor la som nyi ma mchis ltar/ /bag yangs dag tu len cing spyod par shog /bdag gi sha zhig slong ba mchis na yang / /brod la 'dzum pa'i mig gis stsal bar bgyi/ /bdag gi rkang la sogs pa rtag tu yang / /lus can rnams kyi don du tsugatong bar shog /bdag ni yid bzhin nor bus 'gro ba yi/ /'dod pa'i dngos po mtha' dag sgrub pa dang / /yid la re ba yongs rdzogs bgyid pa yi/ /dpag bsam gyi ni shing dang 'dra bar shog /bdag ni rang gi ngang gis sdig pa dag /mi gtsang ba ltar rgyang ring spong ba dang / /thub pa'i skyes mchog gis ni bslab bcas pa'i/ /chu lon 'dral bar bgyed ⑩ par ma gyur cig /lus dang srog la lta ba rgyang bsring 11nas/ /rtag par dgon pa rnams su dga' bar 776 /6()8

bgyi—/ /rnyed pa dag dang bkur ste mtha' dag la/ /slon pa'i zas bzhin blo ni bzlog par bgyi/ /'gro ba rnams la gdol pa'i phru sgogu bzhin/ /rgyags dang nga rgyal dregs pa spangs pa dang / /rigs btsun gupa yi nye du'i tshogs bzhin du/ /rjes su mthun pa sgrub cing spyad par bgyi/ /zla zer pad+ma rtsa lag dri ma bral/ /ma ral ma 'dres nag nog ma mchis la/ /ma lus rab tu zhi ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /tshul khyems la ni bdag ni 5goms par bgyi/ /su dag nongs ma mchis par bdag gi mgo/ /sog les tshal pa brgyar ni gshags (ga bkyid kyang / /de la'ang bu gcig gces pa bzhin du 'ang sape/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sems ni phangs par bgyi/ /su dag snying nas bdag la khros gyur te/ /dgos pa ma mchis bzhin du srog 'phrog na'ang / /de la'ang las kyi 'bras bu mi bzad par⑥/ /mi 'tshal ba dag 'byung bar ma gyur cig /khro ba dang ni gshe dang mtshang 'bru dang / /brdeg 3par gyur kyang bzod pa mi btang ste/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa sgrub 4/pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal ma lus pa dag dang du blang / /sngon chad rnyed ma pyong ba thub pa'i chos/ /shin tu zab cing rigs pa'i mchog la yang / /bdag gis 0sems la skad cig tsam yang ni/ /som nyi'i dpyang ⑩thag g.yo bar ma gyur cig /bdag gi skye ba tshe rabs tshe rabs su//'gro ba kun la sman pa lhur spyod kyisatse/ /skad cig tsam yang dge ba rgya chen po/ /bgyid par mi 'gyur bar ni ma gyur cig /bran dang 'dra bar 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bgyi ba ma lus pa dag bsgrub par bgyi/ /bdag gis kun gyis thubagyi ba'i khur spangs yinas/ /sems can rnams ni bde bar gnas par wīshog /lus ni gzhan gyi bran bgyid tshig smra na'ang / /gzhan la chos ston pa la dga' 779/ /6()()

ba dang / /bdag gi yid kyang rtag tu gzhan dag la/ /phan par sems pa'i dbang du bgyid par shog /gal te dmyal bar bskal pa grangs med du/ /gcig tu sdug bsngal nyams su myong na yang / /'on kyang skyo ba dag ni ma mchis par / /sems can yongs su smin par bgyid par shog /gcig nas sgrub ①pa'i rim pa zhu'adi nyid kyis/ /lus can rnams ni 'dul bar bgyi ④slad du/ /'gro ba gsum po yongs su smin bgyid pa'itshu)/ /go cha 'di nyid kyang ni bgo dubar bgyi/ /me yi 'dag 6mas bar mtshams ma mchis pa'i/ /'obs rnams gang las brgal nas legs gsungs pa'i/ /tshig gcig tsam yang mnyan pa'i ched du ni/ /le lo ma mchis spro ba bgyid par shog /bsam gtan gzugs gred nying 'dzin mtha' dag ni7/ /'bras bu rnams la dga' ba spangs nas ni/ /rab tu mthar phyin pa yi gnas pa yis/ /dga' bar 'gyur ba dag tu goms par bgye/ /zhen pa ma mchis zhi gnas rta zhon nas/ /rang bzhin g.yo ba'i sems kyi glang po che/ /shin tu gdul bar dka' ba log pa yi/ /lam du zhugs pa rnams ni 'dul 8bar bgyi/ /lha dbang dag dang 'khor los sgyur ba yi / /'byor pa dam pa mchog shedag mchis pa rnams/ /'dod pa'i rang bzhin mi gtsang ba bzhin du/ /bdag gi yid ni ltos pa ma mchis shog /lcags kyi khang pa 'bar ba 'dra ba yis/ /sreg ⑫par rgyu bar bdag ni dgar ma gyur / /snying rjes drangs nas /mgazhan la sman pa dag /bgyis 7par rjes su mthun par skye bar shog /'gro ba'i mgon gyi sras po thams cad kyi/ /ting 'dzin gang zhig la ni dbang brnyes pas/ /rnam par bsgyings pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /dpa' bo rol pa sna tshogs mdzad pa yis7/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba 7/6 /7()()

dag dang nam mkha'i mdzod/ /dri med la sogs ma lus thob bgyis kyenas/ /'gro ba gsum po ma lus pa dag gis/ /bde ba gya nom bsgrubs nas cher kyesprul to—/ /bzo dang bstan bcos sgyu rtsal rgya mtsho dag /mchog tu pha mtha' phul du phyin pa dang / /sems can thams cad kyis ni tshig gi don/ /ma lus pa dag rtogs shing mkhas par shog /tshig don ma lus spyod pa'i shes rab ni/ /dri med rnon po dpag tu med thob nas/ /sems can rnams la shin tu zab pa yi/ /rigs pa'i chos rnams kyi ni bgo ③bsha' bgyi/ /sangs rgyas gsung dag mthar phyin ma rtogs pa'i/ /sems can ma lus pa ni mtha' dag la/ /sems la yi ge bris pa 'dra bar ni/ /mang po dag ④gis rab tu bstan par bgyi/ /ci nas 'bras bur bcas pa'i stobs bcu yis(5)/ /go 'phang mngon par 'dzegs nas 'gro ba'i don/ /ma tshang ma lus 'bras mchis bgyid pa yi/ /thabs kyis (6 spyod pa de dag bsgrub par bgyi/ /ji lta ji ltar sems can phan pa'i rgyu/ /thub pa rnams kyi smon lam ma lus pa/ /de lta de ltar rgyun du smon lam gyi/ /pha rol phyin pa dag ni thob par bgyi/ /yul gyi dgra yi tshogs ni mi bzad pa/ /mod la ma lus ci dgar zil mnan nas/ /sems kyi spyod pa rnams ni mi g.yo zhing / /sa steng phan pa kho nas gnas par bgyi/ /chos 'di dag ni sgyu ma smig 7rgyu dang / /sprul pa lta bur yang dag rtogs bgyis nas/ /rtog pa'i dri ma rnams ni spangs nas su/ /'jig rten gsum la phan par 8bgyed gyur cig /pha dag bu gcig lhag par gces pa bzhin/ /nag nog ma lus pa dag spangs nas su/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /byams pa'i bsgom pa dag gis gnas par bgyi/ /ji ltar ma dag brtse ba'i khur lci (ba'i/ /bu na 776 /70/

ba la rjes su mthun spyod pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang 'gro ba sems can la/ /snying rjes rgyas 'gyur so sor bgyid par shog /pha rol bde ba'i 'byor pa mthong nas ni/ /lhag par dga' ba mang po skyes nas su/ /steng gi bu gcig pa la bde skyed 0༄bzhin/ /dga' ba'i bsgom tshu༄pa dag gis gnas par bgyi/ /sems can rnams la phan dang gnod pa'i rgyu/ /khong khro rjes su chags pa spangs nas ni/ /rang gi bu la bgyi ba bsgrub pa bzhin/ /'jig rten gsum po kun gyi bgyi ba bsgrub/ /dbang dang mngon shes so sor rig pa dang / /gzungs dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo rtogs nas/ /'jig rten khams ni dpag tu ma mchis pa'i/ /sems can rnams la phan pa dus gcig bgyi/ /sangs rgyas zhes bgyi'i sgra ni rna lam du/ /thos ma gyur pa'i yul khams gang lags pa/ /der ni thabs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs kyisabla/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa dag dang mthun par bgye/ /nam zhig 'jig rten 'dir ni srid gsum kyi/ /bla ma nyi ma shar bar ma gyur par4/ /der ni bdag gis nyi ma bzhin du di/ /lus can kun gyi rab rib bsal bar bgyi/ /bde gshegs rab tu mang pos spangs pa yi/ /yid dag sdig pas sbags pa gang ༄nyalags pa'i/ /'gro ba de ni bdag gi tshig dag gis6/ /spyod yul rnams la brten nas 'dul bar shog /bdag ni 'jig rten ma lus pa dag gis/ /bsnyen bkur bgyid pa dag la nye du dang / /byams la mdza' bshes ma bzhin sgrub pa dang / /pha bzhin phan pa'i gdams ngag 'doms 7par shog /bdag gi ming ni dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'gro ba ma lus pa dag 'jigs pa lasagu/ /mod la skyob par 4)gyur cig srid gsum gyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus pa dag spong bar shog /phongs pa brgya phrag 776 /702

bsten ①pa'i mi dag la/ /bum pa bzang dang nad pa'i sman dag ni/ /yi dwags sogs la rgyun mi 'chad par yang / /bdud rtsi'i chab kyi rdzing bu bzang por shog /bdag ni grang ba'i dmyal bar dro ba dang / /tsha bar rdzi char bcas pa'i char 'be+ebs shing / /gzhan yang shin tu smad pa'i ngan 'gro dag /gnod pa ma lus zhi bar bgyid par shog /'gro bas bdag ni dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /phongs pa mngon sum gyur la gnyen bshes dang / /nyam thag mda' char 'bab la gos ②sra dang / /mya ngan mi rngo/༄la bsil ba'i chab gyur cig /'gro ba dag gis dran na nyon mongs pa'i/ /dug gi gnyen por gyur cing srid gsum gyi/ /chu bo dag la zam pa brtan po dang / /ngan song gnas kyi sgo gtan bgyid par shog /bdag gi ming tsam dran na'ang 'jus pa bzhin/ /'gro ba ma lus srid pa'i g.yang sa ru/ /lhung ba zhi ba dag gi rtse mo la /'jeg par gyur pa'i 0jem skas gzhir bgyur byug /skad cig tsam yang khro zhi dag ⑥gi ming / /blo la dran pa tsam zhig bgyid na yang (pe/ /ngan song rnams su ldang bar mi 'gyur zhing / /nges par byang chub yang dag sgrub par shog /bdag gi yon tan zla zer dri med ltar/ /'jig rten ma lus pa la bder 8gyur cig /dbugs tsam phyung ba rnams kyang pha rol la/ /bde ba dpag med skyed par bgyid par shog /shin tu phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa/ /mthar phyin pa yi sangs rgyas nyid thob nas/ /dam pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kho na la/ /'gro ba ma lus pa yang sbyar bar bgyi/ / de yi 9tshe na su yi sems la yang / /nyes byas phran tshegs tsam yang mi 'byung la/ /skye bo gzhan la rgyun du phan byed 7cing / /dge ba bcu yi lam la gnas par shog /su yang rung ste ngan song gnas rnams ni//716 703

rmi lam na yang mthong bar mi 'gyur zhing / /ngan 'gro rnams kyi gnas ni mtha' dag kyang / / lha yi tsa)'jig rten bzhin du dga' bar shog /ji srid 'jig rten gsum gyi mi dge ba'i/ /mtsho klung dbus su 'ga' zhig chud na yang / /sangs rgyas bgyi ba yongs su mthar phyin kyang / /de srid de yi ched du bsdad par bgyi / /bdag ni mya ngan 'das 'gro ston pa na/ /gsung rab rnams ni 'khrug par mi 'gyur zhing / /de la 'ga' yang som nyi'i dpyang ⑤thag la/ /skad cig tsam yang 'ju bar ma gyur cig /de ltar rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam 'phrul la/ /mngon dgas bdag gis dge ba bsgrubs sdepa gang / /des duni 'gro ba ma lus de dag gi /ma lus par ni thun mong 'gyur bar shog /slob dpon btsun pa gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs dgon pa pa gsung rab mtha' dag chub par byas pa stag 6gis rang la baspyon 7te nags khyang du phyin pa na snying rjes gdung ba'i yid kyis 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa'i smon lam bdun cu pa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta dhah+ma 8 shrī pra bhā dang / lo tsā ba bsde dpal gyi 4rtelhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //
