༄ga /spob dpon kā ma la shī la'i smon lam mu gnyis ma bzhugs/①༄4/ /dkon mchog gsum la ②phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la brten nas sems bskyed ②pa'i/ /dri ma med pa'i sbyin pa la/ /brten nas yon bdag dunyid grol te/ /de la yon bdag ⑤mi re zhing / /'jig rten re ba zhi bar shog /sgo gsum dri ma med pa yi/ /tshul khrims rgyan dang ldan par shog /sbyin pa 'di yi byen rlabs kyis/ /rtag tu longs spyod ldan par shog /longs spyod de la ma chags shing / /sems can kun la snying rje bas/ /stong pyapa'i sems dang ldan par shog /sbyin pa 'di yi byin larlabs kyis/ /dus 'dir bar du gcod pa yi/ /bgegs rnams ma lus zhi gyur nas/ /rkyen rnams ma lus bzlog ④par shog /bsrung bar gyur pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /g.yel ba med par bsrung bar shog /yid ches rten de 'phel bar shog /'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar yang / /mi rnams kun gyis bkur ḍabar shog /shin tu phra bar 7/6 1707

gyur pa yi/ /sbyin pa shin tu chung gyur ①kyang / /sems kyis thongs pa'i sbyin pa 'di/ /dpag tu med pa 'phel gyur ①te/ /byang chub thob pa'i rten du shogabla med byang chub thob gyur nas/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog/ //dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag kyang de ①la ma chags shing / /khe dang rnyed pa bkur ste dang / /'jig rten snyan grags zhi bar shogachags pa med pa ④rngam sems kyis/ /gzhan la re ba med par shog /phyogs 'dzin ngo bsrung ⑤med par shog /bdag gi dge ba mthar phyin nas/ /dri ma med pa'i dge ba yis/ /gzhan gyi bsod nams 'phel nus shog /dri ma med pas kun dag shog /brjod pa'i stobs kyis kun bral shog /bdag gzhan dge ba ma chad pa'i/ /bar chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob nas kyang / /ngan 'gro de la dgod rjopa dang / /theg pa chung ngur sems bskyed nas/ /theg chen sa la 'god nus shog /slob dpon kā ⑦ma la shī la'i smon lam mu kyiganyis ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //116 — 1708

bsdur mchan/17༷7 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉star bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa slob dpon ka ma shrī las mdzad pa'i smon lam mu gnyis ma bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉la slob dpon po/ ma shī las mdzad pa'i smon lam bcu gnyis ma bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi gus par/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ budhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtse bas/ /stong / ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉sbyon/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzlogs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉17༷/ shā// ༷/ /rgya/nga 'gyur/ 〈〈snar 〉〉du chung 'gyur/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoragyur/ ①〈〈snar 〉thade/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bde la 'god/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka⑧〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (80)—116wa 1709

༄༅/ /dpal legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i smon lam bzhugs/3— ༄go/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe rabs gang yang rung ba ni2/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis dang / /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang / /tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na/ /'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang / /khro ba dag gis 'khrugs gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam/ /bla ma dag dang pha ma dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang / /de las gzhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyid 4dang / /gang yang bkyid du stsal ba dang / /gang yang cung zad yi rang ba/ /bag med pas ni phra mo yang / /lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa 116—1710

rnams—/ /de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas pa/ /bdag gi ①de ni mngon sum bzhin/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams/ /yang dang yang du so sor bshags/ /bdag gis mi dge bgyis ⑧pa rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyi①/ /srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i ④phyir/ /bdag nyid ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /de yi yon tan gus bsgrags te/ /sa la mgo bos gtugs nas ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo can gyis/ /de ltar gus pas skyabs su 'gro/ /de nas mchog gi sa bon gang / /thar pa bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu sbyin/ /shin tu bsgoms nas mchog gyur pa/ /dngos grub phyir ni de bskyed do/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang / /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang / /nyon mongs rnams las sgol rjoba'i phyir/ /srid pa mi bde dog pa na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa—/ /de dag yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can phongs pa thams cad kyi/ / skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu bushog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten gred rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang / /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i/ /tshogs ni rnam pa 116——1711

ba/nyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas/ /bdag gi ② brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog/tshe yis 9mtha' klas byed pa dang / /gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur ba/ /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi ba dang / /grol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing / /byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /cho ga bzhin du kun tu skyed/ /sems can kun la snying rje dang / /byams pa nye bar gnas par bya/ /sems ni legs par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis rjes dran drug /nang gi bdag nyid zhi ba yis/ /bsam pa gcig /③tu bsgom par bya/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs/ /chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs la/ /mnyam par gzhag ④nas yi rang ngo / /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /zhi zhing nad kyang snyemed par shog /bdag kyang bya ba kun nus shing ⑥/ /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can—/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa yi/ /sems ldan tshe rabs thams cad du//skye ba dran zhing gebartser ldan shog /dpal legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud las gsungs 2pa'i smon lam rdzogs so(// //

bsdur mchan/171༷ ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉na/ /tshe rabs/〈〈snar 〉min/ /rab/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉bgyis/1711 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgyid/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yong mi bgyid/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagrol/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyon mongs skyabs su bdag nyid/1712 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈snar 〉mi ba/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cing / ⑧〈〈snar 〉sngagasung / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (81)

༄ga /tshen lam rin po che'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra ṇi jo na rat+na rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/smon lam rin po che'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji srid du ni dus gsum gyi/ /sems can thams cad ma zad pa/ /de srid sangs rgyas zhing rnams ni/ /rdul gyis byur bur gang ba yi/ /rdul rnams re re dag la yang / /de yi rdul mtshungs zhing gnas pa'i/ /zhing dang zhing gi sangs rgyas la/ /rdul de'i grangs kyis lus rnams kyi/ /de rdul snyed du phyag byas nas/ /gzhan yang rgyal rnams bstod bgyid cing / /rdul de dang mnyam bskal pa ru/ /gnas de rtse gcig rtag mchod shog /sras bcas sangs rgyas chos la phyag bgyi zhing / /de dag rnams la rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /lus dang yongs su bzung rnged me tog dang //rin chen de rnams la yang rtag tu dbul/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags 116—1714

bgyi zhing / /kun nas sdig dang rnam par bral bar bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang bdag gis ni/ /dge bas 'gro kun mchog gi byang chub gyur/ /khyad 'phags dam chos rab ston dus kun du/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bzhugs dam bca' 'bras bcas gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams la rtag tu mchod bgyi zhing / /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i//sems can kun gyi don sgrub ched/ /ji ltar 'jam dpal spyad spyod pa/ /bdag spyod de dang 'dra gyur cig /shes rab zab mo nyid du gyur pas bdag /'jam dpal dang ni mtshungs gyur mtha' yas pa'i/ /'gro la nyam thag zhi byed brtse ba yi/ /ngang tshul 'jig rten dbang phyug 'dra bar shog /kun du bzang pos 'gro ba rnams kyi yid/ /dga' byed kun du bzang po dang 'dra zhing / /byams pa legs par 'phel las blo gros ni/ /byams pa ji bzhin nyid du 'gyur bar shog /sbyin pas nam mkha'i mdzod dang tshul khrims kyis/ /rnam 'phrul blo gros mtshan te bzod pa dang / /gus par sbyor bas brtson pa'i brtson 'grus kyisaske/ /gdung bas 'phags pa'i brtson 'grus bzhin gyur cig /bsam gtan gyis ni rnam par 'gyur ba dang / /bral ba'i blo gros sring mo stobs dag gisaske/ /lag na rdo rje dang mtshungs shākya thub/ /ston par shes pa rdor snying 'dra bar shog /bde bar gshegs pa yongs su dri ba ni/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba bzhin gyur te/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa phun tshogs brtan pa'i blo/ /rtag tu brtan pa'i blo gros lta bur shog /rdzu 'phrul yang ni gzhan du mi 'gro dang / /thabs la mkhas pa dri med grags dang mtshungs/ /sems can rnams la sman dge shin tu dga'/ /rtag par shin tu dga' ba ltar gyur cig /pha rol phyin 116—1715

sogs rab tu 'byed pa la/ /blo gros mi zad pa dang mtshungs gyur cing / /dpag med phun tshogs dbyangs kyis nges ston pa/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i blo ldan ji bzhin shog /rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la/ /skyon med yid ni nor bzangs lta bu dang / /dpe med nam mkha'i chos rnams nyer ston pa/ /nam mkha'i snying po lta bur bdag gyur cig /sa bzhin 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor gyur pa las/ /'gro la mnyam par phan byed sa snying dang / /slong ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi la bdag /rtag tu dzam+bha la dang 'dra bar shog /rin chen chos ston pa yis mi ngal ba/ /bdag ni chos 'phags lta bur 'gyur ba dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa tshol ba la/ /byang sems rtag tu ngu dang mtshungs par sgog /gzhan yang yongs su bsngo ba bdun dag la/ /mkhas pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan lta bu dang / /ma lus bdun rnams yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /rtag par ring ba rgyal ba bzhin gyur cig /de ltar lhag pa'i bsam pas yon tan tshogs/ /skyon med grags pa de dang de las ni/ /sras bcas rgyal rnams rab tu dgyes pa dang / /'gro ba thams cad rtag tu zhi gyur cig /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan rnams/ /mngon par 'dod las yang dag dge thob pa/ /shin tu 'phel ba de yis mtha' yas pa'i/ /'gro rnams yon tan tshogs des rab gnas shog /smon lam rin po che'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi sasgo ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnas brtan nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas dang / dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes/dpal bsam yas lhun grub rtse'i pho brang du bsgyur ba'o// //176 —1716

༄༅/ /mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/①༄s+dza/ /rgya gar skad du/ a gra tsar+ya pra ṇi ṅgā na/ bod skad du/mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu kun la sman dang bde slad du/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /de dag la ni brjod cing mchod par bgyiṣ+pe / /'gro kun byang chub phyogs la la1rireg gyur cig /byams pa dang ni 'jam dpal mnga' bdag tog /chos kyi blo gros dpa' bo bdud rtsi gsungs/ /dpa' bo de la phyag 'tshal mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang mi dbang rnams la 'dud/ /thugs rjer ldan zhing 'jig rten don mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba mi mkhyen mi gzigs mi mnga' ba/ /mi dbang thugs brtse nyabyams la gnas pa yi/ /rgyal ba de kun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sngon gyi srid pa dag tu bdag nyid kyis/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis 7ṣ+pebadag gis bshags/ /116—1718

de bzhin lus ngag yid kyis bgyis tshustepa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /shākya thub dang mi 'khrugs 'od dpag med/ /de dag gi ②ni phrin las yongs rdzogs 1pedang / /chags dang bshags pa mkhyen cing rtogs gyur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis ④sdig pa bshags par bgyi/ /thams cad dga' mdzad skyes bu dam pa dang spyo/ /byang chub bzhugs pa kun la gsol bar 'tshal/ /ngan song bzhi po myur du zhi gyur cig /mi khom 'joms par bgyid cing rgyu bar shog /sangs rgyas bzang spyod dri med mnga' bdag dang / /de bzhin lhun po'i dpal dang nyi ma sgron/ /de dag bsod nams yi rang mkhyen pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bsod nams rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu dag na sbyin pa spyod pa gang / /de bzhin nying 'dzin tshul khrims spyod rnams dang / /shes rab bsgom dang bsod nams stobs kun la/ /byang chub yon tan don du yi rang ngo / /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan mtha' yas dang / /chos bstan byang chub 'jog bgyid thams cad la/ /byang chub yon tan don du yi rang ngo / /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /'jig rten rgyal ba gang bzhugs kun la bskul—/ /phyogs bcu dag na byang chub rnyed pa gang / /de dag ji ltar sangs rgyas ④gsol ba ltar/ /rgyal rnams bzhugs shing chos mchog ston gyur cig /rgyal kun bskal pa mang por bzhugs par shog /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /mi rnams thams cad mchog dang bla med pa/ /'jig rten sgon ma bde begashegs myur gyur cig /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal mchog (shegang dang / /las dge rnams la yi rang gang 9lags dang / /sdig pa'i las rnams bshags pa gang lags dang / /rgyal ba rkang gnyis 116—1719

dbang rnams mthong gang dang / /bdag gis dge ba cung zad ci bgyis pa/ /lus dang ngag dang sems las byung ba'ang rung / /bdag gis bgyi ①dang bgyid dang bgyis gyur sdegang / /thams cad skye dgu sman slad stsal bar ④bgyi/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mkhyen nas/ /stsal ba legs par stsal duzhing legs rgyas pa⑤/ /de bzhin bdag gis duskye dgu sman slad stsal⑦/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /bdag gis ⑧'gro la stsal ⑨ba gang lags pa'i—/ /bsod nams 'bras bu bla med ci mchis pa/ /theg pa chen por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag la byang chub 'bras bu grub par shog /mtshungs pa ma mchis kun nas sgo mo rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du bdag la mngon sum shog /'jam dpal gyi ni rjes su slob bgyid cing / /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gdab par bgyi/ /mi gcig tsam gyi ched du ⑩mnar med pa'i/ /tshor ba thams cad bdag gis myong gyur par⑪/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar bgyi/ /'gro ba thams cad mya ngan med par shog /sems dmyal gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal dang / /dud 'gro'i gnas rnams mi yi sdug bsngal dang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phung po mtha' yas dag /bdag la 'bab gyur 4rte'agro ba bde bar shog /rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing ni rnam dag dang / /sems can rnam dag ye shes rnam dag dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi smon lam mtha' yas gang / /smon lam de kun bdag la grub par shog /bdag gi smon lam nyams par ma gyur cig /bdag ni nams kyang skyo bar mi 'gyur shog /byang chub mchog ni bdag gis thob bar du/ /bskal pa du mar bdag ni spro bar shog /mchog gi spyod pa'i sgon lam rdzogs sonyu —//116——1720

༄ga /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs kyi smon lam bzhugs/①༄4/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa klog ②gi dus su smon lam du gsol pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ④bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag na/ ston pa bla na med pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ zhi ba chos kyi sku/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i chos kyis brgyan pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la ston pa dam pa'i 'du shes kyis gus par phyag 'tshal zhing dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /bstan dupa bla na ⑤med pa dam pa'i chos ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag cing rang bzhin gyis rnam par grol ba/ 'phags pa so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul/rnam grangs byis pa lta bu'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ don dam pa'i chos dang /dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad gshegs pa'i shul lam gyi buchos 'phags 116—1722

pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis bsdus pa dang / bstan pa'i chos skyes bu chen po'i dpal gyi mgur ①nas legs par gsungs pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang zhing tshig 'bru gsal ba/ mngon par mtho ④ba/ nges par legs pa'i lam du gyur pa/ mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa bstan bcos la sogs pa dam pa'i chos yi ge 'bru gnyer gyis bsnyad pa thams cad la bstan pa dam pa'i 'du shes kyis gus par phyag 'tshal zhing dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /sgrub pa bla na med pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jigs pa lnga las shin tu 'das pa/phyir mi ldog pa'i sa'i go 'phang ①brnyes pa/ sa chen po la rtogs pa'i khyad par gyis rim par bzhugs dupa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi sras/ 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon du gyur cing / sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa sku nyams su bzhes pa rnams dang / 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas rang gi shes rab ⑤kyi rtsal gyis go zhing / bsam gtan dang ting nge rjo'adzin la dbang thob pas rdzu 'phrul kyis ④don mdzad pa rnams dang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa gnas brtan chen po mchog bcu drug la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las byung ba'i sras/ chos las skyes pa/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa—/ srid par kun du spyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi cha las rnam par grol ba/ lha dang mi'i ④'jig rten kun gyis mchod cing phyag bya bar 'os pa thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mchod gnas dam pa'i 'du shes kyis gus par ⑨phyag 'tshal zhing dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyad par du yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum/116—1723

bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i lha mo dang / sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa thams cad ①bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'ang ②'khor dang bcas pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad lus dang ngag dang yid rab tu dang bas gus par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /dkon mchog gsum 'khor mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa phyag gi gnas bsod nams thams cad ①kyi dpal gyi zhing mthu dang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad la bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas mchod do/ /bstod do / /bsngags so/ /lus dbul lo/ /srog phyogs so/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod gnas ④de dag thams cad la mchod par dbul ⑤ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nying nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings rtogs par gyur pa rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs (kyelas byung ba/ gser gyi pad+ma ⑦'dab ma stong dang /gzhan yang mchod pa bla na med pa dang / bla na med pa'i lha'i me tog dang /lha'i bdug spos dang / lha'i phreng ba dang / lha'i byug pa dang / lha'i na bza' dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis rim gror bgyi'o/ /bkur ster ⑧bgyi'o/ /phu dud du bgyi'o/ /mchod par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang skad cig thang cig yud tsam la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin du kun nas gnas par gyur te/ me tog gi sil ⑨ma sna tshogs kyis kun du gang ba dang /dar gyi lda ldi dang / chun po mang po ⑪kun du byes pa dang / snod sna tshogs nas bdug spos mang po 'thul ba dang / dpag bsam gye shing mang po'i (tre116—1724

yal ga'i rtse mo g.yur za ba dang / me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing dang /spos kyi shing dang / phreng ba'i spos ①dang / bdug spos sna tshogs kyi shing sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan pa kun nas gnas par gyur pa/ /bla na ma mchis pa mchod par 'bul ②gyis bzhes su gsol lo/ /da ltar gyi mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa dngos su 'byor pa rnams kyang / lha dang mi'i mchod pa khyad par can rgya chen por sprul pas yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs te/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mngon sum dang 'dra bar dmigs te/ mchod par dbul gyis bzhes su gsol lo—/ /bdag gir mdzad du gsol lo/ /longs spyad nas mnyes shing dgyes pa chen por mdzad du gsol lo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ 'khor ba thog ma mchis pa nas/ yang dag pa'i don ma mthong ste/ phyin ci log gis babe+ed nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mtshams med pa lnga dang / de dang nye ba lnga dang / mi dge bcu spyod ①pa dang / 'phags pa la skur pa btab pa dang / dam pa'i chos sgong ba'i las babyis pa dang / sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las rnam pa mang po bgyis pas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur cing / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgrib par gyur pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci rjobagyis so 'tshal thams cad mi 'chab mi sbed par gnong ⑤zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis ma lus par mthol zhing bshags so/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa/ rnam par dkar ba'i phyogs thams cad la shin tu rjes su yi rang ba'i mchog gis rjes su yi rang ngo / /de 116—1725

bzhin gshegs pa gang dag dam pa'i chos btsun par mdzad pa'i slad du nang ①du yang dag 'jog la gnas ④nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor zhing bskul ba'i sa la ①gzhes pa de dag la yang chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis bden pa bzhi'i tshul du bskor nas dam pa'i chos bdud rtsi'i char dbab par ④bskul zhing gsol lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa gang dag gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad nas/'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing / 'byor pa thams cad rgud par bstan te/'jig rten mi rtag par bstan pa'i slad du/ rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig ⑤nas/thabs kyis mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag la yang thugs rje chen po'i gzugs kyis 'khor ba ma stongs dukyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' zhing /'jig rten na yun ring por bzhugs nas⑦/ lha dang mi'i ston pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang dag gis sems can ma lus pa'i don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang dus thams cad dang gnas thams cad du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ⑧tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal ba nas byang chub tu ⑨sems bskyed pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / srung ⑩ma thugs dam can mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa 'khor mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas mthong ba/ chos thos pa bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs ⑪pa/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po de dag la chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod rgya chen po bstabs ⑫shing phul ba dang / 'gro ba ris ⑫khams gsum gyis bsdus pa/ lam rgyud 116—1726

lngar 'khor zhing / 'gro ba ris drug tu skye gnas rnam pa bzhi las skyes pa/ji tsam sems can gyi ris na mchis pa/ sems can bsdu bar bsdus pa thams cad la yang bsdu ba rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen pos ①khyab par bsngos pa dang / tshe rabs brgyud ④pa nas lan chags par gyur pa'i bgegs rnams la yang / gnas dang / dus dang / longs spyod ji ltar 'dod pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po bsngos shing stsal pa/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / gzhan yang bdag cag gi snga slad du ①dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis so 'tshal gyi mthu dang / khyad par du yang yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs te/ shes rab rnam gsum gyi don du gsungs pa'i phyogs/ g.yo sgyu rjomed par bris pa dang / bklags shing ston ⑤pa dang /mchod cing rim gro bgyis rjopa dang / rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi mthu dang / lha dang drang srong la sogs pa rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gzi brjid dang / bden pa'i byen gyi rlabs ⑦kyis/ bdag cag gis mchod pa bshams ⑧pa'i gnas 'di/ sngon bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya cher bstan cing bshad pa de bzhin du/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag par gyur cig /yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa/pho brang gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i gnas 'dir spyan drangs te/ mchod pa dang / bklags pa dang / mdo sde dang / mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhung dang / dngos grub kyi cho ga dang / mchod pa la sogs 116—1727

pa'i dbang dang / byen gyi rlabs ①kyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad tshe rabs gar skyes gar gnas kyang /las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad ni byang / ngan song gsum dang /mi khom brgyad la sogs pa sdug bsngal thams cad las ni yang dag par grol zhing thar te/ bde 'gro lha'i 'jig rten du skyes nas 'phags pa thams cad kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ste/ phyag g.yas pa ②gser gyi kha dog can brkyang nas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ rigs kyi bu khyod ma 'ongs ④pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi dukhams 'di zhes bgyi ⑤bar/ sangs rgyas 'di lta bu rjozhes bya bar 'gyur ro rjo zhes lung bstan pa myur du thob nas/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su myur du 'grub ④par gyur cig /sangs rgyas su ⑨ma grub kyi bar du 'jig rten 'di dag tu ⑩yang / tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ rigs rgyud rgyas shing bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa dgra bgegs bar du gcod pa cis kyang mi tshugs shing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /khyad par du yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ chos spyod rnam (sprepa bcu'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bgyis pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab na yang / mdor bsdus pa bcu ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sras su dgongs shing / byin gyis zlob ⑫par 'gyur ba dang / tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i srung ma khyad par can ⑫rnams kyis bu bzhin du skyong bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang /bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa gdon ⑫thams cad kyi spyobasam sbyor ngan 116—1728

pas mi tshugs pa dang / gza' skar dang rmi ltas la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs ①thams cad bzlog ④par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten dang ①'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad bos pa bzhin du 'du bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe rabs thams cad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dang mi skol bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ba dang / mthar bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su grub par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' yas shing rmad du byung ba rnams bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la smin cing grub par gyur cig /khyad par du yang bod kyi rgyal khams su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring por bzhugs par gyur cig /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs su yang ngan sems kyi 'khrugs ④pa mi 'byung ba dang /mi nad dang phyugs nad rgyun chad pa dang / lo phyug ⑤rtag tu legs/ char chu dus su phebs bde skyid ⑥phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan te/ sems can thams cad dge ba spyod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhe sdang ba'i gang zag log sred can bstan pa gzhig pa'i ngan ④sems dang ldan pa rnams ni chu shing gi rtsa ba bzhin du gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum la dad cing dam pa'i chos bsrung sheba'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams ni tshe ring zhing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du grub par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad rnam pa kun tu/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs sgoradang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gye mthu byen gyis/ /gang dang gang na ji ltar gnas pa yi/ /sgrib dang sdug bsngal ma 116—1729

lus kun bsal te①/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus rab bsnyil nas/ /rgyud drug 'gro ba ma lus kun bsgral te/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod pas bsgrubs pa'i zhing / /rin chen mdzes pa rnam bkod bde ba can/ /bdud rtsi'i ①mtsho dang dpag bsam shing dang ldan/ /der 'byung skal ldan pad+ma'i mchog las skyes//yid bzhin phun sum tshogs pa 'phags pa'i sa/ /rnam dag khyad par can gyi gnas mchog der/ / thogs med rdzus ①te bde bar gshegs gyur nas/ /mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa rnam sel ba/ /rin chen 'od 'bar sku mchog 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /tshe dang longs spyod dpag med sbyin pa'i gtso/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'gro don mngon sum ste/ /de las mchog thob lung bsten dbang bskur nas//rgyal sras gnyis dang spyod pa'i blo mthun zhing / /phyogs bcur 'gro la phan pa'i don mdzad nas/ /srid gsum yongs kyi skyabs su gyur par shog /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs kyi smon lam rdzogs so④// //116—1730

༄ga /'phags pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa mdo sde chen po bklags pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa'i bsngo ba bzhugs/①༄4/ /'phags pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa ②mdo sde chen po bklags nas/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i bsngo ba/ dam chos gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar bar/ /yid dang rin chen mang po ①sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas—/ /mkhyen bzhi shes bcu gang chen mtsho dang ldan pa yi/ /chos rje busangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /chos mdzad rang rgyal nyan thos 'phags pa thams cad la/ /lus btud dad pa'i spyi bos phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /thugs rjes ⑤snyoms pa'i mar dang nying 'dzin snying po las/ /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes gsal ba'i mar me 'bar/ /'od bzang bdud rtsi dusrid gsum 'jig rten thams cad khyab/ /sdug bsngal nad sel mi shes mun pa kun sel ba//dam chos mdo yi sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde la 116—1733

gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /dam 1chos lung bstan sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /ched du brjod pa'i sde la ③gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /dam chos gleng gzhi'i ①sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchodape/ /'di ltar 'das pa'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /skyes pa nyarabs kyi sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /rmad du byung ba'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /rtog 'u pa brjod pa'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /gtan la dbab ④pa'i sde la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /skyes bu gang gis ④gus pas gang zhig gis/ /blo dang lce las dam chos sgon ma 'bar ba dang / /mdo sde'i tshig 'bru bdud rtsi thigs pa 'ga' tsam yang / /su yi snying dang lce la snang bar byed pa yi/ /blo gsal ngag bzang skye bo ji snyed bzhugs kun ⑨la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis lngarjes su yi rang phyag 'tshal nas/ /chos brjod ⑪seng ge'i sgra sgogs chos kyi sbyin pa 'di/ /'phags pa chos la ()mnga' mdzad tshig la dbang bsgyur 8dang / /khyu mchog dge slong rgya mcho'i rgyal tshab ji bzhin du/ /tshig gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad thams cad kyis⑫/ /'jig rten so so'i yid mthun chos kyi char 'beb khushog /'di ltar snying po byang chub ⑩tu phyin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyi dbyengs gzhi bye brag mngon sum du shes pa'i sprin zhes tu bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' dbang bsgyur 4sheb thob pa rnams la/ gzhi kun du rten ()pa'i sprin zhes ( 7bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i chos chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams 116—1734

la sgo kun nas 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams la kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa rnams la snying rje chen po'i tshogs ①shin tu brtan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i ②lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa rnams la/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin bye brag shes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi sbyor ba dang ldan pa rnams la/ 'gro ba yongs su sdud ④pas kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' cher skyes pa rnams la/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du dmigs pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor la spyad rjopa rnams la/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / gzhi rab tu sgogs par ⑤zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' ⑥las dang po pa rnams la/ snying rje chen po'i tshul dang thabs kyi ④snying po'i bye brag gi sprin kun du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed ④pa rnams la dga' bar bya ba'i mdzod shin tu brtsegs ⑨pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gye char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa la mos pa rnams la/rnam par thar pa mi zad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyis dga' 116—1735

bar byed pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /gzugs na ①spyod pa'i sems can rnams la gzhi ②kun du mi zad pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la tshul gyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i 'brug sgra'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /dbang bsgyur ④gyi lha rnams la stobs 'byung ba'i chos kyi yo byad mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /bdud kyi durigs kyi lha rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs can yang dag par bsgrubs ⑤pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /'phrul dga'i lha rnams la ye shes rin po che sna tshogs la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /mtshe ma'i lha rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dran pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa mthong na dga' ba'i shugs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i gnas su chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /dri za'i dbang po'i gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos yang dag par 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /lha ma yin 116—1736

gyi dbang po'i gnas su ye shes tshul rdo rje'i she)dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /mi'i gnas su 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par 'phags pa'i ye shes rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs dang /'phags pa'i lam gyi tshig gi rgyud kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /byol song gi skye gnas su las kyi lam kha na ma tho ba'i ②med pa la nan tan du bya ba'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa'i sprin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lhun zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /gshin rje'i 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrags pas sems can thams cad kyi gtong bas ①sems 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /sems can log par ltung ba rnams la snyug bsngal thams cad zhi bar rab tu thob pa'i dbugs dbyung ba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du dus thams cad du mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin rtag par 'byung ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi grogs su gyur te/ phyogs bcu nas stibyang chub tu sems ma bskyed ⑤pa rnams ni bskyed ( pepar gyur cig /sems bskyed ⑦pa rnams ni slar ldog pa'i sa thob par gyur cig /slar ldog pa'i sa thob pa rnams ni slar mi ldog 116—1737

pa'i sa thob par gyur cig /slar mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa rnams ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku thob ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grogs su gyur te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu dhisems bskyed nas theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i sgor gzhol zhing 'bab par shog cig /'jig rten skyong ba tshangs pa dang / brgya byin gyi ②grogs su gyur cig /lha ma yin gyi dgra las rgyal ba dang / so so'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /longs spyod kyis yongs su rgyas par gyur ①cig /rgyal po chen po bzhi grogs su gyur te/ so so'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / longs spyod kyis rgyas par gyur cig /'jig rten skyong ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / blon po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi grogs su gyur te/ lha so so'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / longs spyod kyis rgyas par gyur cig /gtsug lag khang gi bdag po thams cad kyi grogs su gyur te/ so so'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang longs spyod kyis rgyas par gyur cig /'byung ba chen po bzhi dang / lo tog gi lha dang / sman gyi lha la sogs pa rjomi dang mi ma yin pa'i ris na/ 'jig rten skyong ba ji snyed bzhugs pa'i grogs su gyur te/so so'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang longs spyod kyis rgyas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad du thun mong du bsngos pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa 'dis ⑤lha'i 'jig rten thams cad du khyab ste/ lha'i 'jig rten dge zhing skyed par shog cig /mi'i ris thams cad du khyab ste mi'i 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /klu'i ris ⑥thams cad du khyab ste klu'i 116—1738

'jig rten ①dge zhing sprid par shog cig /gnod sbyin gyi ris thams cad du khyab ste gnod sbyin gyi ris dge zhing skyid par shog cig /dri za'i ris thams cad du khyab ste dri za'i 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /lha ma yin gyi ris thams cad du khyab ste lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /gshin rje'i ris thams cad du khyab ste gshin rje'i 'jig rten du ①dge zhing skyid par shog cig /de bzhin du mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / grul bum dang / srin po'i ris thams cad du khyab ste so so'i 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /byol song gi ris thams cad du khyab ste byol song gi 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /dbang po gsal bar gyur cig /yi dwags kyi ④ris thams cad du khyab ste yi dwags kyi 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /dmyal ba'i ris thams cad du khyab ste dhidamyal ba'i 'jig rten dge zhing skyid par shog cig /snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad du khyab ste sa'i bdag po thams cad dgyes shing zhi nas phan 'dogs pa'i dusprin chen po dus dus su 'du/ 'brug sgra dus dus su sgogs shing / char chu rjodus su 'bab ste/ lo tog skye 'khrungs dus su smin cing 'phel bar shog cig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la khyab ste gnas thams cad dang dus thams cad du dam pa'i chos rnam pa thams cad du kun du rgyas shing rdzogs par shog cig /yon tan ⑦thams cad kyi ris su khyab ste legs pa'i yon tan thams cad rgyas shing 'phel ba dang / /nyes pa'i skyon thams cad byang zhing zhi nas yid la bsams ④shing bzang por smon lam ⑪thams cad 'grub ( byepar shog cig /bsam pa myur du 'grub par shog cig⑪/ //116—1739

bsdur mchan/1733 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesas/ du〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da sa/1724 ①〈〈snar 〉〉 pa'i/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉las/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉gling bzhi'i/ ④〈〈snar 〉rnamatshal lo/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i| 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ⑦〈〈po 〉〉〈〈snar 〉marabebs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 chos la ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabarjed/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉car 'bab/ 〈〈snar 〉skarachar 'bab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈rtesnar 〉da mchog ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ces/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉ra rten/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ces/1735 ①〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamachog ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedapa'/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasdus/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mkhyed/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / du〈〈snar 〉byedapal/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtsags/1736 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ①〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikyi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/1737 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng pa'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ dudze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/1728 ①〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉gigyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa ⑦〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/1729 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da thams cad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedadu/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da gnas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi nas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dus/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dag ⑧〈〈snar 〉rabasam/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ ⑩rte〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyob/⑪〈〈pe 〉〉 rdzogs so/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 rdzogs sto/176—1740
bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (85)116wa 1741

༄ga /chos kyi sprun pa'i bsngo ba bzhugs/①༄4/ /rkang gnyis mchog gyur rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /chags sdang bral ba'i dam chos bdud rtsi dang / /sdug bsngal tshogs bsal ④dge 'dun tshogs rnams la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /lus kyi gus bcas bsnyi stang rab bsgrubs te/ /dang sems 'dun bcas rtog ldan bsal ④'gyur la/ /yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas rab brjod de/ /mgon po sras bcas bdag gis rab tu bstanarjo/ /me tog phreng ba sil snyan mchog rnams dang / /byug pa gdugs dang mar me bdug spos rnams/ /shin tu dang ba'i sems kyis dbul bar bgyi⑪/ /rin chen na bza' rnam pa sna tshogs dang //gdugs dang bla re pho brang gdan la sogs/ /khyad par can gyi rgyan mchog rjothams cad kun/ /thabs mkhas kun rdzob byang chub sems yin te/ /'gro ba'i don du dad pas ④bdag 'bul gyis/ /thugs brtser dgongs nas 'di 116—1742

dag bzhes su gsol/ /gnyis med mtha' bral don dam byang chub sems/ /bsngo dang bsngo bya nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra yang / /sngon spyod rgyal sras bsngo mdzad ji bzhin du/ /shes rab rtsal gyis bdag gis bsngo bar bgyi/ /phyogs ①dus kun gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /dam chos bsrung bar ②nyid kyis zhal 'ches pa'i tshangs ris tshangs bcas 'og min lha la sogs/ /gzhan 'phrul 'phrul dga' dga' ldan 'thab bral dang / /brgya byin nye dbang rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcas/ /sa 'og sa steng nam mkha' bar snang bcas/ /bsod nams tshogs ldan lha tshogs mang po kun/ /thugs brtser dgongs nas dpang po mdzad du gsol/ /khyed kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa ni/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /thog ma med nas skye ba 'di bar du//bdag 'dzin sgyu mkhan log pa'i sems brgyud nas/ /nyon mongs drug dang nye ba nyi shu yi/ /dbang du gyur nas sdig pa'i las byas pa'i/ /mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu dang mi khom brgyad la sogs/ /bya bar ma 'os ①bdag gis bgyis pa dang / /sdig pa'i grogs ldan gzhan gyi rkyen song nas—/ /bdud rtsi spangs nas dug 'thungs ji bzhin du/ /yang dag lta spyod dam tshig spangs nas ni/ /log pa'i lta spyod dam tshig mchog bzung nas/ /sdig pa'i nyon mongs rgya mtsho tshul 'dra la/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /rang gis bgyis dudang bgyid du stsal ⑤ba dang / /bgyid par byed la rjes su yi rang bas/ /sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i 'jig rten ni—/ /'bras bu dhisdug bsngal nyams su myong gyur ⑦kun/ /dang sems brtson pas rab tu bshags gyur pas⑧/ /myong bar ma gyur smin par ma gyur 116—1743

cig /deng nas bzung nas ma 'ongs dus su yang / /rkyen du mi 'tsham sdig pa'i las rnams kun/ /nam yang mi bgyid mang ①du bcas pas na/ /'phags pa'i 'khor tshogs thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /tshangs par sprul ④nas byin gyis brlab ①tu gsol/ /byang chub snying po myur du bgrod pa dang / /'gro ba ma lus byang chub bsgral ba'i 9phyir/ /dang ba'i sems kyis dge ba bsngo ba ni//jog ma med nas da lta'i dus bar du/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed derka/ /shes rab gnyis med nges pa'i tshul rtogs shing / /thabs mkhas snying rje sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /sku gsum 'phro 'du phrin ⑤las rnam bzhi yis/ /snying rje bskyed nas dge ba ci bsags dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma bris pa dang / /bla na yod med mchod pa rgya chen dang / /mchod gnas sbyin gnas sbyin pa rnam gnyis dang / /nyan dang len dang de bzhin klag dupa dang / /kha ton dag dang ci rigs bshad pa dang / /tshul bzhin sems dang bsgom ⑦pas mthar phyung dang / /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang stoms dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang stobs dang ni/ /smon lam dang ni de bzhin ye shes dang / /rnam par dag pa'i phung po lnga dang ni/ /dran dang thubartson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang / /dbang stobs yan lag 'phags pa'i lam rnams dang / /phyi nang rten 'brel rgyu 'bras phye ba dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin stobs dang mi 'jigs dang / /ma 'dres chos dang rnam pa kun mkhyen '-i)dang / /thabs dang shes rab bden gnyis bden bzhi dang / /stoms par 'jug dgu zad pa ⑩bcu dag dang / /rnam thar brgyad dang rnam thar gsum dag dang / /bsam gtan brgyad dang 116—1744

dge ba bcu la sogs/ /de la sogs te dge ba ji snyed rnams①/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas rab bsngags pa/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bgrod pa'i lam—/ /nye lam dam pa shin tu mchog gyur pa/ /bdag gis bsgrubs dang sgrub tu stsal ②ba dang / /sgrub par byed la rjes su yi rang bas/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis ci bsags pasne/ /skal ba mnyam pas rigs kyi bu mchog rnams/ /bsam pa dag pas brtson 'grus rab bskyed nas/ /byang chub bsgrub ④phyir dge ba ci bsags dang / /phyogs dus kun gyi rgyal ba sras bcas pas/ /dang por thugs bskyed dam chos gnas par bgyi/ /dge ba'i yon tan khyad par ci mdzad dang / /mtha' yas mu med 'jig rten rab 'byam ⑤na/ /'gro drug sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /dge ba'i yon tan khyad par ci bsags pa/ /thabs mkhas bcas pa'i rjosnying rje cher bskyed nas/ /'gro ba'i don du ⑦dge ba bsngo ba ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyan dang longs spyod mchog gis klubs gyur cig /phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa'i ⑧rgyal ba'i sras/ /sa bcu rgyal tshab srid pa tha ma pa/ /shes bya bag chags rtsa nas bsal nas su/ /byang chub snying po shin tu nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje'i gdan mchog myur du mnan nas kyang / /bdud rnams sder bcas shin tu pham mdzad nas/ /zhing gi rdul snyed ⑨mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor 4rtegyur cig /tshogs kyi lam rtags bcu gsum rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa dad pa thob pa dang / /nges 'byed yan lag ting 'dzin bzhi sbyangs nas/ /sbyor ba'i sa gzhi nges par gnon 4spepa dang / /dang po thob nas dgu la thug par bgyi⑫/ /skyes 116——1745

mchog dam pa thugs rje mnga' rnams kyis①/ /brtson 'grus drag po'i me chen sbar nas su/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes chen po yis/ /'og min ⑤skyon rnams myur du bsal nas kyang / /kun gyis mthun par byang chub thob par shog /ma nor tshul bzhin dge ba 'di bsngos par①/ /tshogs dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal rnams/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'byel ting 'dzin sbyangs nas su/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog brnyes nas/ /'gro ba ma lus thabs kyis sgol mdzad cing / /sa bcu'i yon tan lhun gyis rdzogs gyur cig /dge bshes dam pa'i drin la rab gnas shing / /dbang po skyon med 'dun dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /nyan thos shes pa'i tha snyad ldan pa rnams/ /chos la bdag 'dzin ting 'dzin sbyangs nas su/ /theg pa chen po'i sems la gzhol bar shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba tshul bzhin bsngos pa 'dis/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /ci yang med dang srid pa'i rtse mo pa/ /bdag dang bcas pa'i ting 'dzin sbyangs nas su/ /bla med byang chub myur du ④thob par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /bsam gtan bzhi gsum bcu gnyis la sogs ⑤ te/ /gzugs khams lha tshogs mang po thams cad kun/ /bdag 'dzin sgyu mkhan de dag bsal nas kyang / /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /gzhan 'phrul 'phrul dga' dga' ldan 'thab bral dang / /sum cu gsum pa rgyal chen sa bla ba/ /'dod khams ris drug lha tshogs thams cad kun/ /dge bcu dpag med yon tan bsgrubs nas su/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus//lha ma yin gyi ris su gtogs ⑥pa rnams/ /nga rgyal phrag dog dug rnams spangs 116—1746

nas su/ /byang chub gsum gyi go 'phang thob par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /gling na gnas pa'i mi rnams thams cad kun/ /sdug bsngal dug gsum skyon rnams rab spangs nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sngon sems bskyed pa rnams/ /sems de rgyas shing yon tan rdzogs gyur nas① / /sngon chad nam yang dad sems ma skyed ⑤pa/ /dad dang mos pa'i sems su gyur nas su / /lus ngag yid kyis 1brtson 'grus bskyed nas ni/ /byang chub sgrub la som nyi med par shog /gzhan yang phran tshegs sdug bsngal 'di dag kyang / / nam yang ④ mi 'byung byung yang zhi bar shog /long bas gzugs mthong 'on pas sgra thos shing / /dig pas smra shes sbyon pas dran rnyed shog /zha bo rnams kyang de bzhin rangs pa dang / /nad pa rnams kyang myur du sos par shog /dbul po rnams kyis rtag tu nor rnyed shoga'u /bkres skom rnams kyis zas skom rnyed par shog /gos med rnams kyang gos dang ldan pa dang / /de la sogs pa phongs pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /thams cad bsal nas sgra mi snyan bzhin du/ /bde ba kun gyis kun ⑥du rgyas nas kyang / /bsod nams 'bras bu rtag tu grub par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /mtha' yas 'jig rten khams kyi byol song rnams/ /glen ⑦zhing gti mug par ni gyur pa dang / /gcig la gcig ni gnod pa'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /myur du bsal nas lha mi thob par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams kyi yi dwags rnams/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal rnams ni bsal nas kyang / /lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog la gnas/ /byang chub sgrub la som nyi med par shog /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /'jig rten khams kyi 116—1747

sems can ①ji snyed pa/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /ba mo la ni nyi zer ji bzhin du/ /myur du zhi nas lha mi'i bde ba dang / /byang chub sgrub la the tshom med par shog /mdor na mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi⑤//sdig pa rnam grangs ma lus kun bsal nas/ /sdug bsngal 'bras bu kun las thar ba dang / /bla med byang chub mthun pa thob par shog /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar brtsams pa yang / /bdag phyir ma yin 'gro ba'i phyir brtsams pas/ /deng nas bzung nas byang chub thob par shog /mi khom brgyad dang gtan du bral gyur cig /grogs mchog dam pa rnams dang mi 'bral bas/ /gang nas gang du byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe/ /phrad par gyur nas spyod par mi rngon pa/ /lha mi'i longs spyod mchog tu bde ba dang / /rgyal srid dbang phyug de bzhin snyan tshig rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du spyod pa ma gtogs pa/ /bslus ⑦ shing chags par nam yang ma gyur cig /rig pa'i gnas la sogs pa'i bya byed kun/ /mthong thos tha snyad bzhis ni bsgrubs ④ nas su/ /thabs mkhas snying rje'i ⑤ 'gro don ma gtogs thupa/ /spyod par ma gyur slob par ma gyur cig /yul 'khor nor kye dang 'byung ba'i gter rnams dang / /pha ma phu nu de bzhin spun rnams dang / /bu dang chung ma khyem dang bang mdzod dang / /bran pho bran mo rta dang glang po dang / /de la sogs pa bya byed thams cad kun/ /thabs mkhas snying rje'i shespyod pa ma gtogs par/ /bslus rmyeshing chags par nam yang ma gyur cig/rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus mchod pa dang / /'gro ba ma lus byang chub bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mgo gcod pa dang rna ba sna gcod dang / /snying dang rkang dang rus pa khrag rnams dang / / lpags pa dag ⑩dang yan lag nying lag rnams/ /176—1748

dgos pa'i don du ①spyod pa'i dbang thob nas/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin rtag tu gtong bar shog /byang chub snying po myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod cing mchod pa dang / /sdig pa bshags ④shing tshul bzhin bsngos pa dang / /yi ①dam bcas nas nam yang mi 'bral bas/ /byang chub spyod pa rlabs chen thob nas su/ /ji ltar mthun par 'gro ba'i don spyod ④nas/ /byang chub snying por (snyemyur du song nas ni/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas par tshar bcad nas//chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor ⑥gyur cig /lha dang lha min mi la sogs pa yi/ /grogs mchog dam pa rnal 'byor spyod rnams kyis/ /lta spyod dam tshig shes rab rtsal bzung nas/ /kun gyis bdag bzhin bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ /bsngo ba bla chen ⑦dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so3// //bsdur mchan/1742 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal byis mdzad pa'i sngo ba bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ rngu〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs ldan gsal/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastod/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya mtsho/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang bas/1743 ①〈〈snar 〉ṅkasu/ kye〈〈snar 〉tha/ ①〈〈snar 〉༅ngas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagyid/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rtsal—/ ⑥ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ /'ams bu'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagyur/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoragyur bas/1744 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ram/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉kyi tshangs pa rtsal/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ /tshangs pa rtsol/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅1ba/④ 〈〈snar 〉thasgrub pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ngaphrin/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaklags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skogim/khye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ kye〈〈snar 〉〉khyen/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/1745 1 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ khya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgrub tu rtsal/ kye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rang / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrub/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skarabyams/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mis/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉116byed1749

༄ga /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ ①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṅga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyis khyami thub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mgon po phyogs gcig bzhugs pa na/ /lha gcig rmidapa' bo chen po la/ /phyag 'tshal 'di skad tshig byagasol to/ /dge ba don du gnyer ba na/ /lha dang mi rnams so so nas/ /bkra shis dag ni brjod bgyis na/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dge ba don du gnyer ba na/ /lha dang mi rnams so so nas—/ /bkra shis rnams ni rjod byed pazhu/ /de dag bkra shis brjod par bya/ /yul bzang gnas dang grogs mchog dang / /sngon chad bsod nams byas pa dang / /sems ni legs par gtad byas pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /sbyin dang shin tu smra rjob dang / /yang dag don la rnam nges dang / /khrims 116—1751

ldan rnams dang mtshungs spyor ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /byis pa rnams la mi brten hadang / /mkhas pa rnams la brten pa dang / /mchod 'os rnams la mchod byed pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /pha ma bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / /zhi dang tshangs par 3snaspyod pa dang / /'byung po kun la snying brtse ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /sdig pa'i las ④las ldog pa dang / /dge ba'i las la brten pa dang / /bag yod pa dang brtag mkhas pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /nga rgyal med dang khengs med dang / /chog shes mthun pas 'tsho ba dang / /rtag tu byas pa gzo byed pa/ /de — bkra shis dam pa yin/ /mi smod de bzhin bzod pa dang / /'phags pa rnams dang mthun sbyor 5ba/ /dus skabs su ni chos nyan pa⑩/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /le lo med dang mang thos dang / /chos la legs par rnam nges dang / /de bzhin sems la rnyog med pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /gang zhig sems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i sems ni rab bsgom ⑦zhing / /dpag tu med de du mi 'khrugs pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /gang zhig 'phags pa'i bden rnams la/ /shes rab mig ni rab sbyangs dang / /tshul khrims nongs par ma gyur pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /'phags pa'i bden pa mthong ba dang / /tshangs par spyod pa bsgom spupa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa thob kye'agyur ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /ma rig pa dag rnam spangs dang / /shes pa mi 'khrugs ⑪skye 'gyur ba/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ⑫kyis bskyod kyang / /gang gi sems ni mi g.yo dang / /dri med zhi dang mya ngan med/ /116—1752

sngag /baje legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa ste gā thā/ bod skad du/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad ldupa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha gcig zhu nye bar song nas su/ /lhas mchod pa la zhus byas te/ /sangs rgyas chen po thub pa che/ /ci zhig smras na bde legs gyur/ /des ni ④tshig de gsan gyur na pye / /'jig rten rtsa lag bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig rtag tu rjod byed pa/ /nga yi bde legs 'gyur de nyon/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dang mtho ris na//rin chen rmad byung rgya chen mchog yod pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /cis kyang grangs dang bgrang ⑨dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar ⑦ shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog/ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu ④bde legs shog /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi shin tu gya nom gang / /shākya thub pas mnyam 116—1754

gzhag thugs chud pa①/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te/ /de mngon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dam pa'i chos ni durin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa/ /de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sbyin gnas de dag sa steng shin tu 1 dkon/ /de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur—/ /ngo mtshar ④shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya nom pa / /'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /shes rab dam pa mchog gi ④dam pa mchog /mchog min mchog mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /ting 'dzin dam pa bar chad med pa gang / /mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa/ /ting 'dzin bde 'ubartan rdo rje dper byas pa/ /ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting 'dzin med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi ⑦rin chen 'jig rten ④mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na spu / /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste/ /stobs chen rlung bzhi ⑩dag gis mi bskyod ⑩pa/ /de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa/ /'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo⑫/ /ngo mtshar shin tu 116—1755

rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /thams cad zil gnon ① kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan/ /kun gyi dam pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /bsam pa kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de④/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med/ /skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /shin tu 'gag cing gya nom nges par 'byung / /shin tu dri med zhi ba blos mi 'phrogasalku / /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /shin tu sdug bsngal ston cing bde sbyin pa'i/ /bden rnams mthong ste gang dag bag yod pa/ /bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs ④bral ba de dag skye ba brgyad pa rnams ldumi len/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /dam pa rnams kyi ⑥dam pa don dam mkhyen/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen cing don dam brtson/ /gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs medam pa thugs chud rtogs/ /shin tu sdug bsngal rnams kyi dpung gnyen mchog /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 716—1756

'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /'dun pa bskyed nas khyarnal 'byor ldan gyur cing / / go tam bstan rngul rtag brtson ④rab grol zhing / /gzhan gyis mi bkri ④ba dag zhing der reg /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /bden pa mthong bas brjod 5pas brgya lam na/ /gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang / /de ni de 'chab pa yi 6'os min te/ /chos nyid 'di ni mi g.yo gnas phyir ro/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad 7byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lhag pa'am mtshungs pa med/ /lha dang mi yi ston pa bla na med/ /ston pa ded dpon sman pa rnams kyi mchog /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /so ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yis/ /nags khrod chos kyi dam pa rab brnyes nasadru/ /chos de dang ni lhag pa'am mtshungs pa med//'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad spubyung dpag gred de/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dir ⑫ni shin tu bde legs shog /sdig pa rnying /rtezad gsar du byas med la/ rims nad med pas 'jigs med 116—1757

mya ngan bral/ /rtsa ba 'gags ①pas srid pa mi skyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin du ④'bar bar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /lhas zhus pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad 1 pa rdzogs so④ // //bsdur mchan/1754 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉la bde legs kyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ zhu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ceg④〈〈pe 〉〉ngagyur/ /des ni/ 〈〈snar 〉dngagyur/ /des 2/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jas/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgrangs—/ lnga〈〈snar 〉〉tsar/ ldu〈〈snar 〉〉du/1755 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhin du/ ④〈〈snar 〉ra ra ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rgas/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadzin/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅka'ajig rten/rngu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhin/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ 〈〈co 〉〉skyed/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodang /1756 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzan/ rngu〈〈snar 〉ra/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mophros/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ragongs/ ⑤ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyis/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye mi phrogs/1757 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 2〈〈pe 〉shesa'u tam brtan/ 〈〈snar 〉ye tam brtan/ zhu〈〈snar 〉zadan/ ④〈〈co 〉〉bgri—/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharjed/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉yo na/ ④〈〈snar 〉7da/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉d+kus pa/〈〈snar 〉tharnyes pa/ kye〈〈snar 〉7da/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradis/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXng/1758 ñtsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngagag kye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma na tu/ ④〈〈snar 〉thacas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skogi/116—1758

༄ / /bde legs su gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa s+t+ya yo gā thā② / bod skad du/ bde legs su gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i drung du ni/ /lha zhig nye bar song nas su/ /gang zhig ④rtag tu bde legs pa/ /bdag gi rnguzhu yis bcom ldan gsung / /dam pas de dag gsan pa dang / /'jig rten 'dren pas lung bstan pa/ /gang gis kun du bde legs su/ /'gyur ba lha khyod legs par nyon/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /dad pa mi g.yo legs rab brtanaphyo/ /gang zhig dge ba tshul khrims can/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig pha dang ma dag dang / /bu dang bu mo bran dag la/ /rtag tu legs par bsnyen ④bkur ba/ /de dag kun du bde 3legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig dgra bcom grags pa la/ /legs par rab dad sgo7yon 'bul dang / /lha yi bka' bzhin ⑫byed pa dag /116—1760

de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis ①lus dang ngag dag dang na / /yid la nyes byas med pa dang / /gang zhig rnam gsum rab bsdams pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'byung po thams cad la/ /tshad med kun du mi 'khrugs pa/ /byams pa'i sems ni sgom byed pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal kun spang phyir/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi du yan lag brgyad/ / bden pa ④ 'dren pa legs bsgoms thupa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang gis 'dus byas thams cad kyis zhwa/ /stong nyid rtag tu legs mthong zhing / /de ni sems la gnas gyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig lus kyi 37dri med chos/ /mngon sum ldubyas nas rgyu khyab dang / /dgra bcom rnam grol sems ldan pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs gyur/ /gang zhig ⑩'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug rnams dang chags bral zhing / /ye shes 'khrugs med skyes kyegyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /gang zhig lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon po yang srid spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas khong du chud gyur pa/ /de dag kun du bde legs 'gyur/ /lhas zhus pa'i bde legs su 'gyur ba'i rmyetshigs su bcad pa sdogs so⑫// //116—1761

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das la lha'-i dbang po brgya byin gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 1 ༄gro/ /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' ba 'od srungs rigs skyes zupa/ /rnam par rgyal bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /gser thub sgrib pa med par rab tu gzigs pa de/ /rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bsod skyabs rngugaser gyi ri bo 'bar ba 'dra ba de/ /rtse mo mchog tu gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thams cad mnga' ba dgra bcom dri ma gsum sel ba/ /mdzod spu'i rtse mor gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis 116—1763

dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor dgongs pa zil gyis mi non pa//rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /rnam par gzigs pa skyes bu'i ①zla ba mi yi mgon/ /rin chen rgyan du gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /shin tu rgyas pa don dam mkhas shing brtan ldupa de/ /ma la ya yi rtser gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas ston mchog thos pa mi mnga' ba/ /dri med zla bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis//grags pa dri ma med par mgon po pad+ma'i blazhu/ /dri ma med par gshegs ④gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po mar me mdzad pa 'od snang mnga' ba de⑤/ /'od zer dra bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //116—1764

bsdur mchan/1763 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/du〈〈snar 〉〉skyab/1764 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thad+ma pad+ma'i zla/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉shegs—/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉des/bsdur 'bras re'u mig:rdo ཿdzagab / (90)116wa 1765

༄ / /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bkra shis kyi dutshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas dam pa'i grags ldupar mtshan btags nga// /nor bu'i gtsug tu gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog ④ gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgon ma blo zhes mtshan btags pa/ /sbyangs pa'i lam du gshegs pa ltar/ /der ⑤ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sgrib med gzigs pa 'dzum pa'i spyan du tshimatshan btags pa/ /rgyan gcig ⑦ldan par gshegs 8snapa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgon ma mar me mdzad ces mtshan btags pa / /rnam par rgyal bar gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis 116—1766

mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bde 1gshegs yang dag don gzigs pa zhes mtshan btags pa/ /dri med rtse mor gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rang byung mchog ces mtshan btags pa/ /rin chen yongs ④su gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgon ma dbyig gi lha zhes mtshan btags pa/ /dri med sna tshogs gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur byug /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'gro ba med pa smra ba'i stag ces mtshan btags pa/ /thams cad tshal du gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yon tan kun mnga' dpal gyi rgyal bar mtshan btags pa/ /dga' ba'i rgyun du 3gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten phan brtson dka' thub drag por mtshan btags pa/ /kun nas mchog tu gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang ④po rab mtshe phyems bkra shis kyi du tshigs su bcad pa'o// //116—1767

bsdur mchan/1766 lkumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wakyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grags pa'i dam/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉legs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ཿga du 〈〈snar〉〉shegs/1767 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bder/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgos/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cen spos/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toratshe/ ⑥〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉wakyi/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogab / (91)116wa 1768

༄/ /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po rab dga' ldan gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ cha༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang khu po rab dga' ldan gyis bkra shis kyi zutshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /chags pa med pa'i zla bar mtshan gsol mtshan btags pa/ /pho brang krumachog tu rab gshegs pasnye/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /ye shes mtha' yas dbang zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /kha dog gser du rab gshegs pa'u/ /des ni 'di yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /kun du mtha' yas spyan zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /pad+mo'i sprurtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig/bkra shis dam pa shegang zhig gis/ /yan lag rin po che zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /rin chen mdzod du rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra 116—1769

shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /dpal rab rgol ba'i stag ces bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /dbang po'i khang par rab gshegs pa//des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yon tan thams cad ston 1pa'i nyi mar mtshan btags pa/ /me tog snying por rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yan lag 'od zer mtha' yas par ni mtshan btags pa / /shing gis brgyan par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po je tshom 'joms pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan de/ /rin chen khang par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mi yi seng ge ye shes sgon ma mtha' yas pa/ /spos kyi rtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas 'od mnga' ba/ /nor bus brgyan par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /ces pa ni bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas phal po che las gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi ②tshigs su bcad pa'o// //176—1770

bsdur mchan/1769 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ /②〈〈pe 〉〉pa lha'i rgyal/ 〈〈snar 〉〉lha'i rgyal / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wakyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ringang / khya〈〈co 〉stanashogs so/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉to/pa ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgad+ma'i/ ni〈〈snar 〉〉4ra/177༷ ①〈〈snar 〉〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wakyi/bsdur 'bras re'u mig:rdo ཿdzagab / (92)116wa 1771

༄ / /shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/rmye༄spro/ /shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi bkra shis don sgrub khyacing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ /khyed kyi 1don rnams grub ④gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /phreng ba mgo la 'dug pa ltar/ /lag pa g.yas na dpal yod shog /g.yon na'ang dpal ni gnas gyur cig /yan lag kun la'ang dpal yod shog /tshong pa dag ni nor tshol zhing / /phyogs bcu dag tu 'gro ba rnams/ /rnyed pa chen po rnyed gyur cing / /de yang bde ba skyed byepar shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /shar phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar spyod la skyong gyur cig /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang / /mgo dang lag pa nab khyaso dang / /rgyal dang skag ces bya ba ste/ /de dag rnams ni shar phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten 116—1772

skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /shar phyogs logs kye7na yod ces bya/ /de dag khyed la kun du srungasakhya/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /yul 'khor srung ④zhes grags pa ste/ /de ni dri za kun gyi bdag /nyi ma lhan cig bsrung thu bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod pa/ /mkhas shing ming yang khyemathun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig phyozad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya'i thustobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par 3lhag par skyong gyur cig /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / /don grub kyem dang mi pham dang / /dga' mchog ma dang dga' sde dang / /dga' can ma dang dga' 'phel ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing //shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /gzhi 'dzin zhes bya'i mchod rten yod/ /rgyal ba skyob pa dgra bcom pa/ /de rnams kyi rmye ni bzhugs shing mkhyen/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba na⑪/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /mchu dang gre dang dbo dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa lnga pa yin/ /sa ri dang ni sa ga ste/ /de dag rnams ni lho phyogs pa/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /lho phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du srungs⑫ / /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /'phags skyes po zhes bya bar brjod/ /de ni grul bum kun gyi bdag /gshin rje lhan cig bsrung bar 116—1773

shog /de la bu ni mang yod la/ /mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de rnams khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /lho phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /dpal ldan ma dang grags ldan ma/ /grags pa thob dang grags 'dzin ma/ /legs par langs dang rab mnga' ①dang / /legs par sad dang bde bsgrub ④ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par ④lhag par skyong gyur ④cig /lho phyogs logs ⑪kyi phyogs cha na// /pad+ma zhes bya'i mchod rten yod/ /rtag tu gzi brjid ⑥kyis kyang 'bar/ /rtag tu thams cad gsal byed pa/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed ④de ldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir/ /nub phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khyed la skyong gyur cig /lha mtshams dang ni spyon dang yang / /brtson 'grus brtan 2ldan snrubs dang ni/ /chu stod chu smad byi bzhin dang / /gro bzhin de ni bdun pa yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /nub phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du srungs/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mig mi bzang zhes bya bar shes/ /de ni klu rnams kun kyi bdag /chu lha lhan cig bsrung khyebar shog /de la bu ni mang yod pa/ /mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste⑪/ /dgu bcu rtsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag spyod la nad med cing / /shis par 116—1774

lhag par skyong gyur cig3 /nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rna cha skra ldu 'dres ma dang ni/ /pad+ma dkar dang skya rengs dang / /cha med gabyug dang dgu pa dang / /rol dang gnag dang stabs myur srid① / /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par ④lhag par skyong bar shog/nub phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /nub ces bya ba'i ri bo yod/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis ka'ang nub/ /nub pa'ang khyed la nor sbyin 'gyur/ /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag ④bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun gyis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de 'uldog par shog /dgos pa la la gang gi phyir / /byang phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /gang dag phyogs der gnas pa yi/ /rgyu skar khrod ⑦la skyong gyur cig /mon gru 'udang ni mon gre ⑨ dang / /khrums stod dang ni khrums smad dang / /nam gru dang ni tha skar 6dang / /bra nye ste ⑪ni bdun po yin/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /'jig rten skyong bar ⑫grags ldan pa/ /byang phyogs logs na yod ces bstan/ /de dag khyed la kun du srungs⑫—/ /de dag bdag po rgyal po ni/ /mi la zhon pa lus ngan po/ /gnod sbyin kun gyi 6bdag po ste/ /nor bzang lhan cig bsrung bar shog /de la bu ni mang yod pa/ /mkhas shing ming yang mthun pa ste/ /dgu bcu blartsa gcig zad par yang / /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /byang phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na / /lha mo gzhon nu brgyad yod de/ /rab chags lha mo stong lha mo/ /sa dang de bzhin pad+ma can/ /rgyal po che la nyer gnas dang / /ri ‘/phyodang khrel 116—1775

yod dpal ldan ma/ /de dag khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong bar shog /byang phyogs logs kyi phyogs cha na/ /sgos ngad ldan pa'i ri bo yod / /gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams kyi gnas/ /lha mo sna tshogs blta na sdug /de yang khyed la nad med cing / /shis par lhag par skyong gyur cig /phyogs na khyed cag bde bar shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /lha rnams kun byis rab bsrungs nas/ /nor rnams rnyed de ldog par shog /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ /phyogs bzhi dag na bdun bdun gnas/ /lha yi bu mo sum cu gnyis / /phyogs bzhi dag na brgyad brgyad gnas/ /dge sbyong brgyad dang bram ze brgyad/ /yul rnams la 1 ni grong rdal khubargyad/ /dbang por bcas pa'i lha brgyad rnams/ /de dag khyed la kun du srungs⑦/ /khyed cag 'gro na'ang bkra shis gyur/ /ldog pa na'ang ④bkra shis shog / gnyen la lta ba bkra shis shog / snyeganyen gyis lta ba'ang hūṃbakra shis shog /dbang bcas gnod sbyin rgyal chen dang / /dgra bcom pa dag snying brtse bas/ /thams cad du ni bkra shis dang / /bdud rtsi shis pa thob par shog /tshangs pa dang ni de bzhin nor rgyas dang / /zag pa med pa rnam ⑦par grol rnams dang / /klu dang gnod sbyin rtag tu snying rjes bsrung / /ston brgya mtshungs par tshe ni skyong bar shog /'phags pa rgya cher rol pa'i mdo'i tshong dbon ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u las 'byung dub shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //⑪116—1776
