bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (93)

sngag /yangs pa'i grong/ khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/she ༄gro/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la ser sna rnam 2 chags pa/ /rnam bye'ajoms dri ma med mdzad pa/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' ste④/ /spyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzin 3mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gye phyir/ /gang gis bde ba mnga' ⑥ mdzad de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis phyu 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyang dude—/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa 116—1779

de / /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing slu 1ba mi mnga' la/ /gsung gtsang 1gtsang mar mdzad pa de/ /spyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes snyepas/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don 'grub tshogs kyang grub pa dekru/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur⑤ / /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos nas/ /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed spyol bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por gang zhig gis/ /sa rnams rnam drug g.yos gyur cing klu/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa desaldu/ /spyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyurasbyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nitshu/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsungs pas/ /thub pa'i grags pa gang byung de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig 7mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin lhar bcas bde legs dang / /'byung po kun kyi ⑫bde legs ni/ /khyed la dus kun sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kyis ni bsam pa yis/ /khyod kyi ⑫don 'dod gang yin pa/ /don de di ring 'grub ④gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi 1ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /khyed rnams kun du ⑪bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha 116—1780

ni stong rnams kyis/ /yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad kyis/ /sdang sems can rnams byer gyur cig /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khodalku/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis/ /'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams/ /grong khyer 'di ni stong gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan snyegyur cig /thams cad nad ni med gyur cig /kun gyis 1bzang po mthong gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur cing zi/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang gnas pa rnams/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing lta/ /nyin dang mtshan du khyechos kyang spyod par shog /yangs pa'i grong khyer du ④'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs soldu// //116—1781

bsdur mchan/1779 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rnams/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rnams / ④〈〈pe 〉dz+ra mnga' de/ 〈〈snar 〉〉panga' de/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradzud/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉pangal/⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyanye/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉bskyang /178༷ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bslu/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉btsang / ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉skyos/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉ste/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byur/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉de/ /khyed/ 〈〈snar 〉〉de/ /khyod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉cig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉de/〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉bcas par 'gyur/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bcas par gyur/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stasnor ba na/bya〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ tunye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams pa yi/ /khyed kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grub/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉nyin/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/1781 lku〈〈pe 〉〉khyod/ 〈〈snar 〉skabod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gnas/ khyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉7)/ ④⑤〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉cig 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ du〈〈snar 〉〉sto/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (9mug)116wa 1782

las gsungs pa'i bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/①༄77/ / dudakon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'di 'am yang na 'das pa dang / /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pazu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi ⑤lhar gyur pa/ /mi mchog de dang 'dir phyeni mtshungs pa med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu 'ugasungs/ /bden pa de yis ⑦'dir ni dge bar shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas / /shes pas shākya thub des rtsirab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus ma byas yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu ⑨gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog / tsu) mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab tu bstan/ /ston pa'i bla med rnal 'byor rtag sgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bu'i mig gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /116—1783

bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /gang zag chen po brgyad pos rab bsngags shing / /gang zag zung bzhir hūṃbarjod pa de dag ni/ /drang srong chen po gang zag mchu ngas med pa/ /bde bar gshegs pas 1sbyin pa'i gnas zhes gsungs / /de la byin na 'bras bu cher 1'gyur te/ /zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhinapya/ /'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing / /go ta ma'i bstan la 'jug byed pa/ /de dag thos nas bdud rtsi mchog thob ste/ /mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de 3bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungasa'u/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog/mthong ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / /je tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden pa mthong / /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa rnam )gsum nam yang mi byed la/ /glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing / /de ltar de la lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungasadā/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar 'ubatsugs pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ /'phags pa'i lam kyis ⑫dam pa mthong ba yi⑪/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs⑫ / /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yis⑫ / /'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom ④zhing / /176—1784

lus kyang sbyin pa yid la byas pas ni/ /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang phrad mi ①'gyur / /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungasabye / /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor la/ /lag tu 1 blangs te bgrang du rnged pa nyid/ /de ltar kun du thuspyor ba rab gtang dzuba'i—/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungasabyu/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge ④bar shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni dge bar shog /ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal ding 'dir ru7bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde kyelegs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal ding ṅku'adir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder 13gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal ding ⑫'dir bde legs shog /'byung bo gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tem/ / /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye 'udagu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden pa gsungs shing brdzun ⑫med pa/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas che 14/ /'jig rten skyong bas nyu rtephyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang / /mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha yi snod mchog de dag hubye116—1785

ni—/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa//bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar ①shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis②/ /lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ /blangs nas ston la rab phul ba/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis①/ /nad pa rnams kyis ④nad sel cing / /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar ⑤shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang / /gtsug phud can gyi stobs rnams dang / /thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang / /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang / /gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang / /'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang / /shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar 0shog/ //bsdur mchan/1783 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ltar bkod/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so// kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'di—/ 'u〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉wa/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ n+tu 〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉ma zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/1784 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhin/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 1〈〈pe 〉༅/ 〈〈snar 〉༅na/ ④〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8na/rgya 〈〈snar 〉ra/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉rdzasung / ⑦〈〈snar 〉rams/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khisung / spu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rab—/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra / ⑪ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yo sa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rasung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/rngu〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/ 〈〈snar 〉medam/1785 khye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a ldan/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasung / 2〈〈snar 〉〉dwa ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke kun/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasung / ④〈〈snar 〉thade/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8nga ring /116—1786

3645༄༅/ /stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam bzhugs/①༄go/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang / /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang / /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang / /mod gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang / /ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni / /'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / /kauṇ+ḍi 3n+ya'i sngar thob dang / /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang / /tshangs pa yi ni byams pa dang / /brgya byin kyi ni dbang rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong gi yul rnams dang / /dbang phyug chen po'i snyestobs rnams dang / /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang / /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang / /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis/ /bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /'phags pa stong chen mo jerab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam sdogs sobye// //116—1788

༄ / /ma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bajen tshig bzhugs/1༄gro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam gzigs mya ngan 'tshang la gnas/ /rgyal ba gtsug tor pad+ma dkar po'i drung / /thams cad skyob pa sā la'i drung na gnas/ /bram ze 'khor ba 'jig ni shir sha'i drung / /sangs rgyas gser thub u dusmra rngura'i drung / /'od srungs n+ya gro dha yi dudrung na gnas/ /shākya thub mchog khyad par gnas drung du/ /phyin nas byang chub thob gyur go ta ma/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag la/ /mngon par dad pa'i lha gang 'khod pa dag /lha rnams de dag yid dga' mgur gyur nas/ /rtag tu dge zhing zhi bar 'gyur bar byos // //④sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis khyed cag ⑤bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag 'ukyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin 116—1790

bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun du bde legs shog /de dag sdig par ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin/ /rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom thams cad zag pa zad①/ /bden pa'i tshig 'dis kun du bde legs su gyur cig /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig ④rdzogs somi// //bsdur mchan/179༷ zhumatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉khir bkod/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ du〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha'i/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉// rgya'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rams/1791 ri ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ped/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉zags/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉dge zhing legs par gyur cig /bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (97)116wa 1791

༄ / /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ kye ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṅga snyel gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra ༷ shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun sum tshogs/ pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i srun mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan ④pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa'i chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyes ñdzumachod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi 'umachog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 116—1792

'grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lha yis bskor ba'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum+bi'i hūṃtshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /sred pa'i rnyimathar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge sgrub bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes sdeshing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis sa/yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa 6bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsa sha'i je/phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i sred pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra 116—1793

shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul te 1sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la//bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung 1ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te—/ / nams kyi ldutho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam ④btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sbor ldudrang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan hūṃpa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul ding ghu'adir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag ldubyed pa/ /bsod nams dag spubyed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra zheshis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa rnams kyis skyeng rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal rkyeba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa// man+d+ra ra ⑫ba'i me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog/lha dbang klu dang mi yi ⑫dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri 116—1794

za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur 1 cing zhus te gtan la phab parngu // //bsdur mchan/1792 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ sde 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dz+ra gā/ rte 〈〈snar 〉〉bkri / ④〈〈snar 〉lker bar stan/ phyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉s+dzas/1793 ①〈〈snar 〉〉thum ba'i/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉bltams pa la/ /srid pa/ 〈〈snar 〉ra stams nga/ la/ /srid pa// 5〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byes/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉s+dza/ she/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉rtsa shi'i 'phreng / 〈〈snar 〉 shi'i phreng /1794 rmye〈〈snar 〉ste/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kubyung / bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ram gyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/5〈〈pe 〉tha ra 7 ser/ 〈〈snar 〉tha ra nā sir/ sne〈〈snar 〉thasten/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang / kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ te〈〈snar 〉〉ku/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ tso 〈〈pe 〉zo gyal/〈'ar 〉7'i rgyal/ che 〈〈snar 〉7nar da/ tre〈〈snar 〉'as/1795 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'o//116—1795

༄༅/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/༅7༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṅga la gā thā/ bod skad du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmi ngan 'jigs dang sdig pa thams cad 'jig byed pa/ /tshe dang 'byor dang stobs dang bde ba rnam 'phel byed/ /khyed kyi bkra shis thams cad sgrub par byed 'di dag /rab tu brjod kyis de phyir mi rnams bsgrims te nyon/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i rngu 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /gser gye mdog can 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig pu dang / /chos dang dge 'dun lha dang lha min gyis bstod pa/ /bkra shis rnam par 'phel 1phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /bdud stobs rab tu 'joms pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /rnam snang mdzad dang thams cad skyob dang rnam par gzigs/ /kun du mchod sbyin rgyas par ④ 'gyur ba gzi brjid mchog /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /pad+ma'i spyan 116—1797

dang shākya thub pa thub chen dang / /ye shes dbang phyug spyan legs pa dang zla zhal dang / /'brug gi sgra dang rnga sgra lta bur ①dbyangs snyan pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /'od zer rgyal mtshan dang ni gser thub 'od srungs dang / /mar me mdzad pa shin tu brjid par gshegs pa dang / /'dren pa gtsug tor can dang 'od tog dpag med 'od/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /pad+ma mdzes dang ye shes stobs dang zla 'od dang / /nyi ma'i zhal dang dgra las rgyal dang rgyal bltams ldudang / /yon tan 'byung gnas dpal gyi gzi brjid 'jig rten gtso/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /mi 'khrugs pa ni rdo rje'i rngugadan la bzhugs pa dang / /'dren pa mchog sbyin rin chen tog tu bcas pa dang / /rnam par spel dang lag na rin chen rgyal mtshan mchog /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed5/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rtag tu rgyal dbang gtsug tor can/ /ston zla dri med lta bur zhal ras mdzes pa dang / /nam mkha'i snying po dang ni sa yi snying po dag /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed—/ /'jam dpal gtsug phud shin tu mdzes pas ⑤rab brgyan cing / /gzhon nu'i gzugs ni gser mdog 'od dang ldan pa dang / /rtag tu rgyal bar dka' stsob lag na rdo rje dpal/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed—/ /byams pa shin tu rmad du byung ba'i gzugs mnga' ba/ /lcang lo'i 'khril mnga' mchod rten gtsug tor gnas pa dang / /kun du bzang dang nor bzang dang ni sgra gcan 'dzin/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed / /skul byed ma dang sgol ma khro gnyer 'gro phan dang / /de bzhin shes 116—1798

rab la sogs pha rol phyin drug dang / /rma bya dang ni 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub bcas/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /gtsug tor las byung gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bcas pa dang / /phyir ldog ma dang bsel ba'i tshal na rgyal las 'khrungs/ /lha mo ri khrod lo ma can dang bcas pa rnams/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /don yod grub dang stong chen rab tu 'joms pa dang / /grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī rnguzhes byar grags pa dang //bad sa'i snying po gcig dang ku sha'i gyad ldan pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dang ni gtsug 'phyang 'od po che/ /de bzhin bgegs 'joms 'phags pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor dang / /zla 'od de yang gzhon nu'i gzugs dang bye ldan pa ni/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /gshin rje gshed po 'jigs c-ikun rab tu 'joms mdzad dang //pad+ma mthar byed gnod mdzes de bzhin 'khor lo can/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dbyug sngon bsnams par mdzad pa dag④ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /'phags pa mi g.yo bgegs rigs rab tu 'joms pa dang / /phun sum tshogs byed rmugs 'dzin ut+pal 'umadog can dang / /glang chen ko rlon stag lpags dag gis brgyan 'ugyur pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mod gal 'od srungs dang / /nor bu 'dzin dang ma 'gags nye ba lpi'akhor dang bcas/ /rab 'byor dang ni lus 'phags ri bo kun dga' bokhru / /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /stobs chen bgegs kyi rigs ni rab tu 'joms pa dang / /'od zer ldan dang cha byad rab tu mdzes pa dang / /dug sel po7sbrul gdug rgyags pa 116—1799

rab tu 'jigs hu7byed pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel miphyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /'phrog ma rna cha rnam pa sna tshogs g.yo 'gul ba/ /bu pho lnga brgya dag gis brgyan par gyur pa 1dang / /gnod sbyin bdag po lngas rtsen dang ni pad+ma'i mig /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /ha la ha la sems can kun la phan mdzad dang / /rin chen sgon mar grags dang nor gyi rgyun mchog dang / /gnod sbyin bdag po rnam thos sras po dpal thob pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /thams cad sgrol ba ④/ sbyin phod dam pa gzi chen dang / /byams pa'i stobs ni gtong ba'i snyestobs chen ldan pa dang //sprin gyi mdog dang ldan pa'i bu ni gang yin pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /rab tu dga' ba la sogs sa bcu de dag dang / /dpa' bas byin 'upa de dang gtsug na nor bu dang / /rgyal po dam pa zas gtsang dang ni ka pi ni7/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /lum+bi'i tshal na bung ba mang po 'phur snyelding dang / /gre tog 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /rma bya dang ni khu byug pho mo sgra 'byin pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /btsun mo sgyu 'phrul dang ni de bzhin go ta mi/ /shākya'i bu mo rdzu 'phrul chen mo grags 'dzin dang / / ṣ+pe rañdza tsusnan bsod nams ldan pa'i 6'bab chur bcas/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma bung ba hūṃ khyus lding dang / /'jam dpal at+pal ⑫sngon po yid du 'ong ba dang / /mgon po byams pa yi ⑫ni klu shing me tog rnams rngu/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /rnam snang mdzad pa zla 'od ⑫lta bu'i 'khor lo dang / /dpal thob rin chen nor 116byed1800

bu 'od dang ldan pa dang / /mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i pad+ma dam pa mchog /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /don yod grub pas legs bsnams ral gri ①mchog dang ni/ /mi bskyod rmerdo rje nyid dang gzhan yang ni/ /skyob 1pa thams cad kyi ni phyag mtshan ma lus pa/ /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bcas pa dang //dpag bsam gyi ni shing dang bum pa bzang po dang / /rgyal ba kun gyis nges par bsten pa'i byang chub shing / /bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed/ /lam 'jug dus dang nor dang 'bru rnams sdud zipa dang / /nang par dus sam yang na zhi ba'i las tshe'am/ /dga' ston kun na 'dug dang dgos pa sgrub pa na/ /ming mtshan 'di dag mi yis 5snarab tu bsgrims te gdon//rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi mtshan ni bum lus pa/ /lha la gus bzhin dz+wanyin gcig bzhin du nang par sus brjod pa/ /de dag sems can dmyal ba'i dogs dang bral zhing bde ba dang / /dpal dang ldan zhing nad kun 'joms dul nor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so97// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur ⑫cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'onyu7// //116byed1801

༄ / /rigs gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 1༄gro/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan gser mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sgu/ /bde gshegs sku yi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan dung mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / /bde gshegs gsung gi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan ljang ser ri yi rgyal po 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum mgon phyag na rdo rje ste/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis dam pa des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /rigs gsum gye bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //116—1817

༄/ /bden pa brjod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/1༄ṣ+ṭha/ /rgya gar skad du/ sabye ka ri yi mo ga la gā thā/ bod skad du/bden pa brjod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa chen po thugs rje can/ /thams cad skyong ba'i mgon po de/ /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog brnyes pa//bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /zhi ba myang 'das 'bras bu ni/ /bsten pa las byung ro mchog brnyes/ /rnam 'dren byang chub shing drung du/ /nyin zhag bdun du bzhugs gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas zhag bdun 'grengs te bzhugs/ /bsod snyems 'bul ba kun la dgyes/ /byang chub shing la mi 'dzum gzigs/ /yang dag mchod pas mchod gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rnam 116—1819

par grol ba'i bden pa brnyes/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs/ /rin chen las byas spru/ la pa'i sar/ /rgyal ba zhag bdun 'chag par mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rin chen 'od 'bar gzhal med khang / /nyams dgar bcom ldan bzhugs gyur te/ /nyin zhag bdun du chos kyi dbyings/ /bla na med la mnyam par gzhag /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /bzhin mdzes kha dog rgyan ldan pa'i/ /bdud kyi bu mo 'grogs pa spangs/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing drung du/ /sangs rgyas zhag bdun bzhugs par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /btang bzung gnas su klu dbang gis/ /sku dkris gdengs kas bskyab byas par/ /dpa' bo chen po zhag bdun bzhugs/ /klu de rjes su bzung bar mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /ring nas bsgrun pa'i rnam grol brnyes/ /bde ba mchog la spyod par mdzad/ /shing gi rgyal po sgol rgyu'i drung / /bcom ldan zhag bdun bzhugs par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rdo las byas pa'i lhung bzed bzhi/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis phul ba/ /ri mo bzhi mtshan sdod gcig mdzad/ /sbrang rtsi ldan pa'i bsod snyoms bzhes/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /tshangs pas gsol btab sangs rgyas kyis/ /nyams dga' 'khor mo 'jig grong du/ /'jigs pa med par 'khor bzhi la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba 116—1820

thugs rje ldan pa yis/ /chos kyi gru ni sprul mdzad de/ /'gro mang bsod nams la sbyar nas/ /mtsho chen pha rol sgol bar mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya sogs/ /dge slong rgyal ba zag zad pa/ /rgya chen chos mchog bstan mdzad de/ /de dang de dag rnam spro mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba steng rgyas gshegs pa mdzad/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul bstan mdzad nas/ /'od srungs la sogs der dul te/ /the tshom bral nas dge slong gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba nyan thos dang bcas pa/ /yid 'ong rgyal po'i khab grong gshegs/ /mi dbang gzugs can snying po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa lam la bkod/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i khab/ /yid 'ong grong du bzhugs pa las/ /nye du chos kyis bsdu ba'i phyir/ /ser skya'i grong du gshegs par gyur//nye du'i tshogs dang mjal ba las/ /de dag mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyur/ /mkhyen nas dpa' bo chen po des/ /nyi ma bzhin du mkhar 'phags te/ /sangs rgyas rigs sad chos bstan pas/ /sngon med dga' bas ba spu langs/ /mi dbang shākya'i rigs rnams kyis/ /nga rgyal der ni nyams par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho las ni sgol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mnyan yod grong khyer ni/ /nyams dga' bar ni yun ring bzhugs/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /a mra shing gi drung du ni/ /116—1821

ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul dag /rgyal bas mu stegs rnams la bstan/ /de dang de dag phyogs su byer/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten dbang po zhabs kyis no/ /gom pa gnyis kyis lha yul gshegs/ /cho 'phrul mthar thug ston mdzad phyir/ /mi mchog lha gnas gshegs par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /lha dbang gnas su gshegs nas ni/ /la ba dkar 'dra'i rdo chen yang / /rgyal bas khye'u chung du mdzad de/ /rdo ba mchog gi stan la bzhugs/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /sum cu rtsa gsum grong khyer du/ /rgyal ba zla ba gsum bzhugs nas/ /yum la sogs pa'i lha rnams la/ /chos ni mngon par bstan pa mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /lha yul zla ba gsum bzhugs nas/ /nor bu'i jem skas sprul pa las/ /lhas mchod bkur ste dang bcas pas/ /mi yi yul du byon par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /tshangs sogs dkar zhing chas dkar bas/ /yongs su bskor ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /lha las bab pa chen po yi/ /ngo mtshar ba dag bstan pa mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /lha las babs pa'i dus su ni/ /mthu dang yon tan chen po dag /mthong bas sems can thams cad rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyid la bkod snyam sems/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /grong khyer gsal ldan sgo ru ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni chos bstan pas/ /skye bo'i tshogs ni mang 116—1822

po rnams/ /chos ni mngon par rtogs par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /glang po'i dbang po 'dam bu'i ri—/ /myos pa'i shugs kyis mgyogs 'gro ba/ /rdzogs sangs yid gzhungs sman gyis ni/ /dri ma dag dang bral bar mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten bkra shis mi byed pa'i—/ /chom rkun sor mo'i phreng ba can/ /gnas dang thag ring sprul mdzad de—/ /chu la bying bar mdzad nas ni/ /chos bstan kun sbyor bral bar mdzad//thub dbang mi yi kha lo sgyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /gdengs can dbang po gzi brjid can/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /gdul phyir nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can/ /gnas brtan mod gal kyi bu/ /thub pa'i dbang pos mngag par gyur/ /brtse ldan mkhas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /nga rgyal skyes pa bcom gyur te/ /legs par skyabs su song bar gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /gnod sbyin 'brog gnas rtsub po ni/ /shin tu 'dul dka' sangs rgyas kyis/ /'dul bar mkhyen nas rgyun zhugs pa'i/ /'bras bu mchog la bkod par gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /phyogs rnams kun gyi rlung gis ni/ /ri yi rgyal po mi g.yo ltar//de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /'jig rten chos brgyad kyis mi g.yo/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /bsam gyis mi khyab 'od 'phro ba/ /dbu yi gtsug tor pha mtha' ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gnas pas kyang / /blta bar yang ni nus ma lags/ /bden 116—1823

pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /dam pa'i chos ni ston pa'i tshe/ /sku rgyab phyogs su gnas pas kyang / /nam mkha' zla ba nya ba bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal ni mngon sum mthong / /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar gyi yang / /'khor rnams la ni 'jigs med par/ /de rnams bsam pa thugs chud nas/ /de rnams so sor chos ston mdzad/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /skye sogs sdug bsngal gyis gdungs la/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum/ /rnam pa kun du srog dang ni/ /skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen no/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /sangs rgyas bdag gi skyabs kyi mchog /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /chos ni bdag gi skyabs kyi mchog /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis / /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin//dge 'dun bdag gi skyabs kyi mchog /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /bdag la rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /de ltar 'di skad bden pa'i tshig /rjod par byed pa gang yin pa/ /nye bar 'tshe ba spangs pa dang / /thar pa'i bde ba rmyemangon 'dod pa'i/ /mi yis kun mkhyen 'thob par 'gyur/ /bden pa brjod pa rgyal ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni rgya gar kyi dpe las 'gos lo tsā ba dharma pā la bha dra zhes bgyi bas bsgyur ba'o// //116—1824

swo/ /spubyebyesten(zhesnyerdordordoltesnyesgostekhyeshādrerge dze+e/ /༄ / /'jig rten kun gyi mos pa'i shing rta phyur bur 'gengs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bha ra ta dza ma raspya/ /rdospyordorderdordobyeḍispusmyordokyairdordobyetrīrdedz+wadz+wardoswortse/ /༄ / /deng 'dir dge legs shis pa'i me tog man+d+ra ra ba char du bsnyil/ 1 /ming tshig yi ge tshogs pa'i rjod byed lung gi khrung khrung sgra snyan 'byen/ /brjod par bya ba don bzang gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing khams gsum gyi/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs dri ma spyong byed bsel ba dam pa'i zla gzugs kyang / /gsal bar snang ba'i chos kyi rgyun gsum byang chub lang tsho brtas pa'i bcud/ 2 /thub pa'i mgrin las bab pa'i bdud rtsis rtogs pa'i lus stobs mchog tu rgyas/ /babe+eb gsum gser gyi dra bas gdong mdzes chos kun rnam 'byed mche ba rno/ /mtha' med 'gro ba srid las gdon pa'i g.yar dam khur ni khyer ba po/ /rig dang zhabs ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sa srung phreng ba byang chub grogs/ 3 /sna tshogs las kyi lag pas ma bdar mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gsal/ /gzhan gyi 'bangs su bskos pa min par thugs rje'i gzigs pa 'gro la 'jug /bcu drug lang tsho dar la bab kyang rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yab 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid skye bar dge ba'i bshes su gsol ba'i thal mo sbyar/ 4 /bai ḍūr+ya yi rgyud mangs snyan par 'khrol ba'i sgra dang bsres pa'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu 116—1827

rdzogs pa'i gdangs las shes bya thams cad snyan pa'i glur/ /'dren pa de yis skye 'phags snying gi brtan pa 'phrog pa'i mtsho byung ma/ /mgrin pa pad+ma'i rdzing du 'jug phyir snyan pa'i tshig gi mchod sprin spro/ 5 /ring nas thub pa'i bstan la phan pa'i smon lam pho nyas bos pa'i mgron/ /mi bdag chen po rigs mchog sā la'i rkang 'thung phreng bar bcas pa yis/ /snying stobs bla nas bla mar 'phags pas bde gshegs bka' yi dgongs 'grel che/ /gangs can brda ru 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams mi zad ma mo nyid du bskrun/ 6 /e ma snying stobs ldan pa'i snying stobs mchog gi rtsom pa 'di 'dra sngon/ /mig gi dbang pos longs su ma spyad de bzhin rna lung yangs po na/ /lhung ba med pa de ni ci zhes phyogs kyi dga' ma khengs ldan dag /phan tshun 'dri dang lan ldon mchid kyi rnga ni lhang lhang brdung ba bzhin—/ 7 /tshul 'di bsgrub la zhing dang dmigs pa sbyor ba rnam par dag pa las—/ /byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba gang de gal te gzugs su 'gyur srid na//lam gsum khongs su mi chud dogs pas 'jig rten kun gyi byed pa pos/ /mi mjed ces su grags pa'i snod 'di ched du yangs par sprul lam snyam/ 8 /de lta na yang byang chub mchog gi sa bon bsgyur min de srid du/ /gnas skabs mtho ris 'bras bu zhig gam sdig pas kyang ni mthar gtugs byed/ /des na 'khor gsum dmigs pa'i dug med rab tu zhi ba'i dbyengs nyid du/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rtse 'jo la rol mnyam par 'jog pa'i bsngo ba bgyi/ 9 /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs phyogs dang phyogs bral dang / /steng 'og dag na rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyi//zhing khams rnams su byon dang 'byon 'gyur dang / /da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i chos rnga che/ 10 /de dag re re la yang gdung 'tshob kyi/ /rgyal ba'i sras 116—1828

dang slob ma bye ba phrag /bgrang las 'das pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dag /smon lam don yod byed pa'i dpang por blta/ 11 /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /brnyes pa gang gi yon tan phyogs re'i 'phrin/ /yid kyi ngos su gsal bar bris nas ni/ /grangs med lus rab btud pa'i phyag bgyi'o| 12 /blo yi bang mdzod phye ba las blangs pa'i/ /nye bar spyod pa rnams dang rin chen bdun/ /'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i stong gzugs sprin/ /mchod 'os kun gyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig 13 /chags sdang rmongs pa'i dgra yis rab bdas pas/ /bslab gsum bcas pa'i dbang gi rgyal po dag /nyes lhung 'dam gyi nang du bskyur ba'i dri/ /gnyen po stobs bzhis bshags pa'i chab kyis 'khrud/ 14 /'phags bzhi so skyes bsags pa dge ba'i mtsho/ /phan dang bde ba'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba der/ /phrag dog rdul gyi 'tshub ma mi 'thor bar /yi rang 'dzum pa'i zla 'od dkar pos bran/ 15 /'gro 'dul kha lo sgyur ba khyed rnams la/ /skyo zhing dub pa'i nongs pa mi mnga' yang / /'jig rten mthun par btang stoms mi bzhugs par/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul—/ 16 /sna tshogs spros pa'i gzha' ris mya ngan las/ /brgal ba'i dgon par gzhol bar mi mdzad par/ /sngon gyi smon lam la dgongs bskal pa ni / /grangs med srid du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/17/de ltar bgyis pa'i legs byas de yis bdag /sems can mos pa'i mkha' la bgrod mkhas pa'i—/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi nyi ma mngon gyur nas/ /'jig rten dge ba'i snang bas 'gengs par shog 18 /de 'dra'i byang chub 'dod pa'i ko ki las/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dge legs yid gcugs grogs/ /'gugs pa'i ched du snyan 116—1829

pa'i ming bzung nas/ /bsngo smon tshig gi rgyang glus 'bod la dgongs/ 19 /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang byang chub sems/ /rkyen gcig rtogs dang nyan thos so skye yis/ /dus gsum rjes su 'brel par sgo gsum gyis/ /legs par spyad pa'i dge tshogs gang yin dang / 20 /chos tshul 'di yi ched du gtong ba'i phyag /'dod ldan yongs kyi dpag bsam brkyang ba las/ /mkho dgu ma tshang med pa'i mchod sbyin dang / /sgo gsum thang rer 'bad pa'i dge bar bcas—/ 21 /deng 'dir gcig tu bsdams pa'i gangs kyi ri/ /'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i 'od po ches/ /zhi bsil dam pa'i rgyun du bsgyur ba'i klung //byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor ro gcig shog 22 /de yi rten 'brel snang ba ma 'gags gdangs/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i mchod sprin bdag cag gi /smon lam 'grub pa'i bden dpang mchod pa'i 'os/ /bzhugs so 'tshal gyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig 23 /gang zhig thos na sdug bsngal rgyur bcas las/ /skyob cing mchog gi go 'phang sbyin pa'i chos/ /phan bde'i gzi byin 'jig rten gsum gyi blar/ /rab tu 'bar zhing yun du brtan gyur cig24/yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i dgongs don ma nor gtam/ /tsho ba'i blo dang ngag gi bang mdzod de//'jam dpal gzhon nus byin pa sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa thub pas bsngags pa rgyal gyur cig 25 /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi tasru ras/ /bstan la mkhas pa'i bya ba bgyis mtha' ru/ /'tshang rgya 'gyur ba'i lung bstan kun dga' bzang / /de yi lugs mchog kun du dar gyur cig 26 /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i phrin las rgya mtsho las/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i smra mchog nyin mo'i mgonaske/ /yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i slad/ /zhabs pad rdo 116—1830

rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig 27 /so so thar pa 'dul ba'i gzhung bzhin bca'/ /byang sems bslab pa mdo sde'i lugs su bshad/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde zab mo'i don bzhin gdams/ /'chad mkhas mang pos bstan pa skyong gyur cig 28 /sgra tshad rig pa'i mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /smra ngan bden pa bral ba'i phyogs kun las/ /rnam rgyal grags pa'i sī ta 'phrog byed pa'i/ /rtsod mkhas mang po'i log rtogs chom gyur cig 29 /sde snod gsum gyis brjod par bya ba'i don/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i rjod byed me na kas/ /sgra don rgyan gyi gling bu 'bum bsgyur ba'i/ /rtsom mkhas mang po'i bstan pa gsal gyur cig 30 /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sdes/ /bshad dang sgrub pas sa steng yom yom du/ /bgyid pa de la skrag nas me tog gzhu/ /stong pa'i brdzu la zhugs snyam byed gyur cig na1 /thub chen rang gi lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas su rab bsngags pa/ /bod chen sde bzhi dge bcu'i 'byor pa can/ /sa phyogs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ 32 /bstan la dga' ba'i lha rnams nam mkha' la/ /dus su lhags nas sprin gyi 'thor yab bzung / /swa ste dbyangs su len cing chu gtsang gi/ /an+dha rnyil gyi sil ma 'bebs gyur cig 3lda /de tshe gser ldan dga' ma rang gi lus/ /sngo bsangs mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan dang bcas/ /rtsa khrum lo 'dab myu gu 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /smin pa'i dga' ston ci yang ngom gyur cig 34 /yangasapa'i 'jig rten khams kyi lus can rnams/ /kun 'byung las kyi sprul pa sgyu ma'i lus//nyams dang dus min 'jig byed nad kyi rigs/ /mun nang sgron me bteg bzhin yal gyur byug 35 /zag bcas sdug bsngal nyid du bstan pa'i 'phrin/ /lo 116—1831

zla zhag dus rung ba min pa'i skeg /sri dang gzhan gyi byad kha sbod gtod dag /'bras bu 'byin pa'i nus pa bral gyur cig 36 /las dang smon lam log pa'i chu klung gis/ /dbang med bdas te legs pa'i gegs byed cing / /nyes par sbyor ba'i gdon bgegs 'byung po rnams/ /byams pa chen pos 'khyud bzhin gnas gyur cig na7 /khros pas gtsubs pa'i mig bsgyur smin ma 'khyog /khrag gis bsgos pa'i mtshon char 'bebs pa yis/ /phan tshun gcod dang 'bigs pa'i mi srun tshogs/ /sems rgyud snying rje bas kyang mnyen gyur cig na8 /bkres pa'i nyen pas lus stobs ches dman zhing / /bza' btung ming nas 'dzer ba'i skad kyis smon/ /rdul gyis g.yogs pa'i skra spu gzings byed pa'i/ /bkres phongs bskal pa ming yang mi gnas shog na9 /phan tshun brku dang 'phrog sogs lus med ni/ /lag pa'i brdzu la zhugs 'dra'i log 'tsho dag /yongs su spangs nas rang rang longs spyod kyis/ /chog shes mi zad gter la spyod gyur cig 40 /mdza' bar gyur pa'i 'gro ba phan tshun dag /mthong na byams pa chen pos dz+rel ba'i 'dzum/ /so phreng dkar ba'i 'od zer sngon 'gro mas/ /mdun nas bsu ba byed bzhin gnas gyur cig 41 /'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs/ /chos mthun 'byor pa rnams ni gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /dkar phyogs zla ba nyin mor byed pa'i 'od/ /dbyar gyi chu gter rnams su 'gran par shog 42 /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /mgrin pa'i bkra shis chos dung 'khyel pa las/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgra dbyangs ldir de yi/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub gyur cig 4na /bstan pa dam pa'i lha gnas snying gi stobs—/ /rmad byung phrag par 'degs pa'i sa 'dzin des/ /tshe rabs du 116—1832

ma'i ring nas smon pa'i gnas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la reg gyur cig4galas dbang gser gyi 'khor lo sngon 'gro mas/ /yangs pa'i chab srid ri gling rgya mtshor bcas/ /rang dbang byed pa'i pho nya dang po'i 'phrin/ /bla ma che zhes phyogs kyi bu mos smra/ 45 /kun dga'i dpal ster lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan/ /bla na 'degs pa'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos/ /yongs su khyab pa'i sde bzhi ldan pa gang / /'gro ba'i bsod nams khri 'phang brtan gyur cig 46 /gang gi bgrod byed zung gi chu las skyes/ /rab dmar dbang gi rdul phreng sgyugs pa de/ /khengs ldan phyogs kyi sa 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug /kun las rnam par rgyal bar brtan gyur cig gye /'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig 'chi med tshe/ /rgud pa med pa'i chab srid mnga' thang dpal/ /rnam par gnon du med pa'i 'khor dang stobs/ /nub pa med par grags pa'i yi ge rnams/ rga /rigs dang stobs dang dpung tshogs 'byor pa yis/ /khengs pas dregs pa rnams kyang rang dbang du/ /rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dmar mdangs mkhur tshos pa 'phos pa'i mdzes pa ci yang 'byung gyur cig go /chos dang srid kyi phrin las nam mkha'i mtha'/ /rtogs phyir ring du song snyam bgyid pa der/ /gegs byed mi dang mi min gnod pa rnams/ /nam yang 'jug pa'i go skabs ma gyur cig 50 —/ tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i rgyal srid chen po la/ /dbang mdzad chos kyi rgyal po mngon gyur nas/ /sa gsum bstan pa'i rgyal rnga brdung bar shog 51 /de lta'i byang chub sgrub pa la sdang ba'i/ /sdig pas snying nas bzung 'dra'i gdug can rnams/ /skad cig gson du rung na srung ma'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs dga' ba'i ru mtshon ci ste 116—1833

sgreng / 52 /lugs brgya dpyod pa'i blo gros ba ku la/ /'jam dpal byin rlabs sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis/ /phye ba gang de'i sku tshe las dbang dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod gyur cig 5na /lus can yongs kyi bsod nams khang pa ru/ /bde skyid mgron du khugs pa'i 'chi med mgon/ /bstan srid lha yi gzhal med yangs po na/ /mkhyen pa'i mig stong 'dzum par ma gyur cig 54 /sa spyod mchog gi bsod nams g.yab mo yis/ /bos bzhin byon pa'i chos blon chen po rnams/ /dge ba bcu dang mthun pa'i bka' khrims kyis//khams gsum 'gro ba bde la dgod gyur cig 55 /chos sbyin 'di yi las byed mgo 'dren du/ /'os pa'i yi ge dam pa gang gi gtsug /bab pa de yang skye nas skye ba ru/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun la dbang 'byor shog 56 /rtags gsum sngon rjes 'jug dang bya byed las/ /dus gsum rnam dbye 'byed pa'i blo gros kyis—/ /brda dag byed pa rnams ni byang chub bar/ /mchog gi bstan la bya ba byed gyur cig 57 /bzo gnas sbyangs pa'i mthar son sku gzugs dang / /yi ge'i rig byed 'dri 'don rko ba sogs/ /sgo gsum las kyi 'brel thogs thams cad kyang / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu mngon gyur cig58 /bdag kyang byang chub bar gyi skye ba'i phreng / /rnam gsum tshul khrims dag cing lung rigs dang / /gdams pa mi zad rin chen mdzod bzung nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed gyur cig 59 /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i glegs bam phreng ba dag /gang du bzhugs dang gang gis spyan 'dren mdzad/ /nyan dang klog dang mchod sbyin byed pa der/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i bden pas skyong / 60 /mdor na spyi dang bye brag 'gro ba yi/ /mtshan nas smos dgu thams cad 116—1834

mthong ba'i chos/ /phyi mar bcas la mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bral bar ma gyur cig 61 /mngon par mtho dang nges legs bsgrub pa'i rten/ /dal brgyad 'byor pa bcu dang mi 'bral zhing / /gang de 'jig pa'i chos su shes nas ni/ /dge ba'i snyeng po can du byed gyur cig 62 /srid par 'ching ba'i 'khyud po khyod nyid ces/ /bdag don zhen la rnam pa brgyas smad cing / /gzhan don byang chub mchog tu smon pa dang / /'jug pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag gyur cig 63 /nyam thag dbul ba'i tshor ba dbugs 'byin slad/ /gtong phod phyag gi dpag bsam brkyang ba las/ /lan dang rnam smin re ba'i 'dogs thag gis/ /bcing ba med pa'i sbyin pa mthar phyin shog 64 /srid pa'i 'dun pas dben pa gzhan don du/ /byang chub 'dod pa'i mkhur tshos 'dzum bsu ba'i/ /bag yod sdom pa'i kā shi mdzes dga' mar//rnam gsum tshul khrims rgyan gyis bklub par shog 65 /thos bsam bsgom pa'i dka' thub gdung ba dang / /gshe dang brdeg sogs gzhan gyis gtses pa rnams//chu la bris pa'i ri mo ji bzhin du/ /ma rmas bzod pa'i g.yar dam brtan par shog 66 /bsreg za rab tu 'bar ba bud shing gis/ /tshim pa med ltar rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur/ /ji tsam lci la phyir zhing spro ba yis/ /de la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom par shog 67 /'gro la snying rje shin tu mnyen ldan gyis/ /lan brgyar dkris nas bdag gi bde dge dang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mnyam dang brje sems kyis/ /rang nyid gces pa'i mgo bo gnon par shog 68 /mtshan rtog tsher ma med pa'i zhi gnas dang / /gnas lugs brjod bral rtogs pa'i lhag mthong dag /ya bral med pa'i rtse gcig rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag 116—1835

tu 'dzin pa drung nas 'byin par shog 69 /sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i dpung tshogs kyis/ /chos kun bdag med rnam par 'byed pa'i mtshon/ /gdengs pa tsam gyis nyon mongs dgra bo che/ /gzhom pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin par shog 70 /phongs phongs dbugs rab 'byen pa lag pa'i mthil/ /dmar dmar brtse ba'i tshon kyis byugs 'dra las/ /lhug lhug stsal ba'i zang zing sbyin pa yis/ /mang mang skye bo 'khor du sdud par shog 71 /de mthong dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar yid 'ong mas/ /bltas te chos dang thar pa'i phan yon dag /mchid du snyan par smra bas thams cad kyang / /dge ba'i phyogs su spro ba bskyed par shog 72 /zhum la gzengs bstod rgod la skyo ba bskyed/ /rmugs pa ngo mtshar gtam gyis brid byas nas/ /don spyod pa yis rang rang mos pa dang / /'tsham pa'i chos la legs par sbyar bar shog 73 /lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag dge ba'i blo/ /brtan ldan bya ba'i ched du rang nyid kyang / sbyin sogs brtson pa'i don mthun bya ba yis/ /sems can yongs su smin par byed par shog 74 /bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi tshogs zung gi/ /rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i snying po sa lam dang / /'bras bu'i yon tan cha rdzogs rgyu skar bdag /mda' lnga'i mun pa kun las rgyal bar shog 75 /sgrib gnyis zad pa'i 'khor tshogs grangs med dbus—/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug 'doms pa'i chos rnga che/ /don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa mngon gyur cig 76 /zla ba gcig las ji snyed chu yi snod/ /de snyed gzugs su 'gog med ston bzhin du/ /gang de nyid las mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /'bad med 'jig rten kun du snang byed shog 77 /gsang gsum yon tan mi 116—1836

zad yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam ltar/ /mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya ji snyed kyi/ /re ba'i shing rta kun nas 'gengs par shog 78 /'jig rten gsum na mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dra mi srid gtam gyi rnga/ /bden mtha' gsal bas lhang lhang brdung de yis/ /bdag gi smon lam snying pos lci gyur cig 79 /bdag cag mos pa'i khang bzangs yangs par dad pa'i spos chus kun nas bran pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams rin chen gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas me tog sil mas mchod pa'i dbus/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mgrin bsgrigs swa ste dza ya snyan pa'i gling bu 'bum bsgyur nas/ /bstan pa dri med yun du gnas shing 'jig rten bde ba'i shis pa kun gyis skyong gyur cig 80 /dga' ldan lha yi gzhal med nas 'phos 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dam pa'i snying pos phyi ba'i be+ed/ /lhums su zhugs dang pad+ma ltar 'khrungs gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad dang btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /nges par 'byung dang dka' ba rab spyad byang chub mchog brnyes bdud las rnam rgyal chos rab ston/ /sa gsum chos kyi snang bas khyab pa'i bkra shis dam pas 'di na shis pa'i 'bab stegs mdzod/ 81 /phyogs bcu rab 'byam mu dang mtha' yis thug pa med pa'i zhing na rab gshegs stobs bcu pa'iske/ /mchu sgos mtsho skyes dmar po'i 'dab ma 'dzum las 'phos pa'i tshangs dbyangs rkang drug glu dang bcas/ /'gro khams mos par mi 'tsham med pa'i zab dang rgya che legs gsungs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /rnam grol srog gi ka ba tshugs pa'i bkra shis dam pas skye dgu thams cad bde gyur cig 82 /de skad bdag gis smras pa'i 'bras bu mi bslu nges par gsung gi rdo rje grub pa min/ /116—1837

'chi med drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i ngag gi mtshon cha stor ba rnyed pa nyid kyang min—/ /'on te sngon gyi 'jam dpal la sogs rgyal sras spyod pa'i smon lam rgya mtsho'i rjes zhugs nas/ /dge rtsa byang chub chen por smin byas ji ltar smon pa nam yang don med ma gyur cig 83 /de ltar thams cad mdon pa chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung spyi dang bye brag gi dgongs don ma lus pa rnam par 'grel pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi 'chad pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gye phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa zhes bya ba'i glegs bam gyi phreng ba brgya phrag gnyis la bkra shis pa'i rtags kyis nye bar lhag pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i mgur gyi bum pa bzang po las/ lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi nod pa'i rgyal tshab kyi skyes bu chen po/ mdon rab rgyal ba nyid las dmigs su med pa'i bdag nyid chen po dpal rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes phyogs thams cad du yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi zhabs stegs mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i dbang po rnam par bsgyings pa'i khri 'phang mthon po ga la ba der/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs zung nye bar bkod nas/ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las kyi 'khor los 'chi med lam gyi mu mtha' gzhal ba snyam byed pa gang gi mtshan nas smos na mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kyis/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i dgongs 'grel chen po 'di dag par du brko ba cig byung na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams su yun ring por gnas pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pas sngon drangs pa'i bka' byed phebs par brten/ kun mdon bu ram shing pa'i 116—1838

ring lugs dri ma med pa yongs su dar ba'i yul gru chen po nyid du ches cher bsngags pa rnams kyi nang gses bod chen por grags pa'i sa'i steng gi dkyil 'khor phal che ba dag /chos tshul dge ba bcu dang mthun pa'i phrin las dang stobs kyi 'khor los mnga' sgyur zhing khyad par gnam gyis bskos pa shar phyogs gong ma chen po'i las lung gis bod chen ljongs kyi skye 'gro spyi'i rje bor mnga' gsol ba'i sde dge sa spyod chen po bstan pa tshe ring zhes grags pa'i rnga gsang phyogs kyi kho ra khor yug dag tu khyab pa de nyid kyis/ ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul bsngags par 'os pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang bla ma'i bka' tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa de ni ches mchog tu gyur pa'i lung rigs kyi nor bu dam par thugs la bcang nas/ mkhan chen dam pa'i bka' stsal ji ltar phebs pa de ltar bsgrub par zhal gyis 'ches te/ dmar ser zhes pa me sgrul gyi lo'i zla tshes dge ba nas las kyi dbu tshugs par mdzad/ de nas brtsams te snying stobs rmad du byung ba'i khur gyis bya ba 'di nyid kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du 'grub par byed pa'i bdag po'i rkyen ni gang de'i rigs sras dri ma med pa bod chen ljongs kyi skye 'gro spyi'i bsod nams dang dbang thang gi rin chen phung po gcig tu srungs pa'i khri 'phang mthon po la/ lha dang mi'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar mnga' gsol ba'i tshe na chos dang srid kyi phrin las 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phyogs kyi mthar bgrod pa can sde dge bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid kyi las dbang dang bsod nams gzhal du med pa'i gser ldan dga' ma'i lto ba yangs par/ sngon chad gang gis bskrun par ma nus pa'i 116—1839

legs byas kyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid kyi khur yongs su 'dzin pa la spro ba mchog gi rtse mor 'dzeg par gyur te/ bzhed pa tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi kha lo sgyur zhing / las byed rnams kyi mgo 'dzin par/ phyag mdzod 'gu ru bkra shis dang / gnyer pa a zlos dang / dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan/par dpon gzungs skyabs rnams dang / zhus dag pa bdag dang / de'i grogs ldan pa rmugs sangs sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ spo lu'i drung yig blo gros rgyal mtshanaske/ lcags ra'i dge bshes bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'dzom thog pa o rgyan bkra shis rnams dang bcas te/ phyi mo khungs thub rgyas bsdus cha gsum tsam dang zhib par gtugs nas zhu dag nan cher bgyis nas stod smad phyogs kyi sgyug 'dzin pa brgyad cu kha yar dang / par mkhan brgya phrag lnga tsam bsags nas—/ rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khye'i gnam lo gsar du shar ba'i zla tshes dge bar/mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen bgrang ba las 'das pa byon pa dang 'byon pa dang 'byon 'gyur ba'i gdan sa chen po dpal sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab chen por legs par grub par bgyis pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' spyi dang bye brag gi dgongs pa ma lus pa rnam par 'grel pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dge legs yid gcugs mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba par byang mdor bsnyus tsam dang bcas pa 'di ni—/ zhu dag pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon 116—1840

tan la smon pa'i tha snyad du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pa'i snyom las pa des / nam mkha' lding gi 'phur lding la bung ba gzhon nus 'gran pa bzhin du smras pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //yang smras pa/ lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgrar bcas 'bab pa'i klung / /drang srong khros pa'i dmod pas ma bcings na/ /skal ldan shing rta'i re ba rdzogs byed pa'i / /lam gsum dri ma sbyong byed de rmad byung / /zhes so/ /sarba maṅga lo// / /bsdur mchan/1826 ①mtshan byang 'di rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u mig :sna tshogs/ (1༷8): re'u mig gi zur mchan/ sdeb sbyor gyi mchan dang lag sum phab kyi sngags rnams tsheg khyim du brtsis med/116—1841

deb brgya dang bcu drug pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkram/pe cin ta yun ho par 'debs 'gan tshad kung sis dpa ra btab/spyi lo 2༷༷5lo'i zla por par gzhi dang po bsgrisas/spyi lo 2 5lo'i zla ngo ra par zengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ ༷ byed ༷༷52sku7—80057—634—52 336
